`containers/ghidra/ghidra_scripts/ReverseAIOptions.java`:

```java
// ReverseAI's fixed analysis options (pre-script; reviewed code baked into the image, never chosen by a request).
// Turns off every boolean analysis option whose name says PDB, DWARF or Swift: PDB symbol loading (symbol servers,
// local symbol files), DWARF (external debug files) and the Swift demangler, with their sub-options. Ghidra offers
// an analyzer only for programs it can analyze, so the rule is by name, not a fixed list; ReverseAIQuery reports
// the final values and the worker refuses the run if any of them is still on.
//@category ReverseAI

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;

public class ReverseAIOptions extends GhidraScript {
	static final Pattern OFF = Pattern.compile("(?i).*(pdb|dwarf|swift).*");
	private static final Set<String> FORMATS = Set.of("Executable and Linking Format (ELF)", "Portable Executable (PE)",
		"Mac OS X Mach-O");

	@Override
	public void run() throws Exception {
		if (!FORMATS.contains(currentProgram.getExecutableFormat())) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("UnsupportedFormat");
		}
		for (Map.Entry<String, String> option : getCurrentAnalysisOptionsAndValues(currentProgram).entrySet()) {
			String value = option.getValue();
			if (OFF.matcher(option.getKey()).matches() && ("true".equals(value) || "false".equals(value))) {
				setAnalysisOption(currentProgram, option.getKey(), "false");
			}
		}
	}
}

```

`containers/ghidra/ghidra_scripts/ReverseAIPrepare.java`:

```java
// Fixed prepare exporter: input is analyzed, never executed. Tables are streamed before the completion marker.
//@category ReverseAI

import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import ghidra.app.plugin.core.analysis.AutoAnalysisManager;
import ghidra.app.util.headless.HeadlessScript;
import ghidra.program.database.mem.AddressSourceInfo;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Instruction;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Program;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.Memory;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlock;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlockSourceInfo;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.RefType;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Reference;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Symbol;

public class ReverseAIPrepare extends HeadlessScript {
	private static final int MAX_FUNCTIONS = 65536;
	private static final int MAX_CALLS = 262144;
	private static final int MAX_REFERENCES = 262144;
	private static final int MAX_FUNCTION_VISITS = 1000000;
	private static final long MAX_INSTRUCTION_VISITS = 8388608;
	private static final int MAX_RAW_ROW_BYTES = 16384;
	private static final Pattern OFF = Pattern.compile("(?i).*(pdb|dwarf|swift).*");
	private Memory memory;
	private long visits;
	private int calls;
	private int references;

	@Override
	public void run() throws Exception {
		// A post-script failure must also prevent HeadlessAnalyzer from saving partial analysis.
		setHeadlessContinuationOption(HeadlessContinuationOption.ABORT_AND_DELETE);
		String[] args = getScriptArgs();
		if (args.length != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("ReverseAIPrepare arguments");
		}
		requireComplete();
		memory = currentProgram.getMemory();
		Path folder = Path.of(args[0]);
		try (BufferedWriter functions = writer(folder.resolve("functions.jsonl"));
			 BufferedWriter callRows = writer(folder.resolve("calls.jsonl"));
			 BufferedWriter referenceRows = writer(folder.resolve("references.jsonl"))) {
			int count = 0;
			for (Function function : currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctions(true)) {
				monitor.checkCancelled();
				if (function.isExternal() || uniqueFileOffset(function.getEntryPoint(), 1) < 0) {
					continue;
				}
				if (count == MAX_FUNCTIONS) {
					throw new IllegalStateException("TooManyRows");
				}
				int assemblyTotal = instructions(function, callRows, referenceRows);
				writeRow(functions, functionRow(function, count, assemblyTotal));
				count++;
			}
		}
		requireComplete();
		// Header is the sole completion marker, created only after every table was closed successfully.
		try (BufferedWriter header = writer(folder.resolve("header.json"))) {
			header.write(header().append(",\"complete\":true}\n").toString());
		}
		setHeadlessContinuationOption(HeadlessContinuationOption.CONTINUE);
	}

	private void requireComplete() throws Exception {
		monitor.checkCancelled();
		if (analysisTimeoutOccurred() || AutoAnalysisManager.getAnalysisManager(currentProgram).isAnalyzing()
				|| !currentProgram.getOptions(Program.PROGRAM_INFO).getBoolean(Program.ANALYZED_OPTION_NAME, false)) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("IncompleteAnalysis");
		}
	}

	private static BufferedWriter writer(Path path) throws Exception {
		return Files.newBufferedWriter(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW, StandardOpenOption.WRITE);
	}

	private static void writeRow(BufferedWriter writer, StringBuilder row) throws Exception {
		String value = row.append('\n').toString();
		if (value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > MAX_RAW_ROW_BYTES) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("RowTooLarge");
		}
		writer.write(value);
	}

	/** Exactly one instruction traversal produces the assembly total and both edge tables. */
	private int instructions(Function function, BufferedWriter callRows, BufferedWriter referenceRows) throws Exception {
		int functionVisits = 0;
		int assemblyTotal = 0;
		for (Instruction instruction : currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true)) {
			monitor.checkCancelled();
			if (++functionVisits > MAX_FUNCTION_VISITS || ++visits > MAX_INSTRUCTION_VISITS) {
				throw new IllegalStateException("TooManyRows");
			}
			Address at = instruction.getAddress();
			int length = instruction.getLength();
			if (at.compareTo(function.getEntryPoint()) < 0 || length < 1 || length > 16
					|| length > span(function) - at.subtract(function.getEntryPoint()) || uniqueFileOffset(at, length) < 0) {
				continue;
			}
			assemblyTotal++;
			if (instruction.getFlowType().isCall()) {
				Address target = callTarget(instruction);
				if (target != null) {
					if (calls == MAX_CALLS) {
						throw new IllegalStateException("TooManyRows");
					}
					writeRow(callRows, edgeRow(function, instruction, target).append("}"));
					calls++;
				}
			}
			// An instruction can expose the same relationship through several operands. Keep one contract key.
			TreeMap<ReferenceKey, Reference> sorted = new TreeMap<>();
			for (Reference reference : instruction.getReferencesFrom()) {
				Address target = reference.getToAddress();
				RefType type = reference.getReferenceType();
				if (!target.isMemoryAddress() || type.isCall()) {
					continue;
				}
				String kind = referenceKind(type, function.getBody().contains(target));
				if (kind == null) {
					continue;
				}
				sorted.putIfAbsent(new ReferenceKey(target.getOffset(), kind), reference);
				if ((long) references + sorted.size() > MAX_REFERENCES) {
					throw new IllegalStateException("TooManyRows");
				}
			}
			for (Reference reference : sorted.values()) {
				Address target = reference.getToAddress();
				RefType type = reference.getReferenceType();
				writeRow(referenceRows, edgeRow(function, instruction, target)
					.append(",\"type\":").append(quote(type.getName()))
					.append(",\"flow\":").append(type.isFlow()).append(",\"jump\":").append(type.isJump())
					.append(",\"read\":").append(type.isRead()).append(",\"write\":").append(type.isWrite())
					.append(",\"data\":").append(type.isData())
					.append(",\"inside\":").append(function.getBody().contains(target)).append("}"));
				references++;
			}
		}
		return assemblyTotal;
	}

	private static final class ReferenceKey implements Comparable<ReferenceKey> {
		private final long target;
		private final String kind;
		ReferenceKey(long target, String kind) {
			this.target = target;
			this.kind = kind;
		}
		@Override
		public int compareTo(ReferenceKey other) {
			int address = Long.compareUnsigned(target, other.target);
			return address == 0 ? kind.compareTo(other.kind) : address;
		}
	}

	private static String referenceKind(RefType type, boolean inside) {
		if (type.isFlow()) {
			return type.isJump() && !inside ? "jump" : null;
		}
		return type.isRead() ? (type.isWrite() ? "read_write" : "read")
			: type.isWrite() ? "write" : type.isData() ? "data" : null;
	}

	private static Address callTarget(Instruction instruction) {
		for (Address target : instruction.getFlows()) {
			if (target.isMemoryAddress()) {
				return target;
			}
		}
		for (Reference reference : instruction.getReferencesFrom()) {
			if (reference.getToAddress().isMemoryAddress()) {
				return reference.getToAddress();
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	private StringBuilder functionRow(Function function, int index, int assemblyTotal) throws Exception {
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		String signature = function.getPrototypeString(false, false);
		return new StringBuilder("{\"index\":").append(index).append(",\"name\":").append(quote(function.getName()))
			.append(",\"entry\":").append(entry.getOffset()).append(",\"size\":").append(span(function))
			.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(entry)).append(",\"anchored\":true")
			.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(hex(entry, memory.getBlock(entry), span(function))))
			.append(",\"signature\":").append(signature == null ? "null" : quote(signature))
			.append(",\"assembly_total\":").append(assemblyTotal).append("}");
	}

	private StringBuilder edgeRow(Function function, Instruction instruction, Address target) throws Exception {
		return new StringBuilder("{\"from\":").append(function.getEntryPoint().getOffset())
			.append(",\"address\":").append(instruction.getAddress().getOffset())
			.append(",\"length\":").append(instruction.getLength())
			.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(instruction.getAddress()))
			.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
			.append(",\"to\":").append(target.getOffset()).append(",\"to_file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(target))
			.append(",\"to_name\":").append(quote(nameAt(target)));
	}

	/** Every byte must have exactly one executable, contiguous file mapping. Also used by export queries. */
	private long uniqueFileOffset(Address at, int length) {
		MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(at);
		long offset = fileOffset(at);
		if (block == null || !block.isLoaded() || !block.isExecute() || !block.isInitialized() || offset < 0
				|| blockFileOffset(block) < 0 || blockFileOffset(block) + at.subtract(block.getStart()) != offset
				|| block.getEnd().subtract(at) < length - 1L) {
			return -1;
		}
		for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) {
			Address address = at.add(index);
			List<Address> mapped = memory.locateAddressesForFileOffset(offset + index);
			if (fileOffset(address) != offset + index || mapped == null || mapped.size() != 1 || !address.equals(mapped.get(0))) {
				return -1;
			}
		}
		return offset;
	}

	private StringBuilder header() {
		StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("{\"format\":").append(quote(currentProgram.getExecutableFormat()))
			.append(",\"options_off\":{");
		boolean first = true;
		for (Map.Entry<String, String> option : getCurrentAnalysisOptionsAndValues(currentProgram).entrySet()) {
			if (OFF.matcher(option.getKey()).matches()) {
				out.append(first ? "" : ",").append(quote(option.getKey())).append(":").append(quote(option.getValue()));
				first = false;
			}
		}
		out.append("},\"blocks\":[");
		first = true;
		for (MemoryBlock block : memory.getBlocks()) {
			if (!block.isLoaded()) {
				continue;
			}
			out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"name\":").append(quote(block.getName()))
				.append(",\"start\":").append(block.getStart().getOffset()).append(",\"size\":").append(block.getSize())
				.append(",\"execute\":").append(block.isExecute()).append(",\"initialized\":").append(block.isInitialized())
				.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(blockFileOffset(block)).append("}");
			first = false;
		}
		return out.append("]");
	}

	private static long span(Function function) {
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		Address last = function.getBody().getMaxAddress();
		return last == null || last.compareTo(entry) < 0 ? 1 : last.subtract(entry) + 1;
	}

	private String nameAt(Address address) {
		Function function = getFunctionAt(address);
		if (function != null) {
			return function.getName();
		}
		Symbol symbol = currentProgram.getSymbolTable().getPrimarySymbol(address);
		return symbol == null ? "" : symbol.getName();
	}

	private long fileOffset(Address address) {
		AddressSourceInfo info = memory.getAddressSourceInfo(address);
		return info == null ? -1 : info.getFileOffset();
	}

	private long blockFileOffset(MemoryBlock block) {
		List<MemoryBlockSourceInfo> sources = block.getSourceInfos();
		if (sources.size() != 1 || sources.get(0).getFileBytes().isEmpty() || sources.get(0).getLength() != block.getSize()) {
			return -1;
		}
		return sources.get(0).getFileBytesOffset();
	}

	private String hex(Address entry, MemoryBlock block, long size) throws Exception {
		long left = block.getEnd().subtract(entry) + 1;
		byte[] bytes = new byte[(int) Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.min(size, 4096), left))];
		memory.getBytes(entry, bytes);
		return toHex(bytes);
	}

	private static String toHex(byte[] bytes) {
		StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder(bytes.length * 2);
		for (byte value : bytes) {
			text.append(String.format("%02x", value & 0xff));
		}
		return text.toString();
	}

	private static String quote(String value) {
		StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("\"");
		for (int index = 0; index < value.length(); index++) {
			char c = value.charAt(index);
			if (c == '"' || c == '\\') {
				text.append('\\').append(c);
			}
			else if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7e) {
				text.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
			}
			else {
				text.append(c);
			}
		}
		return text.append('"').toString();
	}
}

```

`containers/ghidra/ghidra_scripts/ReverseAIQuery.java`:

```java
// ReverseAI's fixed Ghidra query (reviewed code baked into the image; requests cannot choose scripts).
// Arguments: <output JSON path> <mode> and the mode's fixed arguments (see analyze, functions, function and xrefs below).
// analyze writes what Ghidra reports, as plain JSON: memory blocks, functions (address order, at most MAX_FUNCTIONS; size is
// the span from the entry to the last body byte, decision m3a-function-span), the calls and the other references
// (with their reference-type flags) from the instructions of the first max_functions file-backed executable
// functions, pseudocode for the entry-point function and then the largest of those, and, in the same order, the
// first instructions of `assembly` of them (M3c). The Python worker checks what the bytes can confirm (each anchor's
// file offset, bytes and memory-block mapping, one rebase delta, bounds and order) and drops or refuses the rest;
// names, sizes, call and reference targets, reference types, instruction texts and pseudocode remain Ghidra's
// interpretation, reported as derived and never as verified. The M3d modes answer one question each (a page of
// functions, one function's parts, the references to one address) with the same blocks and the same kind of rows.
//@category ReverseAI

import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompInterface;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompileOptions;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompileResults;
import ghidra.app.script.GhidraScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.database.mem.AddressSourceInfo;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Instruction;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.Memory;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlock;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlockSourceInfo;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.RefType;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Reference;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.ReferenceIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Symbol;

public class ReverseAIQuery extends GhidraScript {
	private static final int MAX_FUNCTIONS = 4096;
	private static final int MAX_CALLS_PER_FUNCTION = 1024;
	private static final int MAX_REFS_PER_FUNCTION = 1024;
	private static final int MAX_BODY_INSTRUCTIONS = 1000000;
	private static final int MAX_ROWS = 65536;  // functions, callers or xrefs counted by one run (decision m3d-seams-w)
	private static final int MAX_LOCATION = 4096;
	private static final int MAX_TEXT = 65536;
	private static final int MAX_EXPORT_TEXT = 1048576;
	// The same rule as ReverseAIOptions: the worker refuses the run if any of these is still on.
	private static final Pattern OFF = Pattern.compile("(?i).*(pdb|dwarf|swift).*");

	private Memory memory;

	@Override
	public void run() throws Exception {
		String[] args = getScriptArgs();
		String mode = args.length > 1 ? args[1] : "";
		int expected = mode.equals("analyze") ? 8 : mode.equals("functions") ? 5 : mode.equals("function") ? 9
			: mode.equals("xrefs") ? 6 : mode.equals("export") ? 8 : -1;
		if (args.length != expected) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("ReverseAIQuery arguments");
		}
		memory = currentProgram.getMemory();
		StringBuilder out = header();
		out.append(",\"mode\":").append(quote(mode));
		if (mode.equals("analyze")) {
			analyze(out, args);
		}
		else if (mode.equals("functions")) {
			functions(out, args);
		}
		else if (mode.equals("function")) {
			function(out, args);
		}
		else if (mode.equals("export")) {
			export(out, args);
		}
		else {
			xrefs(out, args);
		}
		out.append("}");
		try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(new FileOutputStream(args[0]), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
			writer.write(out.toString());
		}
	}

	/** The executable format, the analyzer options the worker checks and the loaded memory blocks. */
	private StringBuilder header() {
		StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder("{\"format\":").append(quote(currentProgram.getExecutableFormat()))
			.append(",\"options_off\":{");
		boolean first = true;
		for (Map.Entry<String, String> option : getCurrentAnalysisOptionsAndValues(currentProgram).entrySet()) {
			if (OFF.matcher(option.getKey()).matches()) {
				out.append(first ? "" : ",").append(quote(option.getKey())).append(":").append(quote(option.getValue()));
				first = false;
			}
		}
		out.append("},\"blocks\":[");
		first = true;
		for (MemoryBlock block : memory.getBlocks()) {
			if (!block.isLoaded()) {
				continue; // non-loaded blocks (section headers, .symtab, ...) are not part of the program's address space
			}
			out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"name\":").append(quote(block.getName()))
				.append(",\"start\":").append(block.getStart().getOffset())
				.append(",\"size\":").append(block.getSize())
				.append(",\"execute\":").append(block.isExecute())
				.append(",\"initialized\":").append(block.isInitialized())
				.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(blockFileOffset(block)).append("}");
			first = false;
		}
		return out.append("]");
	}

	/** analyze: <max_functions> <decompile> <entry file offset or -1> <decompile seconds> <assembly> <max_instructions>. */
	private void analyze(StringBuilder out, String[] args) throws Exception {
		int maxFunctions = Integer.parseInt(args[2]);
		int decompile = Integer.parseInt(args[3]);
		long entryOffset = Long.parseLong(args[4]);
		long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 1000L * Integer.parseInt(args[5]);
		int assembly = Integer.parseInt(args[6]);
		int maxInstructions = Integer.parseInt(args[7]);

		List<Function> selected = new ArrayList<>();
		out.append(",\"functions\":[");
		boolean first = true;
		int count = 0;
		for (Function function : currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctions(true)) {
			if (function.isExternal() || count == MAX_FUNCTIONS) {
				continue;
			}
			count++;
			Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
			long size = span(function);
			long offset = fileOffset(entry);
			MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(entry);
			boolean anchored = offset >= 0 && block != null && block.isExecute() && block.isInitialized()
				&& selected.size() < maxFunctions;
			out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"name\":").append(quote(function.getName()))
				.append(",\"entry\":").append(entry.getOffset())
				.append(",\"size\":").append(size)
				.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(offset)
				.append(",\"anchored\":").append(anchored)
				.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(anchored ? hex(entry, block, size) : ""))
				.append(",\"calls\":[");
			if (anchored) {
				selected.add(function);
				appendCalls(out, function, MAX_CALLS_PER_FUNCTION);  // analyze: at most 1,024 rows, unchanged
			}
			out.append("],\"refs\":[");
			if (anchored) {
				appendRefs(out, function);
			}
			out.append("]}");
			first = false;
		}

		out.append("],\"pseudocode\":[");
		List<Function> order = new ArrayList<>();
		for (Function function : selected) {
			if (fileOffset(function.getEntryPoint()) == entryOffset) {
				order.add(function);
			}
		}
		List<Function> rest = new ArrayList<>(selected);
		rest.removeAll(order);
		rest.sort((a, b) -> {
			int bySize = Long.compare(span(b), span(a));
			return bySize != 0 ? bySize : a.getEntryPoint().compareTo(b.getEntryPoint());
		});
		order.addAll(rest);
		first = true;
		if (decompile > 0 && !order.isEmpty()) {
			DecompInterface decompiler = new DecompInterface();
			try {
				decompiler.setOptions(new DecompileOptions());
				decompiler.openProgram(currentProgram);
				for (Function function : order.subList(0, Math.min(decompile, order.size()))) {
					String text = decompiled(decompiler, function, deadline);
					if (text == null) {
						continue;
					}
					out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"entry\":").append(function.getEntryPoint().getOffset())
						.append(",\"text\":").append(quote(text)).append("}");
					first = false;
				}
			}
			finally {
				decompiler.dispose();
			}
		}
		out.append("],\"assembly\":[");
		first = true;
		for (Function function : order.subList(0, Math.min(Math.max(assembly, 0), order.size()))) {
			out.append(first ? "" : ",");
			appendInstructions(out, function, maxInstructions);
			first = false;
		}
		out.append("]");
	}

	/** functions: <query (x + hex)> <start> <limit>: the page of file-backed executable functions whose name contains
	 * query, in address order, and how many there are (at most MAX_ROWS, else "overflow"). */
	private void functions(StringBuilder out, String[] args) throws Exception {
		String query = text(args[2]);
		int start = Integer.parseInt(args[3]);
		int limit = Integer.parseInt(args[4]);
		out.append(",\"functions\":[");
		boolean first = true;
		int total = 0;
		for (Function function : anchoredFunctions()) {
			if (!function.getName().contains(query)) {
				continue;
			}
			if (total == MAX_ROWS) {
				out.append("],\"overflow\":true,\"total\":").append(total);
				return;
			}
			if (total >= start && total - start < limit) {
				out.append(first ? "" : ",");
				appendFunction(out, function, total, false);
				first = false;
			}
			total++;
		}
		out.append("],\"overflow\":false,\"total\":").append(total);
	}

	/** function: <select entry|name> <entry file offset or -1> <name (x + hex)> <parts> <start> <limit> <decompile
	 * seconds>: the target (the function at that entry, or the lowest-entry one with that exact name), how many share
	 * the name, its calls and references, the calls to it from file-backed executable code, its pseudocode and a page
	 * of its instructions from the entry. */
	private void function(StringBuilder out, String[] args) throws Exception {
		boolean byEntry = args[2].equals("entry");
		long entryOffset = Long.parseLong(args[3]);
		String name = text(args[4]);
		String parts = args[5];
		int start = Integer.parseInt(args[6]);
		int limit = Integer.parseInt(args[7]);
		long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 1000L * Integer.parseInt(args[8]);
		Function target = null;
		int matches = 0;
		for (Function function : anchoredFunctions()) {
			if (byEntry ? fileOffset(function.getEntryPoint()) == entryOffset : function.getName().equals(name)) {
				target = target == null ? function : target;  // address order: the first is the lowest entry
				matches++;
			}
		}
		out.append(",\"matches\":").append(matches).append(",\"target\":");
		if (target == null) {
			out.append("null");
			return;
		}
		appendFunction(out, target, 0, true);
		out.append(",\"callers\":");
		appendReferencesTo(out, target.getEntryPoint(), true);
		out.append(",\"pseudocode\":");
		String text = null;
		if (parts.equals("pseudocode") || parts.equals("all")) {
			DecompInterface decompiler = new DecompInterface();
			try {
				decompiler.setOptions(new DecompileOptions());
				decompiler.openProgram(currentProgram);
				text = decompiled(decompiler, target, deadline);
			}
			finally {
				decompiler.dispose();
			}
		}
		out.append(text == null ? "null" : quote(text)).append(",\"instructions\":");
		if (parts.equals("assembly") || parts.equals("all")) {
			appendPage(out, target, start, limit);
		}
		else {
			out.append("null");
		}
	}

	/** export: <entry|name> <entry file offset> <name (x + hex)> <pseudocode|assembly> <start> <limit>.
	 * Cached tables serve all other parts. A call here visits or decompiles only its selected function. */
	private void export(StringBuilder out, String[] args) throws Exception {
		if ((!args[2].equals("entry") && !args[2].equals("name"))
				|| (!args[5].equals("pseudocode") && !args[5].equals("assembly"))) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("ReverseAIQuery export arguments");
		}
		boolean byEntry = args[2].equals("entry");
		long offset = Long.parseLong(args[3]);
		String name = text(args[4]);
		int start = Integer.parseInt(args[6]);
		int limit = Integer.parseInt(args[7]);
		if (start < 0 || start > 1048575 || limit < 1 || limit > 128) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("ReverseAIQuery export page");
		}
		Function target = null;
		for (Function function : currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctions(true)) {
			monitor.checkCancelled();
			long entryOffset = uniqueExportFileOffset(function.getEntryPoint(), 1);
			if (!function.isExternal() && entryOffset >= 0
					&& (byEntry ? entryOffset == offset : function.getName().equals(name))) {
				target = function;
				break; // The iterator's address order selects the lowest exact match.
			}
		}
		out.append(",\"function\":");
		if (target == null) {
			out.append("null,\"pseudocode\":null,\"instructions\":null");
			return;
		}
		appendFunction(out, target, 0, false);
		out.append(",\"pseudocode\":");
		String pseudocode = args[5].equals("pseudocode") ? exportDecompiled(target) : null;
		out.append(pseudocode == null ? "null" : quote(pseudocode)).append(",\"instructions\":");
		if (args[5].equals("assembly")) {
			appendExportPage(out, target, start, limit);
		}
		else {
			out.append("null");
		}
	}

	/** Match the prepare traversal's validity rule, so every cursor counts the same admitted instructions. */
	private void appendExportPage(StringBuilder out, Function function, int start, int limit) throws Exception {
		StringBuilder rows = new StringBuilder();
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		int visits = 0;
		int total = 0;
		boolean first = true;
		for (Instruction instruction : currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true)) {
			monitor.checkCancelled();
			if (++visits > MAX_BODY_INSTRUCTIONS) {
				throw new IllegalStateException("TooManyRows");
			}
			Address at = instruction.getAddress();
			int length = instruction.getLength();
			if (at.compareTo(entry) < 0 || length < 1 || length > 16
					|| length > span(function) - at.subtract(entry) || uniqueExportFileOffset(at, length) < 0) {
				continue;
			}
			if (total >= start && total - start < limit) {
				rows.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"index\":").append(total)
					.append(",\"address\":").append(at.getOffset()).append(",\"length\":").append(length)
					.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(at))
					.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
					.append(",\"text\":").append(quote(instruction.toString())).append("}");
				first = false;
			}
			total++;
		}
		out.append("{\"start\":").append(Math.min(start, total)).append(",\"rows\":[").append(rows)
			.append("],\"total\":").append(total).append(",\"overflow\":false}");
	}

	/** Every byte must have exactly one executable, contiguous file mapping; identical to prepare's rule. */
	private long uniqueExportFileOffset(Address at, int length) {
		MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(at);
		long offset = fileOffset(at);
		if (block == null || !block.isLoaded() || !block.isExecute() || !block.isInitialized() || offset < 0
				|| blockFileOffset(block) < 0 || blockFileOffset(block) + at.subtract(block.getStart()) != offset
				|| block.getEnd().subtract(at) < length - 1L) {
			return -1;
		}
		for (int index = 0; index < length; index++) {
			Address address = at.add(index);
			List<Address> mapped = memory.locateAddressesForFileOffset(offset + index);
			if (fileOffset(address) != offset + index || mapped == null || mapped.size() != 1 || !address.equals(mapped.get(0))) {
				return -1;
			}
		}
		return offset;
	}

	/** One complete C result, at most 40 seconds and 1,048,576 Unicode scalars; never clipped.
	 * Python's printable_text is authoritative for normalization, including its Unicode category version. */
	private String exportDecompiled(Function function) throws Exception {
		DecompInterface decompiler = new DecompInterface();
		try {
			decompiler.setOptions(new DecompileOptions());
			if (!decompiler.openProgram(currentProgram)) {
				return null;
			}
			DecompileResults result = decompiler.decompileFunction(function, 40, monitor);
			if (result == null || !result.decompileCompleted() || result.getDecompiledFunction() == null) {
				return null;
			}
			String raw = result.getDecompiledFunction().getC();
			if (raw == null) {
				return null;
			}
			if (raw.codePointCount(0, raw.length()) > MAX_EXPORT_TEXT) {
				throw new IllegalStateException("PseudocodeTooLarge");
			}
			return raw;
		}
		finally {
			decompiler.dispose();
		}
	}

	/** xrefs: <address file offset or -1> <address> <mapped file offset or -1> <its address>: every reference to the
	 * address from an instruction in file-backed executable code. An address without file bytes is rebased like the
	 * mapped pair (Ghidra may load the file at another base). */
	private void xrefs(StringBuilder out, String[] args) throws Exception {
		Address target = located(Long.parseLong(args[2]));
		if (target == null) {
			Address base = located(Long.parseLong(args[4]));
			if (base != null) {
				long address = Long.parseUnsignedLong(args[3]);
				long delta = base.getOffset() - Long.parseUnsignedLong(args[5]);
				try {
					target = base.getAddressSpace().getAddress(address + delta);
				}
				catch (Exception e) {
					target = null;  // outside the address space: no references
				}
			}
		}
		out.append(",\"to\":").append(target == null ? "null" : Long.toString(target.getOffset()))
			.append(",\"xrefs\":");
		if (target == null) {
			out.append("{\"rows\":[],\"overflow\":false}");
		}
		else {
			appendReferencesTo(out, target, false);
		}
	}

	/** The one address a file offset maps to, or null. */
	private Address located(long offset) {
		if (offset < 0) {
			return null;
		}
		List<Address> found = memory.locateAddressesForFileOffset(offset);
		return found != null && found.size() == 1 ? found.get(0) : null;
	}

	/** File-backed, executable, non-external functions in address order. */
	private List<Function> anchoredFunctions() {
		List<Function> found = new ArrayList<>();
		for (Function function : currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctions(true)) {
			Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
			MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(entry);
			if (!function.isExternal() && fileOffset(entry) >= 0 && block != null && block.isExecute() && block.isInitialized()) {
				found.add(function);
			}
		}
		return found;
	}

	/** One function row at its anchor; with edges, its calls and references too. */
	private void appendFunction(StringBuilder out, Function function, int index, boolean edges) throws Exception {
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		long size = span(function);
		out.append("{\"index\":").append(index).append(",\"name\":").append(quote(function.getName()))
			.append(",\"entry\":").append(entry.getOffset())
			.append(",\"size\":").append(size)
			.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(entry))
			.append(",\"anchored\":true")
			.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(hex(entry, memory.getBlock(entry), size)));
		if (edges) {
			out.append(",\"calls\":[");
			boolean more = appendCalls(out, function, MAX_ROWS);  // the query modes count every call (decision m3d-fix-round)
			out.append("],\"calls_overflow\":").append(more).append(",\"refs\":[");
			appendRefs(out, function);
			out.append("]");
		}
		out.append("}");
	}

	/** References to the address from instructions in file-backed executable code (calls only, tail calls included,
	 * when onlyCalls), with Ghidra's flags and the containing function; at most MAX_ROWS, else "overflow". */
	private void appendReferencesTo(StringBuilder out, Address target, boolean onlyCalls) throws Exception {
		out.append("{\"rows\":[");
		boolean first = true;
		int rows = 0;
		ReferenceIterator references = currentProgram.getReferenceManager().getReferencesTo(target);
		while (references.hasNext()) {
			Reference reference = references.next();
			Address at = reference.getFromAddress();
			Instruction instruction = currentProgram.getListing().getInstructionAt(at);
			MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(at);
			if (instruction == null || block == null || !block.isExecute() || !block.isInitialized() || fileOffset(at) < 0) {
				continue;
			}
			RefType type = reference.getReferenceType();
			boolean call = type.isCall() || (type.isFlow() && instruction.getFlowType().isCall());
			if (onlyCalls && !call) {
				continue;
			}
			if (rows == MAX_ROWS) {
				out.append("],\"overflow\":true}");
				return;
			}
			rows++;
			Function from = getFunctionContaining(at);
			out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"address\":").append(at.getOffset())
				.append(",\"length\":").append(instruction.getLength())
				.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(at))
				.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
				.append(",\"to\":").append(target.getOffset())
				.append(",\"from\":").append(from == null ? "null" : Long.toString(from.getEntryPoint().getOffset()))
				.append(",\"from_file_offset\":").append(from == null ? -1 : fileOffset(from.getEntryPoint()))
				.append(",\"call\":").append(call)
				.append(",\"flow\":").append(type.isFlow())
				.append(",\"jump\":").append(type.isJump())
				.append(",\"read\":").append(type.isRead())
				.append(",\"write\":").append(type.isWrite())
				.append(",\"data\":").append(type.isData()).append("}");
			first = false;
		}
		out.append("],\"overflow\":false}");
	}

	/** Instructions start..start+limit-1 of the function, counted from its entry in address order, and the count of
	 * all of them; "overflow" when there are more than MAX_BODY_INSTRUCTIONS (the worker then fails the run). */
	private void appendPage(StringBuilder out, Function function, int start, int limit) throws Exception {
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		out.append("{\"start\":").append(start).append(",\"rows\":[");
		boolean first = true;
		boolean overflow = false;
		int index = 0;
		for (Instruction instruction : currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true)) {
			if (instruction.getAddress().compareTo(entry) < 0) {
				continue;
			}
			if (index == MAX_BODY_INSTRUCTIONS) {
				overflow = true;
				break;
			}
			if (index >= start && index - start < limit) {
				out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"index\":").append(index)
					.append(",\"address\":").append(instruction.getAddress().getOffset())
					.append(",\"length\":").append(instruction.getLength())
					.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(instruction.getAddress()))
					.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
					.append(",\"text\":").append(quote(instruction.toString())).append("}");
				first = false;
			}
			index++;
		}
		out.append("],\"total\":").append(index).append(",\"overflow\":").append(overflow).append("}");
	}

	/** Decompiled C for one function within the deadline (at most 15 s), cut at MAX_TEXT; null when it fails. */
	private String decompiled(DecompInterface decompiler, Function function, long deadline) throws Exception {
		int left = (int) ((deadline - System.currentTimeMillis()) / 1000);
		if (left < 1) {
			return null;
		}
		DecompileResults result = decompiler.decompileFunction(function, Math.min(left, 15), monitor);
		if (result == null || !result.decompileCompleted() || result.getDecompiledFunction() == null) {
			return null;
		}
		String text = result.getDecompiledFunction().getC();
		return text.length() > MAX_TEXT ? text.substring(0, MAX_TEXT) : text;
	}

	/** A query string the worker passed as "x" followed by its UTF-8 bytes in hex. */
	private static String text(String encoded) {
		if (!encoded.startsWith("x") || encoded.length() % 2 != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("ReverseAIQuery text argument");
		}
		byte[] bytes = new byte[(encoded.length() - 1) / 2];
		for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
			bytes[i] = (byte) Integer.parseInt(encoded.substring(1 + 2 * i, 3 + 2 * i), 16);
		}
		return new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
	}

	/** One row per call instruction of the function with a memory target, at most cap rows; true when there are more. */
	private boolean appendCalls(StringBuilder out, Function function, int cap) throws Exception {
		boolean first = true;
		int calls = 0;
		for (Instruction instruction : currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true)) {
			if (!instruction.getFlowType().isCall()) {
				continue;
			}
			Address target = null;
			for (Address flow : instruction.getFlows()) {
				if (flow.isMemoryAddress()) {
					target = flow;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (target == null) {
				for (Reference reference : instruction.getReferencesFrom()) {
					if (reference.getToAddress().isMemoryAddress()) {
						target = reference.getToAddress();
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (target == null) {
				continue;
			}
			if (calls == cap) {
				return true;
			}
			calls++;
			out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"address\":").append(instruction.getAddress().getOffset())
				.append(",\"length\":").append(instruction.getLength())
				.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(instruction.getAddress()))
				.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
				.append(",\"to\":").append(target.getOffset())
				.append(",\"to_file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(target))
				.append(",\"to_name\":").append(quote(nameAt(target))).append("}");
			first = false;
		}
		return false;
	}

	/** Every non-call memory reference from the function's instructions, with Ghidra's reference-type flags. */
	private void appendRefs(StringBuilder out, Function function) throws Exception {
		boolean first = true;
		int refs = 0;
		for (Instruction instruction : currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true)) {
			for (Reference reference : instruction.getReferencesFrom()) {
				Address target = reference.getToAddress();
				RefType type = reference.getReferenceType();
				if (refs == MAX_REFS_PER_FUNCTION || !target.isMemoryAddress() || type.isCall()) {
					continue;
				}
				refs++;
				out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"address\":").append(instruction.getAddress().getOffset())
					.append(",\"length\":").append(instruction.getLength())
					.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(instruction.getAddress()))
					.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
					.append(",\"to\":").append(target.getOffset())
					.append(",\"to_file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(target))
					.append(",\"to_name\":").append(quote(nameAt(target)))
					.append(",\"type\":").append(quote(type.getName()))
					.append(",\"flow\":").append(type.isFlow())
					.append(",\"jump\":").append(type.isJump())
					.append(",\"read\":").append(type.isRead())
					.append(",\"write\":").append(type.isWrite())
					.append(",\"data\":").append(type.isData())
					.append(",\"inside\":").append(function.getBody().contains(target)).append("}");
				first = false;
			}
		}
	}

	/** The function's instructions from its entry in address order, at most maxInstructions, and how many it has. */
	private void appendInstructions(StringBuilder out, Function function, int maxInstructions) throws Exception {
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		out.append("{\"entry\":").append(entry.getOffset()).append(",\"instructions\":[");
		boolean first = true;
		int listed = 0;
		int count = 0;
		for (Instruction instruction : currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true)) {
			if (count == MAX_BODY_INSTRUCTIONS) {
				break;
			}
			count++;
			if (listed == maxInstructions || instruction.getAddress().compareTo(entry) < 0) {
				continue;
			}
			listed++;
			out.append(first ? "" : ",").append("{\"address\":").append(instruction.getAddress().getOffset())
				.append(",\"length\":").append(instruction.getLength())
				.append(",\"file_offset\":").append(fileOffset(instruction.getAddress()))
				.append(",\"bytes\":").append(quote(toHex(instruction.getBytes())))
				.append(",\"text\":").append(quote(instruction.toString())).append("}");
			first = false;
		}
		out.append("],\"count\":").append(count).append("}");
	}

	/** Entry to the last byte of the body: a body with gaps keeps the calls in its later ranges. */
	private static long span(Function function) {
		Address entry = function.getEntryPoint();
		Address last = function.getBody().getMaxAddress();
		return last == null || last.compareTo(entry) < 0 ? 1 : last.subtract(entry) + 1;
	}

	private String nameAt(Address address) {
		Function function = getFunctionAt(address);
		if (function != null) {
			return function.getName();
		}
		Symbol symbol = currentProgram.getSymbolTable().getPrimarySymbol(address);
		return symbol == null ? "" : symbol.getName();
	}

	private long fileOffset(Address address) {
		AddressSourceInfo info = memory.getAddressSourceInfo(address);
		return info == null ? -1 : info.getFileOffset();
	}

	private long blockFileOffset(MemoryBlock block) {
		List<MemoryBlockSourceInfo> sources = block.getSourceInfos();
		if (sources.size() != 1 || sources.get(0).getFileBytes().isEmpty() || sources.get(0).getLength() != block.getSize()) {
			return -1;
		}
		return sources.get(0).getFileBytesOffset();
	}

	private String hex(Address entry, MemoryBlock block, long size) throws Exception {
		if (block == null || !block.isInitialized()) {
			return "";
		}
		long left = block.getEnd().subtract(entry) + 1;
		byte[] bytes = new byte[(int) Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.min(size, MAX_LOCATION), left))];
		memory.getBytes(entry, bytes);
		return toHex(bytes);
	}

	private static String toHex(byte[] bytes) {
		StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder(bytes.length * 2);
		for (byte value : bytes) {
			text.append(String.format("%02x", value & 0xff));
		}
		return text.toString();
	}

	private static String quote(String value) {
		StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("\"");
		for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
			char c = value.charAt(i);
			if (c == '"' || c == '\\') {
				text.append('\\').append(c);
			}
			else if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7e) {
				text.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
			}
			else {
				text.append(c);
			}
		}
		return text.append('"').toString();
	}
}
```

`containers/ghidra/project_cache.py`:

```py
"""Opaque Ghidra project packaging and bounded restore, used only inside the worker."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import struct
import tarfile

MAX_TAR_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_FILES = 4096
MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES = 128 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_ROW_BYTES = 4096
MAX_METADATA_BYTES = 4096
FORMAT = 1
TABLES = ("functions", "calls", "references", "strings")
TABLE_FILES = frozenset({"cache/tables/meta.json", *(f"cache/tables/{name}.{suffix}"
                         for name in TABLES for suffix in ("jsonl", "idx"))})
_COMPONENT = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.~+-]{1,64}\Z")
_HEX = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")


class InvalidCachedProject(ValueError):
    pass


class ProjectTooLarge(InvalidCachedProject):
    pass


def _need(condition):
    if not condition:
        raise InvalidCachedProject("InvalidCachedProject")


def _name(raw, directory):
    _need(isinstance(raw, str) and raw.isascii() and len(raw) <= 240)
    name = raw[:-1] if directory and raw.endswith("/") else raw
    parts = name.split("/")
    _need(len(parts) <= 16 and all(part not in (".", "..") and _COMPONENT.fullmatch(part) for part in parts))
    allowed = (name in ("cache", "cache/project", "cache/tables") and directory
               or name == "cache/project/reverseai.rep" and directory
               or name.startswith("cache/project/reverseai.rep/")
               or name == "cache/project/reverseai.gpr" and not directory
               or name in TABLE_FILES and not directory)
    _need(allowed)
    return name


def _field(raw):
    head, _, tail = raw.partition(b"\0")
    _need(not tail.strip(b"\0"))
    try:
        return head.decode("ascii")
    except UnicodeError:
        raise InvalidCachedProject("InvalidCachedProject") from None


def _octal(raw, optional=False):
    value = raw.strip(b"\0 ")
    if not value and optional:
        return 0
    _need(bool(value) and all(48 <= char <= 55 for char in value))
    return int(value, 8)


def _read_exact(source, size):
    data = source.read(size)
    _need(len(data) == size)
    return data


def inventory(source):
    """Validate every header and span before writing any archive member."""
    source.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
    length = source.tell()
    if length > MAX_TAR_BYTES:
        raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
    _need(length >= 1024 and length % 512 == 0)
    source.seek(0)
    rows, names, folded, total = [], {}, {}, 0
    while source.tell() < length:
        header = _read_exact(source, 512)
        if header == b"\0" * 512:
            _need(_read_exact(source, 512) == b"\0" * 512)
            while block := source.read(65536):
                _need(not block.strip(b"\0"))
            required = {"cache/project/reverseai.gpr", "cache/project/reverseai.rep", *TABLE_FILES}
            _need(required <= names.keys())
            return rows
        if len(rows) >= MAX_FILES:
            raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
        _need(header[257:263] == b"ustar\0" and header[263:265] == b"00")
        expected = _octal(header[148:156])
        _need(sum(header[:148]) + 8 * 32 + sum(header[156:]) == expected)
        kind = header[156:157]
        _need(kind in (b"0", b"\0", b"5") and not header[157:257].strip(b"\0"))
        directory = kind == b"5"
        prefix, leaf = _field(header[345:500]), _field(header[:100])
        name = _name((prefix + "/" if prefix else "") + leaf, directory)
        size = _octal(header[124:136])
        mode = _octal(header[100:108])
        for field in (header[108:116], header[116:124], header[136:148], header[329:337], header[337:345]):
            _octal(field, optional=True)
        _need(not mode & 0o7000 and (not directory or size == 0))
        _need(name not in names)
        components = name.split("/")
        for end in range(1, len(components) + 1):
            component_path = "/".join(components[:end])
            _need(folded.get(component_path.casefold(), component_path) == component_path)
            folded[component_path.casefold()] = component_path
        for parent in Path(name).parents:
            _need(str(parent) not in names or names[str(parent)])
        if not directory:
            _need(not any(previous.startswith(name + "/") for previous in names))
        names[name] = directory
        total += size
        if total > MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES:
            raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
        offset = source.tell()
        after = offset + ((size + 511) // 512) * 512
        _need(after <= length)
        rows.append((name, offset, size, directory))
        source.seek(offset + size)
        _need(not _read_exact(source, after - offset - size).strip(b"\0"))
        source.seek(after)
    raise InvalidCachedProject("InvalidCachedProject")


def _hash(source):
    source.seek(0)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    while chunk := source.read(65536):
        digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def unpack_project(source, expected_sha256, fresh_root):
    _need(isinstance(expected_sha256, str) and _HEX.fullmatch(expected_sha256))
    rows = inventory(source)
    _need(_hash(source) == expected_sha256)
    root = Path(fresh_root)
    root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for name, offset, size, directory in rows:
        target = root / name
        target.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if directory:
            target.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
            continue
        source.seek(offset)
        descriptor = os.open(target, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as destination:
            left = size
            while left:
                chunk = _read_exact(source, min(left, 65536))
                destination.write(chunk)
                left -= len(chunk)
    return root / "cache"


class _BoundedSink:
    def __init__(self, sink):
        self.sink, self.size, self.digest = sink, 0, hashlib.sha256()

    def write(self, data):
        if self.size + len(data) > MAX_TAR_BYTES:
            raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
        left = memoryview(data)
        while left:
            written = self.sink.write(left)
            _need(type(written) is int and 0 < written <= len(left))
            self.digest.update(left[:written])
            self.size += written
            left = left[written:]
        return len(data)


def pack_project(work_root, sink):
    root, pending, rows, total = Path(work_root), [Path("cache")], [], 0
    while pending:
        relative = pending.pop()
        info = (root / relative).lstat()
        directory = stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)
        _need(directory or stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode))
        _name(relative.as_posix(), directory)
        total += 0 if directory else info.st_size
        rows.append((relative, info, directory))
        if len(rows) > MAX_FILES or total > MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES:
            raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
        if directory:
            for child in (root / relative).iterdir():
                pending.append(relative / child.name)
                if len(rows) + len(pending) > MAX_FILES:
                    raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
    _need({"cache/project/reverseai.gpr", "cache/project/reverseai.rep", *TABLE_FILES}
          <= {relative.as_posix() for relative, _, _ in rows})
    bounded = _BoundedSink(sink)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=bounded, mode="w|", format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as archive:
        for relative, info, directory in sorted(rows):
            member = tarfile.TarInfo(relative.as_posix())
            member.type, member.mode = (tarfile.DIRTYPE, 0o700) if directory else (tarfile.REGTYPE, 0o600)
            member.size = 0 if directory else info.st_size
            if directory:
                archive.addfile(member)
            else:
                descriptor = os.open(root / relative, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
                with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as source:
                    current = os.fstat(source.fileno())
                    _need(stat.S_ISREG(current.st_mode) and current.st_size == info.st_size
                          and current.st_ino == info.st_ino and current.st_dev == info.st_dev)
                    archive.addfile(member, source)
    return bounded.size, bounded.digest.hexdigest()


CAPS = {"functions": 65536, "calls": 262144, "references": 262144, "strings": 65536}


def _json(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        _need(len({key for key, _ in items}) == len(items))
        return dict(items)
    try:
        return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                          parse_constant=lambda _: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError()))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError):
        raise InvalidCachedProject("InvalidCachedProject") from None


def canonical(value):
    try:
        return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False,
                          allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
    except (TypeError, ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError):
        raise InvalidCachedProject("InvalidCachedProject") from None


class TableWriter:
    """Append complete bounded rows; offsets always point to the start of one JSON line."""
    def __init__(self, folder, name, *, budget=None):
        _need(name in TABLES)
        self.name, self.count = name, 0
        self.budget = {"bytes": 0} if budget is None else budget
        self.body = open(Path(folder) / (name + ".jsonl"), "xb")
        try:
            self.index = open(Path(folder) / (name + ".idx"), "xb")
        except BaseException:
            self.body.close()
            raise

    def add(self, value):
        raw = canonical(value)
        _need(len(raw) <= MAX_ROW_BYTES and b"\n" not in raw)
        if self.count == CAPS[self.name]:
            raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
        if self.budget["bytes"] + len(raw) + 9 > MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES:
            raise ProjectTooLarge("ProjectTooLarge")
        self.index.write(struct.pack("<Q", self.body.tell()))
        self.body.write(raw + b"\n")
        self.budget["bytes"] += len(raw) + 9
        self.count += 1

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.body.close()
        finally:
            self.index.close()


class TableReader:
    """Validate both span endpoints before seeking; no JSON decoder sees an unbounded row."""
    def __init__(self, folder, name, count):
        _need(name in TABLES and type(count) is int and 0 <= count <= CAPS[name])
        self.count = count
        self.body = open(Path(folder) / (name + ".jsonl"), "rb")
        try:
            self.index = open(Path(folder) / (name + ".idx"), "rb")
            self.size = os.fstat(self.body.fileno()).st_size
            _need(os.fstat(self.index.fileno()).st_size == count * 8
                  and self.size <= count * (MAX_ROW_BYTES + 1)
                  and (count > 0 or self.size == 0))
            if count:
                _need(struct.unpack("<Q", _read_exact(self.index, 8))[0] == 0)
        except BaseException:
            self.body.close()
            if hasattr(self, "index"):
                self.index.close()
            raise

    def row(self, position):
        _need(type(position) is int and 0 <= position < self.count)
        self.index.seek(position * 8)
        offset = struct.unpack("<Q", _read_exact(self.index, 8))[0]
        after = (struct.unpack("<Q", _read_exact(self.index, 8))[0]
                 if position + 1 < self.count else self.size)
        _need(0 <= offset < after <= self.size and 1 < after - offset <= MAX_ROW_BYTES + 1)
        self.body.seek(offset)
        raw = _read_exact(self.body, after - offset)
        _need(raw.endswith(b"\n") and b"\n" not in raw[:-1])
        value = _json(raw)
        _need(canonical(value) + b"\n" == raw)
        return value

    def rows(self):
        for index in range(self.count):
            yield self.row(index)

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.body.close()
        finally:
            self.index.close()
```

`containers/ghidra/unpack.py`:

```py
"""Natives-stage helper: check a pinned download's SHA-256, then unpack the Ghidra zip keeping its exec bits.

    python3 -I -B unpack.py check <file> <sha256>
    python3 -I -B unpack.py ghidra <zip> <sha256> <destination>

Every member must resolve inside the destination: a link, a member whose resolved path leaves it (an absolute
path, or a parent step that climbs out) and a duplicate name are refused; a ".." that stays inside is not. Modes
become 0755 or 0644 (no setuid, setgid or sticky bit).
"""

import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import sys
import zipfile


def check(path, expected):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        while chunk := stream.read(1 << 20):
            digest.update(chunk)
    if digest.hexdigest() != expected:
        raise SystemExit("download does not match its pinned SHA-256")


def unpack(archive, destination):
    root, seen = Path(destination).resolve(), set()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
        for info in bundle.infolist():
            mode = info.external_attr >> 16
            target = (root / info.filename).resolve()
            if stat.S_ISLNK(mode) or root not in target.parents:
                raise SystemExit("unsafe member in the archive")
            if target in seen:
                raise SystemExit("duplicate member in the archive")
            seen.add(target)
            if info.is_dir():
                target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                continue
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with bundle.open(info) as source, open(target, "xb") as out:
                shutil.copyfileobj(source, out)
            os.chmod(target, 0o755 if mode & 0o111 else 0o644)


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "check":
        check(argv[1], argv[2])
    elif len(argv) == 4 and argv[0] == "ghidra":
        check(argv[1], argv[2])
        unpack(argv[1], argv[3])
    else:
        raise SystemExit("usage: unpack.py check FILE SHA256 | ghidra ZIP SHA256 DESTINATION")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

```

`containers/ghidra/worker.py`:

```py
"""ReverseAI Ghidra worker: bounded query JSON, or one raw USTAR prepared artifact, on stdout.

Entrypoint (docs/contract.md, "Contained Ghidra worker (M3a)"):
    python3 -I -B /opt/reverseai/worker.py ghidra.analyze <canonical JSON of validated args>

The worker accepts ELF, PE and thin little-endian Mach-O only and runs one headless Ghidra import of
the snapshot into a project under /tmp, with a fixed loader per format (libraries never loaded), the
reviewed scripts baked into
the image (ReverseAIOptions turns off the analyzers that could look outside the input; ReverseAIQuery
writes functions, calls, other references, pseudocode and instruction listings as JSON), a fixed heap
and timeouts below the 240 s wall limit. Requests choose only the eight bounded counts: never a script,
loader or option.

Ghidra's addresses may be rebased, so every anchor is mapped again here with this file's own
section table (stdlib decoding; only file-mapped bytes count: ELF SHF_ALLOC sections, PE
min(SizeOfRawData, VirtualSize), decision m3a-function-span; Mach-O LC_SEGMENT(_64) sections with
file bytes inside their segment's file range, executable by the segment's initprot or an instruction
attribute, as the host's macho_sections, decision m3b-macho-zerofill): an observation's address is the
file's virtual address of its anchor, and an anchor is kept only inside an executable section. The
entry point that leads the pseudocode is the one the host checks (Mach-O: structure.macho_entry's rule,
decision m3b-macho-entry).
Each anchor is cross-checked: Ghidra's bytes there equal the snapshot's, Ghidra's memory block maps
its address back to the same file offset, and every anchor has the same Ghidra-to-file address
delta; anything else is InconsistentAnchor. What stays Ghidra's reading, reported as derived and
never as verified: names, a function's size (its span from the entry to the last body byte), call
and reference targets, reference types, instruction texts and pseudocode. Observations follow the M3a
seams: functions in address order, pseudocode for the entry-point function and then the largest (cut
to fit the 4,096-byte observation limit, decision m3c-pseudocode-fit), calls from emitted functions
only, inside their span. Then the M3c kinds (decision m3c-contract), each added only while the encoded
reply stays within its limit: instruction listings in the pseudocode order, each instruction's bytes
confirmed; non-call references with their contract type; and the strings the referenced bytes hold,
decoded here from the snapshot by the contract rule. Errors are class names only. Nothing but the
one JSON object is written, to stdout only.
"""

import hashlib
import importlib.util
import contextlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import signal
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

PROTOCOL = "reverseai.worker/1"
ADAPTER_VERSION = "12.1.4-r7"
SNAPSHOT = "/snapshot/input"
MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_REPLY_BYTES = 262_144
MAX_QUERY_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_LOCATION = 4096
MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES = 4096  # an observation value's canonical JSON, as the host's Observation bounds it
MAX_NAME = 128
MAX_INSTRUCTION_TEXT = 64
MAX_STRING_CHARS = 128
MAX_STRING_FROM = 8
ARGS = {"max_functions": (1, 128, 64), "decompile": (0, 16, 8), "max_chars": (64, 2048, 1024), "max_calls": (0, 256, 128),
        "assembly": (0, 8, 4), "max_instructions": (1, 64, 32), "max_refs": (0, 128, 64), "max_strings": (0, 64, 32)}
MAX_ADDRESS = 2**64 - 1
# Every operation's arguments with the host's ArgSpec bounds (decision m3d-contract): ("int", min, max, default),
# ("enum", choices, default) or ("str", default); a None default means required.
OPERATIONS = {
    "ghidra.analyze": {name: ("int", *bounds) for name, bounds in ARGS.items()},
    "ghidra.functions": {"query": ("str", ""), "start": ("int", 0, 65535, 0), "limit": ("int", 1, 128, 64)},
    "ghidra.function": {"select": ("enum", ("entry", "name"), "entry"), "entry": ("int", 0, MAX_ADDRESS, 0), "name": ("str", ""),
                        "parts": ("enum", ("info", "pseudocode", "assembly", "callees", "callers", "all"), "all"),
                        "start": ("int", 0, 65535, 0), "limit": ("int", 1, 256, 64), "max_chars": ("int", 64, 2048, 1024),
                        "max_calls": ("int", 0, 256, 64), "max_refs": ("int", 0, 128, 64)},
    "ghidra.xrefs": {"address": ("int", 0, MAX_ADDRESS, None), "start": ("int", 0, 65535, 0), "limit": ("int", 1, 256, 64)},

    "ghidra.prepare": {},
    "ghidra.pseudocode": {"select": ("enum", ("entry", "name"), "entry"),
                          "entry": ("int", 0, MAX_ADDRESS, 0), "name": ("str", ""),
                          "text_start": ("int", 0, 1048576, 0), "max_chars": ("int", 64, 2048, 1024)},
    "ghidra.export_function": {"select": ("enum", ("entry", "name"), "entry"),
        "entry": ("int", 0, MAX_ADDRESS, 0), "name": ("str", ""),
        "part": ("enum", ("info", "pseudocode", "assembly", "callees", "callers", "references", "strings"), "info"),

})
```
