`reverseai/tools/ghidra_export.py`:

```py
"""Admit prepared export pages against the original image, never the project blob."""

import hashlib
import re

from reverseai import ghidra_args
from reverseai.contract import Location, Observation, canonical_json
from reverseai.tools.ghidra_verify import (
    _SectionIndex, _sections, _check, _uint, _name, _function_anchor,
    _instruction_anchor, _file_map, _map, _string_bytes, _REFERENCE_TYPES,
)

FIELDS = {
    "export_page": {"kind", "scope", "part", "entry", "status", "start", "total", "count", "next_start"},
    "function_export": {"kind", "index", "name", "entry", "size", "signature", "signature_truncated", "library_hint"},
    "instruction_export": {"kind", "index", "from", "from_size", "at", "length", "text"},
    "call_export": {"kind", "index", "from", "from_size", "at", "to", "to_name"},
    "reference_export": {"kind", "index", "from", "from_size", "at", "to", "type", "to_name"},
    "string_export": {"kind", "index", "from", "from_size", "at", "instruction_length", "address", "encoding", "text", "truncated"},
    "function_info": {"kind", "name", "entry", "size", "matches", "signature", "signature_truncated", "library_hint", "totals", "pseudocode_status"},
    "pseudocode_page": {"kind", "entry", "size", "text_sha256", "start", "total", "text", "next_start", "status"},
    "string_reference_anchor": {"kind", "index", "from", "from_size", "at", "address", "instruction_length"},
}
KINDS = {"functions": "function_export", "assembly": "instruction_export", "calls": "call_export",
         "callees": "call_export", "callers": "call_export", "references": "reference_export",
         "strings": "string_export", "info": "function_info", "pseudocode": "pseudocode_page"}
CAPS = {"functions": 65536, "assembly": 1000000, "calls": 262144, "callees": 262144,
        "callers": 262144, "references": 262144, "strings": 65536, "info": 1, "pseudocode": 1048576}
ANALYSIS_ID_BYTES = 81


def _integer(value, maximum):
    return type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= maximum


def _function(value):
    _check(_name(value["name"]) and _uint(value["entry"]) and _uint(value["size"], 1)
           and value["entry"] + value["size"] <= 2**64)
    signature = value["signature"]
    _check(signature is None or isinstance(signature, str) and len(signature) <= 512
           and all(c.isprintable() for c in signature))
    _check(type(value["signature_truncated"]) is bool and value["library_hint"] is None
           and (signature is not None or not value["signature_truncated"]))


def _source(sections, item, value, length):
    _check(_uint(value["from"]) and _uint(value["from_size"], 1)
           and value["from"] + value["from_size"] <= 2**64 and _uint(value["at"]))
    _function_anchor(sections, value["from"], value["from_size"])
    _check(1 <= length <= 16 and value["from"] <= value["at"]
           and value["at"] + length <= value["from"] + value["from_size"])
    offset, _ = _map(sections, value["at"], length, virtual=True)
    reverse, _ = _map(sections, offset, length, virtual=False)
    _check(reverse == value["at"])
    return Location(offset, length)


def _page(value, args, part):
    maximum = CAPS[part]
    _check(all(_integer(value[field], maximum) for field in ("start", "total", "count")))
    request = args.get("text_start", 0) if part == "pseudocode" else args.get("start", 0)
    _check(value["start"] == min(request, value["total"]) and value["start"] + value["count"] <= value["total"])
    more = value["start"] + value["count"] < value["total"]
    _check(value["next_start"] == value["start"] + value["count"] if more else value["next_start"] is None)
    if more:
        _check(type(value["next_start"]) is int and value["count"] > 0)


def admit(data, observations, raw_args, operation):
    args = ghidra_args.check(operation, raw_args)
    scope = "program" if operation == "ghidra.export_program" else "function"
    part = "pseudocode" if operation == "ghidra.pseudocode" else args["part"]
    _check(isinstance(observations, (list, tuple)) and 1 <= len(observations) <= 129)
    for item in observations:
        _check(isinstance(item, Observation) and item.artifact is None and item.location.within(len(data)))
        value = item.value
        _check(value.get("kind") in FIELDS and value["kind"] != "string_reference_anchor"
               and set(value) == FIELDS[value["kind"]]
               and len(canonical_json(value).encode("utf-8")) + ANALYSIS_ID_BYTES <= 4096)
    header = observations[0]
    meta = header.value
    _check(meta["kind"] == "export_page" and header.location == Location(0, min(64, len(data)))
           and meta["scope"] == scope and meta["part"] == part
           and meta["status"] in ("ok", "not_found", "decompile_failed"))
    if scope == "program":
        _check(meta["entry"] is None and meta["status"] == "ok")
    else:
        _check(meta["entry"] is None or _uint(meta["entry"]))
        if meta["entry"] is not None and args["select"] == "entry":
            _check(meta["entry"] == args["entry"])
    if meta["status"] != "ok":
        _check(len(observations) == 1 and all(type(meta[k]) is int and meta[k] == 0 for k in ("start", "total", "count"))
               and meta["next_start"] is None
               and (meta["status"] != "decompile_failed" or part == "pseudocode"))
        return tuple(observations)
    _page(meta, args, part)
    rows = observations[1:]
    _check(all(item.value["kind"] == KINDS[part] for item in rows))
    if part == "pseudocode":
        _check(len(rows) == 1 and meta["entry"] is not None)
        item, value = rows[0], rows[0].value
        _check(_uint(value["entry"]) and value["entry"] == meta["entry"] and _uint(value["size"], 1)
               and value["entry"] + value["size"] <= 2**64)
        _check(item.location == _function_anchor(_SectionIndex(_sections(data)[0]), value["entry"], value["size"]))
        _check(value["status"] == "ok" and all(value[k] == meta[k] for k in ("start", "total", "next_start")))
        _check(all(_integer(value[k], 1048576) for k in ("start", "total")))
        _check(value["next_start"] is None or type(value["next_start"]) is int)
        text = value["text"]
        _check(isinstance(text, str) and len(text) <= args["max_chars"] and len(text) == meta["count"]
               and all(c.isprintable() or c in "\n\t" for c in text)
               and isinstance(value["text_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value["text_sha256"]))
        if value["start"] == 0 and len(text) == value["total"]:
            _check(hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == value["text_sha256"])
        return tuple(observations)
    _check(len(rows) == meta["count"] and len(rows) <= args["limit"])
    _check(part != "info" or len(rows) == 1)
    sections = _SectionIndex(_sections(data)[0])
    if scope == "function":
        _check(meta["entry"] is not None)
        _map(sections, meta["entry"], 1, virtual=True)
    extra, previous, sources, callsites = [], None, {}, set()
    instruction_end = -1
    for number, item in enumerate(rows, meta["start"]):
        value = item.value
        if part != "info":
            _check(type(value["index"]) is int and value["index"] == number)
        if part in ("info", "functions"):
            _function(value)
            _check(item.location == _function_anchor(sections, value["entry"], value["size"]))
            order = value["entry"]
            if part == "info":
                _check(meta["entry"] == value["entry"] and meta["start"] == 0 and meta["total"] == meta["count"] == 1
                       and _integer(value["matches"], 65536) and value["matches"] >= 1
                       and value["pseudocode_status"] == "not_requested"
                       and isinstance(value["totals"], dict)
                       and set(value["totals"]) == {"assembly", "callees", "callers", "references", "strings"}
                       and all(_integer(total, CAPS[name]) for name, total in value["totals"].items()))
                if args["select"] == "entry":
                    _check(value["entry"] == args["entry"] and value["matches"] == 1)
                else:
                    _check(value["name"] == args["name"])
        else:
            _check(_uint(value["at"]) and _uint(value["from"]) and _uint(value["from_size"], 1))
            _check(sources.setdefault(value["from"], value["from_size"]) == value["from_size"])
            if part == "strings":
                _check(type(value["instruction_length"]) is int)
                source = _source(sections, item, value, value["instruction_length"])
                _check(value["encoding"] in ("ascii", "utf-16le") and type(value["truncated"]) is bool
                       and isinstance(value["text"], str) and 2 <= len(value["text"]) <= 128
                       and all(" " <= c <= "~" for c in value["text"]) and _uint(value["address"]))
                width = 1 if value["encoding"] == "ascii" else 2
                _check(item.location.length == width * len(value["text"]))
                address, section = _file_map(sections, item.location.offset, item.location.length + width, virtual=False)
                _check(address == value["address"])
                offset, _ = _file_map(sections, address, item.location.length + width, virtual=True)
                _check(offset == item.location.offset)
                _check(_string_bytes(data, offset, section.offset + section.size)
                       == (value["encoding"], value["text"], value["truncated"]))
                extra.append(Observation(source, {"kind": "string_reference_anchor", **{
                    key: value[key] for key in ("index", "from", "from_size", "at", "address", "instruction_length")}}))
                order = (value["from"], value["at"], value["address"], value["encoding"])
            else:
                _check(item.location == _source(sections, item, value, item.location.length)
                       and _instruction_anchor(sections, item) == value["at"])
                if part == "assembly":
                    _check(type(value["length"]) is int and value["length"] == item.location.length
                           and value["at"] >= instruction_end
                           and isinstance(value["text"], str) and 1 <= len(value["text"]) <= 64
                           and all(" " <= c <= "~" for c in value["text"]))
                    order = value["at"]
                    instruction_end = value["at"] + value["length"]
                else:
                    _check(_uint(value["to"]) and _name(value["to_name"]))
                    order = (value["from"], value["at"], value["to"])
                    if part == "references":
                        _check(value["type"] in _REFERENCE_TYPES)
                        order += (value["type"],)
                    else:
                        site = (value["from"], value["at"])
                        _check(site not in callsites)
                        callsites.add(site)
            if scope == "function":
                _check(meta["entry"] is not None)
                _check(value["to"] == meta["entry"] if part == "callers" else value["from"] == meta["entry"])
        _check(previous is None or order > previous)
        previous = order
    _check(scope != "function" or meta["entry"] is not None)
    return (*observations, *extra)

```

`reverseai/tools/ghidra_tool.py`:

```py
"""Derived Ghidra analysis through the contained worker; the host verifies its anchors."""

from reverseai.contained import ContainedError, DockerExecutor, default_lock, inspect_image, load_lock
from reverseai.contract import ArgSpec, ContractError, OperationSpec, ToolRef, ToolSpec, WorkerError, parse_worker_reply, sha256_hex
from reverseai.tools import ghidra_verify
from reverseai import ghidra_args, ghidra_cache
from reverseai.contract import Observation

REF = ToolRef("ghidra", "12.1.4-r7")
DEFAULT_LOCK = default_lock("ghidra")


def make_tool(executor=None, *, store=None):
    if executor is None:
        executor = DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK, adapter_version=REF.version)
        if store is None:
            store = ghidra_cache.CacheStore()
    lock = load_lock(executor.lock, adapter_version=REF.version)

    def invoke(operation, data, args):
        spec = operations[operation]
        checked = spec.validate_args(args)
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        exported = operation in ghidra_args.OPERATIONS
        if exported:
            checked = ghidra_args.check(operation, checked)
        project = None
        if store is not None:
            try:
                project = store.lookup(ghidra_cache.identity(digest, lock))
            except ghidra_cache.CacheError:
                if exported:
                    raise
        if exported and project is None:
            raise ghidra_cache.CacheError(ghidra_cache.MISSING)
        try:
            raw = (executor.run(operation, checked, data, digest, project=project) if project is not None
                   else executor.run(operation, checked, data, digest))
            source_id = None if project is None else project.analysis_id
        finally:
            if project is not None:
                project.close()
        try:
            observations = parse_worker_reply(raw, input_sha256=digest,
                                              max_observations=129 if exported else spec.max_observations)
        except WorkerError:
            raise
        except (ContractError, UnicodeError):
            raise ContractError(ghidra_verify.REFUSED) from None
        if exported:
            admitted = ghidra_verify.verify(data, observations, checked, operation=operation)
            return tuple(Observation(item.location, {**item.value, "analysis_id": source_id}) for item in admitted)
        if operation == "ghidra.analyze":
            ghidra_verify.verify(data, observations, checked)
        else:
            ghidra_verify.verify(data, observations, checked, operation=operation)
        return observations

    def operation(name, args, max_observations):
        return OperationSpec(name, args, lambda data, checked: invoke(name, data, checked),
                             max_observations=max_observations, derived=True)

    operations = {
        "ghidra.analyze": operation("ghidra.analyze", {
            "max_functions": ArgSpec("int", 1, 128, default=64),
            "decompile": ArgSpec("int", 0, 16, default=8),
            "max_chars": ArgSpec("int", 64, 2048, default=1024),
            "max_calls": ArgSpec("int", 0, 256, default=128),
            "assembly": ArgSpec("int", 0, 8, default=4),
            "max_instructions": ArgSpec("int", 1, 64, default=32),
            "max_refs": ArgSpec("int", 0, 128, default=64),
            "max_strings": ArgSpec("int", 0, 64, default=32),
        }, 600),
        "ghidra.functions": operation("ghidra.functions", {
            "query": ArgSpec("str", default=""),
            "start": ArgSpec("int", 0, 65535, default=0),
            "limit": ArgSpec("int", 1, 128, default=64),
        }, 128),
        "ghidra.function": operation("ghidra.function", {
            "select": ArgSpec("enum", choices=("entry", "name"), default="entry"),
            "entry": ArgSpec("int", 0, 2 ** 64 - 1, default=0),
            "name": ArgSpec("str", default=""),
            "parts": ArgSpec("enum", choices=("info", "pseudocode", "assembly", "callees", "callers", "all"), default="all"),
            "start": ArgSpec("int", 0, 65535, default=0),
            "limit": ArgSpec("int", 1, 256, default=64),
            "max_chars": ArgSpec("int", 64, 2048, default=1024),
            "max_calls": ArgSpec("int", 0, 256, default=64),
            "max_refs": ArgSpec("int", 0, 128, default=64),
        }, 643),
        "ghidra.xrefs": operation("ghidra.xrefs", {
            "address": ArgSpec("int", 0, 2 ** 64 - 1),
            "start": ArgSpec("int", 0, 65535, default=0),
            "limit": ArgSpec("int", 1, 256, default=64),
        }, 256),
    }
    for name, args in ghidra_args.OPERATIONS.items():
        operations[name] = operation(name, args, 257)
    return ToolSpec(REF, operations, contained=True,
                    runtime={"image": lock["image_id"], "platform": lock["platform"]})


def prepare(data, *, executor=None, store=None):
    """Explicit trusted controller operation; a project is storage, never evidence."""
    executor = executor if executor is not None else DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK, adapter_version=REF.version)
    store = store if store is not None else ghidra_cache.CacheStore()
    lock = load_lock(executor.lock, adapter_version=REF.version)
    digest = sha256_hex(data)
    manifest, source_id, state, seconds = store.prepare(ghidra_cache.identity(digest, lock),
                                                        lambda sink: executor.prepare(data, digest, sink))
    return {"schema": "reverseai.prepare/1", "input": {"sha256": digest, "size": len(data)},
            "analysis_id": source_id, "state": state,
            "runtime": {"image": lock["image_id"], "platform": lock["platform"], "bundle_sha256": lock["bundle_sha256"]},
            "cache_format": 1, "artifact_size": manifest["size"], "elapsed_seconds": seconds}


def available(lock=None, *, inspect=None):
    try:
        executor = DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK if lock is None else lock, adapter_version=REF.version,
                                  inspect=inspect_image if inspect is None else inspect)
        return executor.available()
    except ContainedError:
        return False


def __getattr__(name):
    if name == "TOOL":
        return make_tool()
    raise AttributeError(name)

```

`reverseai/tools/ghidra_verify.py`:

```py
"""Re-derive Ghidra byte anchors and referenced strings, not code semantics."""

from array import array
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
from collections import namedtuple
import struct

from reverseai.contract import ContractError, Location, Observation
from reverseai.tools import structure
from reverseai.tools.structure import (
    SHF_EXECINSTR, SCN_MEM_EXECUTE, _elf_layout, _format, _need, _pe_layout,
)

REFUSED = "Worker code anchor not confirmed by the bytes"
SHF_ALLOC = 0x2
_Section = namedtuple("_Section", "va offset size span executable")
_FIELDS = {
    "function": {"kind", "index", "name", "entry", "size"},
    "pseudocode": {"kind", "index", "entry", "text", "truncated"},
    "call": {"kind", "from", "to", "to_name"},
    "assembly": {"kind", "index", "entry", "instructions", "truncated"},
    "ref": {"kind", "from", "to", "type", "to_name"},
    "string": {"kind", "address", "encoding", "text", "truncated", "from"},
}


def _check(condition):
    if not condition:
        raise ContractError(REFUSED)


def _uint(value, minimum=0):
    return type(value) is int and minimum <= value < 2**64


def _name(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= 128 and all(char.isprintable() for char in value)


def _sections(data):
    kind, pe, _ = _format(data)
    sections = []
    if kind == "macho":
        _check(data[:4] in (b"\xce\xfa\xed\xfe", b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe"))
        mapped = structure.macho_sections(data)
        _check(bool(mapped))
        width = 64 if data[:4] == b"\xcf\xfa\xed\xfe" else 32
        _check(all(row["addr"] + row["size"] <= 2**width for row in mapped))
        sections = [_Section(row["addr"], row["offset"], row["size"], row["size"], row["executable"])
                    for row in mapped]
        return sections, structure.macho_entry(data)
    if kind == "elf":
        width, order, _, header = _elf_layout(data)
        entry, layout = (40, "IIIIIIIIII") if width == 32 else (64, "IIQQQQIIQQ")
        if header["shnum"] == header["shoff"] == 0:
            return sections, header["entry"]
        _check(header["shentsize"] == entry and header["shoff"] > 0)
        count = header["shnum"]
        if count == 0:
            _need(data, header["shoff"], entry, "ELF section header zero")
            count = struct.unpack_from(order + layout, data, header["shoff"])[5]
        _need(data, header["shoff"], count * entry, "ELF section table")
        for index in range(count):
            _, kind, flags, va, offset, size = struct.unpack_from(order + layout, data, header["shoff"] + index * entry)[:6]
            backed = size if kind not in (0, 8) else 0
            if backed:
                _need(data, offset, backed, "ELF section contents")
            if flags & SHF_ALLOC:
                _check(va + size <= 2**width)
                sections.append(_Section(va, offset, backed, size if kind else 0, bool(flags & SHF_EXECINSTR)))
        return sections, header["entry"]
    _check(kind == "pe")
    header = _pe_layout(data, pe)
    optional = header["optional"]
    _check(header["magic"] in (0x10B, 0x20B) and header["optional_size"] >= 32)
    _need(data, optional, header["optional_size"], "PE optional header")
    base = struct.unpack_from("<Q" if header["magic"] == 0x20B else "<I", data,
                              optional + (24 if header["magic"] == 0x20B else 28))[0]
    width = 64 if header["magic"] == 0x20B else 32
    _check(base + header["entry"] < 2**width)
    table = optional + header["optional_size"]
    _need(data, table, header["sections"] * 40, "PE section table")
    for index in range(header["sections"]):
        at = table + index * 40
        _, virtual_size, rva, size, offset = struct.unpack_from("<8sIIII", data, at)
        flags = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, at + 36)[0]
        span = max(size, virtual_size)
        _check(rva + span <= 2**32 and base + rva + span <= 2**width)
        if size:
            _need(data, offset, size, "PE section contents")
        backed = min(size, virtual_size or size)
        sections.append(_Section(base + rva, offset, backed, backed, bool(flags & SCN_MEM_EXECUTE)))
    return sections, base + header["entry"]


class _Intervals:
    """Count overlaps in O(log n), including aliases away from the query's start."""

    def __init__(self, sections, *, virtual, backed=False):
        self.sections = sections
        bounds = ((section.va if virtual else section.offset,
                   section.size if backed or not virtual else section.span, index)
                  for index, section in enumerate(sections))
        self.starts, self.start_ids = self._prefix(sorted((start, index) for start, length, index in bounds if length))
        bounds = ((section.va if virtual else section.offset,
                   section.size if backed or not virtual else section.span, index)
                  for index, section in enumerate(sections))
        self.ends, self.end_ids = self._prefix(sorted((start + length, index) for start, length, index in bounds if length))

    @staticmethod
    def _prefix(rows):
        points, ids = [], array("Q", [0])
        for point, index in rows:
            points.append(point)
            ids.append(ids[-1] ^ index)
        return points, ids

    def single(self, start, length):
        _check(length > 0)
        began = bisect_left(self.starts, start + length)
        ended = bisect_right(self.ends, start)
        _check(began - ended == 1)
        # Ended intervals are a subset of started ones; their IDs cancel in the XOR.
        return self.sections[self.start_ids[began] ^ self.end_ids[ended]]


class _SectionIndex:
    def __init__(self, sections):
        self.virtual = _Intervals(sections, virtual=True)
        self.file = _Intervals(sections, virtual=False)
        self.backed_virtual = (self.virtual if all(section.span == section.size for section in sections)
                               else _Intervals(sections, virtual=True, backed=True))


def _map(sections, start, length, *, virtual):
    section = (sections.virtual if virtual else sections.file).single(start, length)
    delta = start - (section.va if virtual else section.offset)
    _check(section.executable and 0 <= delta and delta + length <= section.size)
    return (section.offset if virtual else section.va) + delta, section


def _function_anchor(sections, entry, size):
    offset, section = _map(sections, entry, 1, virtual=True)
    length = min(size, 4096, section.size - (entry - section.va))
    _map(sections, entry, length, virtual=True)
    _map(sections, offset, length, virtual=False)
    return Location(offset, length)


def _file_map(sections, start, length, *, virtual):
    """String mapping admits only file-backed bytes, independent of execute permission."""
    section = (sections.backed_virtual if virtual else sections.file).single(start, length)
    delta = start - (section.va if virtual else section.offset)
    _check(0 <= delta and delta + length <= section.size)
    return (section.offset if virtual else section.va) + delta, section


def _string_bytes(data, offset, end):
    for encoding, width in (("ascii", 1), ("utf-16le", 2)):
        chars = []
        while len(chars) < 128 and offset + (len(chars) + 1) * width <= end:
            unit = data[offset + len(chars) * width:offset + (len(chars) + 1) * width]
            if not 0x20 <= unit[0] <= 0x7e or (width == 2 and unit[1] != 0):
                break
            chars.append(chr(unit[0]))
        following = data[offset + len(chars) * width:min(end, offset + (len(chars) + 1) * width)]
        truncated = (len(chars) == 128 and len(following) == width
                     and 0x20 <= following[0] <= 0x7e and (width == 1 or following[1] == 0))
        if len(chars) >= 2 and (truncated or following == bytes(width)):
            return encoding, "".join(chars), truncated
    raise ContractError(REFUSED)


def verify(data, observations, args, operation="ghidra.analyze"):
    """Validate the whole reply before admitting any derived observation."""
    try:
        if operation in ("ghidra.pseudocode", "ghidra.export_function", "ghidra.export_program"):
            from reverseai.tools.ghidra_export import admit
            return admit(data, observations, args, operation)
        if operation == "ghidra.analyze":
            _verify(data, observations, args)
        else:
            _verify_query(data, observations, args, operation)
    except (ContractError, struct.error, TypeError, KeyError, ValueError, IndexError):
        raise ContractError(REFUSED) from None


def _verify(data, observations, args):
    args = {"assembly": 4, "max_instructions": 32, "max_refs": 64, "max_strings": 32, **args}
    _check(isinstance(data, bytes) and isinstance(observations, (list, tuple)) and len(observations) <= 600)
    decoded, binary_entry = _sections(data)
    sections = _SectionIndex(decoded)
    groups = {kind: [] for kind in _FIELDS}
    order = {kind: index for index, kind in enumerate(_FIELDS)}
    previous_kind = 0
    for item in observations:
        _check(isinstance(item, Observation) and item.location.within(len(data)))
        value = item.value
        kind = value.get("kind")
        _check(isinstance(kind, str) and kind in _FIELDS and set(value) == _FIELDS[kind])
        _check(order[kind] >= previous_kind)
        previous_kind = order[kind]
        functions = groups["function"]
        if kind == "function":
            _check(type(value["index"]) is int and value["index"] == len(functions) and _name(value["name"]))
            _check(_uint(value["entry"]) and _uint(value["size"], 1) and value["entry"] + value["size"] <= 2**64)
            _check(not functions or value["entry"] > functions[-1].value["entry"])
            _check(item.location == _function_anchor(sections, value["entry"], value["size"]))
        elif kind in ("pseudocode", "assembly"):
            _check(type(value["index"]) is int and _uint(value["entry"]) and type(value["truncated"]) is bool)
            if kind == "pseudocode":
                _check(isinstance(value["text"], str) and len(value["text"]) <= args["max_chars"])
            else:
                _check(isinstance(value["instructions"], list) and 1 <= len(value["instructions"]) <= args["max_instructions"])
                end = 0
                for row in value["instructions"]:
                    _check(isinstance(row, list) and len(row) == 3)
                    delta, length, text = row
                    _check(_uint(delta) and type(length) is int and 1 <= length <= 16
                           and end <= delta and delta + length <= item.location.length)
                    _check(isinstance(text, str) and 1 <= len(text) <= 64 and all(0x20 <= ord(c) <= 0x7e for c in text))
                    end = delta + length
        elif kind in ("call", "ref"):
            _check(_uint(value["from"]) and _uint(value["to"]) and _name(value["to_name"]))
            _check(1 <= item.location.length <= 16)
            if kind == "ref":
                _check(value["type"] in ("read", "write", "read_write", "data", "jump"))
        else:
            _check(_uint(value["address"]) and type(value["truncated"]) is bool)
            _check(isinstance(value["from"], list) and 1 <= len(value["from"]) <= 8
                   and all(_uint(entry) for entry in value["from"]))
        groups[kind].append(item)
    for kind, limit in (("function", "max_functions"), ("pseudocode", "decompile"), ("call", "max_calls"),
                        ("assembly", "assembly"), ("ref", "max_refs"), ("string", "max_strings")):
        _check(len(groups[kind]) <= args[limit])
    functions = groups["function"]
    by_entry = {item.value["entry"]: item for item in functions}
    selection = sorted(functions, key=lambda item: (item.value["entry"] != binary_entry,
                                                   -item.value["size"], item.value["entry"]))
    ranks = {item.value["index"]: index for index, item in enumerate(selection)}
    for kind in ("pseudocode", "assembly"):
        previous = -1
        for item in groups[kind]:
            value = item.value
            _check(0 <= value["index"] < len(functions))
            function = functions[value["index"]]
            _check(value["entry"] == function.value["entry"] and item.location == function.location)
            _check(ranks[value["index"]] > previous)
            previous = ranks[value["index"]]
    for item in groups["call"] + groups["ref"]:
        value = item.value
        _check(value["from"] in by_entry)
        function = by_entry[value["from"]].value
        va, _ = _map(sections, item.location.offset, item.location.length, virtual=False)
        _map(sections, va, item.location.length, virtual=True)
        _check(value["from"] <= va and va + item.location.length <= value["from"] + function["size"])
    previous = None
    origins = {}
    for item in groups["ref"]:
        value = item.value
        key = (item.location.offset, value["to"], value["type"])
        _check(previous is None or key > previous)
        previous = key
        origins.setdefault(value["to"], set()).add(value["from"])
    previous = -1
    for item in groups["string"]:
        value = item.value
        address = value["address"]
        _check(address > previous and address in origins)
        previous = address
        _check(value["from"] == sorted(origins[address])[:8])
        offset, section = _file_map(sections, address, 1, virtual=True)
        encoding, text, truncated = _string_bytes(data, offset, section.offset + section.size)
        _check((value["encoding"], value["text"], value["truncated"]) == (encoding, text, truncated))
        length = len(text.encode(encoding))
        _check(item.location == Location(offset, length))
        checked_length = length + (1 if encoding == "ascii" else 2)
        _file_map(sections, address, checked_length, virtual=True)
        _file_map(sections, offset, checked_length, virtual=False)


_QUERY_FIELDS = {
    "function_row": {"kind", "index", "total", "name", "entry", "size"},
    "target": {"kind", "name", "entry", "size", "matches", "callers_total", "callees_total"},
    "instructions": {"kind", "entry", "start", "total", "rows", "truncated"},
    "caller": {"kind", "at", "from", "to"},
    "xref": {"kind", "index", "total", "at", "from", "to", "type"},
    **{kind: _FIELDS[kind] for kind in ("pseudocode", "call", "ref")},
}
_REFERENCE_TYPES = ("read", "write", "read_write", "data", "jump")


def _index(value, minimum=0):
    return type(value) is int and minimum <= value < 2**32


def _instruction_anchor(sections, item):
    _check(1 <= item.location.length <= 16)
    address, _ = _map(sections, item.location.offset, item.location.length, virtual=False)
    offset, _ = _map(sections, address, item.location.length, virtual=True)
    _check(offset == item.location.offset)
    return address


def _instruction_rows(rows, maximum, size):
    _check(isinstance(rows, list) and 1 <= len(rows) <= maximum)
    end = 0
    for row in rows:
        _check(isinstance(row, list) and len(row) == 3)
        delta, length, text = row
        _check(_uint(delta) and type(length) is int and 1 <= length <= 16
               and end <= delta and delta + length <= size)
        _check(isinstance(text, str) and 1 <= len(text) <= 64 and all(" " <= c <= "~" for c in text))
        end = delta + length


def _page_rows(items, args):
    total = None
    for index, item in enumerate(items, args["start"]):
        value = item.value
        _check(type(value["index"]) is int and value["index"] == index)
        _check(_index(value["total"]) and index < value["total"] <= 65536)
        _check(total is None or total == value["total"])
        total = value["total"]


def _verify_query(data, observations, args, operation):
    _check(operation in ("ghidra.functions", "ghidra.function", "ghidra.xrefs"))
    _check(isinstance(data, bytes) and isinstance(observations, (list, tuple))
           and len(observations) <= (643 if operation == "ghidra.function" else 256))
    _check(isinstance(args, dict))
    defaults = {
        "ghidra.functions": {"query": "", "start": 0, "limit": 64},
        "ghidra.function": {"select": "entry", "entry": 0, "name": "", "parts": "all", "start": 0,
                             "limit": 64, "max_chars": 1024, "max_calls": 64, "max_refs": 64},
        "ghidra.xrefs": {"start": 0, "limit": 64},
    }[operation]
    _check(set(args) <= set(defaults) | ({"address"} if operation == "ghidra.xrefs" else set()))
    args = {**defaults, **args}
    _check(type(args["start"]) is int and 0 <= args["start"] <= 65535)
    maximum = 128 if operation == "ghidra.functions" else 256
    _check(type(args["limit"]) is int and 1 <= args["limit"] <= maximum)
    decoded, _ = _sections(data)
    sections = _SectionIndex(decoded)
    allowed = ({"function_row"} if operation == "ghidra.functions" else {"xref"}
               if operation == "ghidra.xrefs" else {"target", "pseudocode", "instructions", "call", "caller", "ref"})
    for item in observations:
        _check(isinstance(item, Observation) and item.location.within(len(data)))
        value = item.value
        kind = value.get("kind")
        _check(isinstance(kind, str) and kind in allowed and set(value) == _QUERY_FIELDS[kind])
    if operation == "ghidra.function":
        _verify_function(sections, observations, args)
        return
    _check(len(observations) <= args["limit"])
    _page_rows(observations, args)
    previous = -1
    if operation == "ghidra.functions":
        _check(isinstance(args["query"], str))
        for item in observations:
            value = item.value
            _check(_name(value["name"]) and args["query"] in value["name"])
            _check(_uint(value["entry"]) and value["entry"] > previous and _uint(value["size"], 1)
                   and value["entry"] + value["size"] <= 2**64)
            previous = value["entry"]
            _check(item.location == _function_anchor(sections, value["entry"], value["size"]))
    else:
        _check(_uint(args["address"]))
        previous = None
        for item in observations:
            value = item.value
            address = _instruction_anchor(sections, item)
            _check(_uint(value["at"]) and value["at"] == address)
            _check(_uint(value["to"]) and value["to"] == args["address"])
            _check(value["type"] in ("call", *_REFERENCE_TYPES))
            _check(value["from"] is None or _uint(value["from"]))
            key = (value["at"], value["type"])
            _check(previous is None or key > previous)
            previous = key



def _verify_function(sections, observations, args):
    _check(args["select"] in ("entry", "name") and _uint(args["entry"]) and isinstance(args["name"], str))
    parts = args["parts"]
    _check(parts in ("info", "pseudocode", "assembly", "callees", "callers", "all"))
    for key, minimum, maximum in (("max_chars", 64, 2048), ("max_calls", 0, 256), ("max_refs", 0, 128)):
        _check(type(args[key]) is int and minimum <= args[key] <= maximum)
    if not observations:
        return
    target_item = observations[0]
    target = target_item.value
    _check(target["kind"] == "target" and _name(target["name"]))
    _check(_uint(target["entry"]) and _uint(target["size"], 1)
           and target["entry"] + target["size"] <= 2**64)
    _check(_index(target["matches"], 1) and target["matches"] <= 65536
           and _index(target["callers_total"]) and target["callers_total"] <= 65536
           and _index(target["callees_total"]))
    _check((target["entry"] == args["entry"] and target["matches"] == 1) if args["select"] == "entry"
           else target["name"] == args["name"])
    _check(target_item.location == _function_anchor(sections, target["entry"], target["size"]))
    kinds = ("target", "pseudocode", "instructions", "call", "caller", "ref")
    limits = {"target": 1, "pseudocode": 1, "instructions": 1, "call": args["max_calls"],
              "caller": args["max_calls"], "ref": args["max_refs"]}
    selected = {"info": (), "pseudocode": ("pseudocode",), "assembly": ("instructions",),
                "callees": ("call",), "callers": ("caller",), "all": kinds[1:]}[parts]
    previous_kind = 0
    counts = dict.fromkeys(kinds, 0)
    previous_caller = -1
    previous_ref = None
    call_sites = set()
    for item in observations:
        value = item.value
        kind = value["kind"]
        rank = kinds.index(kind)
        _check(rank >= previous_kind and (kind == "target" or kind in selected))
        previous_kind = rank
        counts[kind] += 1
        _check(counts[kind] <= limits[kind])
        if kind == "target":
            continue
        if kind == "pseudocode":
            _check(type(value["index"]) is int and value["index"] == 0 and _uint(value["entry"])
                   and value["entry"] == target["entry"] and item.location == target_item.location)
            _check(isinstance(value["text"], str) and len(value["text"]) <= args["max_chars"]
                   and type(value["truncated"]) is bool)
        elif kind == "instructions":
            _check(_uint(value["entry"]) and value["entry"] == target["entry"])
            _check(type(value["start"]) is int and value["start"] == args["start"] and _index(value["total"]))
            rows = value["rows"]
            _instruction_rows(rows, args["limit"], target["size"])
            _check(value["start"] + len(rows) <= value["total"] and type(value["truncated"]) is bool)
            _check(value["truncated"] == (len(rows) < args["limit"] and value["start"] + len(rows) < value["total"]))
            address = target["entry"] + rows[0][0]
            length = rows[-1][0] + rows[-1][1] - rows[0][0]
            offset, _ = _map(sections, address, length, virtual=True)
            reverse, _ = _map(sections, offset, length, virtual=False)
            _check(reverse == address and item.location == Location(offset, length))
        elif kind == "caller":
            address = _instruction_anchor(sections, item)
            _check(_uint(value["at"]) and value["at"] == address and address > previous_caller)
            _check(_uint(value["to"]) and value["to"] == target["entry"])
            _check(value["from"] is None or _uint(value["from"]))
            previous_caller = address
        else:
            _check(_uint(value["from"]) and value["from"] == target["entry"]
                   and _uint(value["to"]) and _name(value["to_name"]))
            address = _instruction_anchor(sections, item)
            _check(target["entry"] <= address and address + item.location.length <= target["entry"] + target["size"])
            if kind == "call":
                _check(address not in call_sites)
                call_sites.add(address)
            if kind == "ref":
                _check(value["type"] in _REFERENCE_TYPES)
                key = (item.location.offset, value["to"], value["type"])
                _check(previous_ref is None or key > previous_ref)
                previous_ref = key
    _check(counts["caller"] <= target["callers_total"] and counts["call"] <= target["callees_total"])

```

`reverseai/tools/jadx_tool.py`:

```py
"""Contained JADX method pages; identities and byte anchors come from the host."""

from reverseai.contained import ContainedError, DockerExecutor, default_lock, inspect_image, load_lock
from reverseai.contract import ArgSpec, OperationSpec, ToolRef, ToolSpec, sha256_hex
from reverseai.tools import jadx_verify

REF = ToolRef("jadx", "1.5.6-r1")
DEFAULT_LOCK = default_lock("jadx")


def make_tool(executor=None):
    if executor is None:
        executor = DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK, adapter_version=REF.version)
    lock = load_lock(executor.lock, adapter_version=REF.version)

    def invoke(data, args):
        checked = operation.validate_args(args)
        request, anchors = jadx_verify.prepare(data, checked)
        if not anchors:
            return ()
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        raw = executor.run("jadx.method", request, data, digest)
        return jadx_verify.anchor(jadx_verify.parse_reply(raw, digest), checked, anchors)

    operation = OperationSpec("jadx.method", {
        "member": ArgSpec("identity", 0, 255, default=""),
        "class": ArgSpec("identity", 1, 255), "method": ArgSpec("identity", 1, 255),
        "prototype": ArgSpec("identity", 0, 255, default=""),
        "start": ArgSpec("int", 0, 1048575, default=0),
        "max_chars": ArgSpec("int", 64, 2048, default=1024),
    }, invoke, max_observations=16, derived=True)
    return ToolSpec(REF, {"jadx.method": operation}, contained=True,
                    runtime={"image": lock["image_id"], "platform": lock["platform"]})


def available(lock=None, *, inspect=None):
    try:
        executor = DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK if lock is None else lock, adapter_version=REF.version,
                                  inspect=inspect_image if inspect is None else inspect)
        return executor.available()
    except ContainedError:
        return False


def __getattr__(name):
    if name == "TOOL":
        return make_tool()
    raise AttributeError(name)
```

`reverseai/tools/jadx_verify.py`:

```py
"""Resolve JADX targets from DEX bytes and attach only host-derived anchors."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
import re

from reverseai.contract import (
    ContractError, Location, MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES, MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES, MAX_WORKER_REPLY_BYTES,
    Observation, WORKER_PROTOCOL, WorkerError, canonical_json,
)
from reverseai.tools import dex

REFUSED = "JADX reply does not match the input"
_FIELDS = {"target", "status", "code_offset", "insns_count", "total", "text"}
_ERRORS = {"decompile_failed", "class_not_found", "method_not_found", "no_code"}


def _check(condition):
    if not condition:
        raise ContractError(REFUSED)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Anchor:
    identity: dict
    location: Location
    artifact: dict
    code_offset: int
    insns_count: int


def prepare(data, args):
    """Resolve once, using the DEX tool's limits and exact escaped comparisons."""
    members, targets, anchors = [], [], []
    selected = not args["member"]
    try:
        for name, _, parsed, artifact in dex._dex_files(data, ""):
            _check(len(members) < 16)
            member_index = len(members)
            members.append(dict(artifact))
            if args["member"] and not dex._matches((name,), args["member"]):
                continue
            selected = True
            methods = sorted(dex._defined_methods(parsed), key=lambda pair: pair[1]["index"])
            for declaration, method in methods:
                code = declaration.get("code")
                if not code or not code["insns_size"] or not dex._selected_method(method, args):
                    continue
                _check(len(targets) < 16)
                identity = {"dex": dex._identity((name,)),
                            "class": dex._identity((method["class_descriptor"],)),
                            "name": dex._identity((method["name"],)),
                            "prototype": dex._identity(dex._prototype_parts(method["prototype"]))}
                raw_prototype = "".join(dex._prototype_parts(method["prototype"]))
                targets.append({"member": member_index,
                                "class": method["class_descriptor"].encode("utf-8").hex(),
                                "method": method["name"].encode("utf-8").hex(),
                                "prototype": raw_prototype.encode("utf-8").hex()})
                anchors.append(_Anchor(identity,
                    Location(code["insns_offset"], min(2 * code["insns_size"], MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES)),
                    dict(artifact), declaration["code_off"], code["insns_size"]))
    except (ContractError, UnicodeError):
        raise ContractError(REFUSED) from None
    if not selected:
        raise ContractError("JADX member is not a classes*.dex member of the input")
    return {"members": members, "targets": targets, "start": args["start"], "max_chars": args["max_chars"]}, tuple(anchors)


def _unique(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        _check(key not in result)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def parse_reply(raw, digest):
    _check(isinstance(raw, bytes) and len(raw) <= MAX_WORKER_REPLY_BYTES)
    try:
        reply = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=_unique,
                           parse_constant=lambda value: _check(False))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise ContractError(REFUSED) from None
    _check(isinstance(reply, dict) and reply.get("protocol") == WORKER_PROTOCOL
           and reply.get("snapshot_sha256") == digest)
    if reply.get("status") == "error":
        _check(set(reply) == {"protocol", "status", "snapshot_sha256", "error"})
        _check(isinstance(reply["error"], str) and reply["error"] in ("memory", "timeout", "input"))
        raise WorkerError(reply["error"])
    _check(set(reply) == {"protocol", "status", "snapshot_sha256", "observations"}
           and reply.get("status") == "ok")
    rows = reply["observations"]
    _check(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) <= 16)
    return rows


def anchor(rows, args, anchors):
    """Only prepare's host-owned anchors may enter this core; no worker location is admitted."""
    _check(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == len(anchors) <= 16)
    result = []
    for index, (row, expected) in enumerate(zip(rows, anchors)):
        _check(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == _FIELDS)
        _check(type(row["target"]) is int and row["target"] == index)
        status, total, text = row["status"], row["total"], row["text"]
        _check(isinstance(status, str) and status in {"ok", "fallback", "omitted", *_ERRORS})
        _check(type(total) is int and 0 <= total < 2**32 and isinstance(text, str)
               and len(text) <= args["max_chars"]
               and all(" " <= char <= "~" or char in "\n\t" for char in text))
        if status in ("ok", "fallback"):
            _check(total > 0 and type(row["code_offset"]) is int and row["code_offset"] == expected.code_offset
                   and type(row["insns_count"]) is int and row["insns_count"] == expected.insns_count)
            start = min(args["start"], total)
            _check(len(text) == min(args["max_chars"], total - start))
            form = "java" if status == "ok" else "fallback"
        else:
            _check(row["code_offset"] is None and row["insns_count"] is None and total == 0 and text == "")
            start, form = 0, "omitted" if status == "omitted" else "error"
        value = {"kind": "java", **expected.identity, "form": form, "start": start, "total": total, "text": text}
        if len(canonical_json(value).encode()) > MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES:
            low, high = 0, len(text)
            while low < high:
                middle = (low + high + 1) // 2
                value["text"] = text[:middle]
                if len(canonical_json(value).encode()) <= MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES:
                    low = middle
                else:
                    high = middle - 1
            for escape in re.finditer(r"\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}", text):
                if escape.start() < low < escape.end():
                    low = escape.start()
                    break
            value["text"] = text[:low]
        _check(len(canonical_json(value).encode()) <= MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES)
        result.append(Observation(expected.location, value, dict(expected.artifact)))
    return tuple(result)


def verify(data, rows, args):
    """Standalone verification always derives anchors afresh from the input bytes."""
    _, anchors = prepare(data, args)
    return anchor(rows, args, anchors)

```

`reverseai/tools/js.py`:

```py
"""Read JavaScript application bytes and package declarations without executing them."""

from reverseai.contract import (
    ArgSpec, ContractError, Location, MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES, Observation, OperationSpec,
    ToolRef, ToolSpec, sha256_hex,
)
from reverseai.tools import apk, asar, jsonpos, tarball

MAX_READ_BYTES = 128 * 1024 * 1024
_SUFFIXES = ('.js', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.jsx', '.ts', '.tsx')
_ASCII_LOWER = str.maketrans('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ', 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
_CATEGORIES = ('endpoint', 'dynamic_code', 'shell', 'filesystem', 'network', 'credential', 'encoding')
_FIELDS = frozenset(('name', 'version', 'description', 'main', 'module', 'browser', 'types',
                     'type', 'license', 'homepage'))
_COLLECTIONS = frozenset(('bin', 'exports', 'scripts', 'engines', 'dependencies', 'devDependencies',
                          'peerDependencies', 'optionalDependencies'))


def _package_name(name):
    return name.rsplit('/', 1)[-1].translate(_ASCII_LOWER) == 'package.json'


def _javascript_name(name):
    return name.translate(_ASCII_LOWER).endswith(_SUFFIXES) or _package_name(name)


def _members(data, *, include_flagged=False):
    if data.startswith(tarball.MAGIC):
        return tuple(member for member in tarball.members(data)
                     if _javascript_name(member.name) and (include_flagged or not member.flags))
    if data.startswith(asar.MAGIC):
        return tuple(member for member in asar.members(data)
                     if _javascript_name(member.name) and (include_flagged or not member.flags))
    try:
        return tuple(member for member in apk.members(data)
                     if _javascript_name(member.name) and (include_flagged or not member.flags))
    except apk.ApkError:
        if data.startswith(b'PK\x03\x04'):
            raise ContractError('Invalid JavaScript ZIP container') from None
        return None  # The input itself is the single file, named "".


def _sources(data, members):
    if members is None:
        if len(data) > MAX_READ_BYTES:
            raise ContractError('JavaScript read budget exceeded')
        yield '', data, None, None
        return
    total = 0
    for member in members:
        if member.flags:
            yield apk.escape(member.name), None, None, member
            continue
        total += member.size
        if total > MAX_READ_BYTES:
            raise ContractError('JavaScript read budget exceeded')
        # These clean descriptors came from one parse of these exact bytes.
        archive = (tarball if isinstance(member, tarball.TarMember)
                   else asar if isinstance(member, asar.AsarMember) else apk)
        child, _ = archive._materialize(data, member)
        artifact = None if archive is tarball and not child else archive.artifact(member, child)
        yield apk.escape(member.name), child, artifact, member


def _page(rows, args):
    page, total = [], 0
    for location, value, artifact in rows:
        if args['start'] <= total < args['start'] + args['limit']:
            page.append((location, {**value, 'index': total}, artifact))
        total += 1
    return [Observation(location, {**value, 'total': total}, artifact) for location, value, artifact in page]


def _line_stats(data):
    lines, longest, pending = 0, 0, 0
    for at in range(0, len(data), 65536):
        parts = data[at:at + 65536].split(b'\n')
        lines += len(parts) - 1
        if len(parts) == 1:
            pending += len(parts[0])
        else:
            longest = max(longest, pending + len(parts[0]), max(map(len, parts[1:-1]), default=0))
            pending = len(parts[-1])
    return lines + int(bool(data) and data[-1] != 10), max(longest, pending)


def _header_location(member):
    if isinstance(member, tarball.TarMember):
        return Location(0, tarball.BLOCK), tarball.header_artifact(member)
    return Location(member.central_offset, min(member.central_length, MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES)), None


def _files(data, args):
    def rows():
        for name, child, artifact, member in _sources(data, _members(data, include_flagged=True)):
            if member is not None and member.flags:
                location, artifact = _header_location(member)
                yield location, dict(
                    kind='js_file', file=name, size=member.size, sha256=None, lines=None, max_line=None,
                    flags=list(member.flags)), artifact
                continue
            if not child:
                if member is None:
                    continue  # There is no byte range to cite in an empty input.
                location, artifact = _header_location(member)
            else:
                location = Location(0, min(len(child), MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES))
            lines, longest = _line_stats(child)
            yield location, dict(kind='js_file', file=name, size=len(child), sha256=sha256_hex(child),
                                 lines=lines, max_line=longest, flags=[]), artifact
    return _page(rows(), args)


def _cut(text):
    escaped = apk.escape(text, maximum=266)
    return escaped[:256], len(escaped) > 256


def _pointer(parts):
    raw = '/' + '/'.join(part.replace('~', '~0').replace('/', '~1') for part in parts)
    escaped = apk.escape(raw, maximum=265)
    if len(escaped) > 255:
        raise ContractError('JavaScript JSON pointer exceeds its limit')
    return escaped


def _strings(node, path, depth=0, maximum=None):
    if maximum is not None and depth > maximum:
        return
    if isinstance(node.value, str):
        yield node, path
    elif isinstance(node.value, dict):
        for key, child in node.children:
            yield from _strings(child, (*path, key.value), depth + 1, maximum)
    elif isinstance(node.value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(node.children):
            yield from _strings(child, (*path, str(index)), depth + 1, maximum)


def _declarations(data):
    root = jsonpos.parse(data).root
    if not isinstance(root.value, dict):
        raise ContractError('JavaScript package must be a JSON object')
    for key, node in root.children:
        name = key.value
        if name in _FIELDS and isinstance(node.value, str):
            yield node, (name,)
        elif name == 'repository':
            if isinstance(node.value, str):
                yield node, (name,)
            elif isinstance(node.value, dict):
                for child_key, child in node.children:
                    if child_key.value == 'url' and isinstance(child.value, str):
                        yield child, (name, 'url')
        elif name in ('bundledDependencies', 'bundleDependencies'):
            if isinstance(node.value, list):
                for index, child in enumerate(node.children):
                    if isinstance(child.value, str):
                        yield child, (name, str(index))
        elif name in _COLLECTIONS and (name in ('bin', 'exports') or isinstance(node.value, (dict, list))):
            yield from _strings(node, (name,), maximum=4 if name == 'exports' else None)


def _package(data, args):
    members = _members(data)
    if members is not None:
        members = tuple(m for m in members if _package_name(m.name)
                        and (not args['file'] or apk.escape(m.name) == args['file']))
        if not args['file'] and members:
            members = (min(members, key=lambda m: m.name.count('/')),)
    elif args['file']:
        return []

    def rows():
        for name, child, artifact, _ in _sources(data, members):
            if members is None and not child.removeprefix(b'\xef\xbb\xbf').lstrip(b' \t\r\n').startswith(b'{'):
                continue
            for node, path in _declarations(child):
                text, truncated = _cut(node.value)
                yield Location(node.start, min(node.end - node.start, MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES)), dict(
                    kind='package_field', file=name, path=_pointer(path), value=text, truncated=truncated), artifact
    return _page(rows(), args)


def _hints(data, args):
    from reverseai.tools import jshints

    members = _members(data)
    if members is not None:
        members = tuple(m for m in members if not _package_name(m.name)
                        and (not args['file'] or apk.escape(m.name) == args['file']))
    elif args['file']:
        return []

    def rows():
        for name, child, artifact, _ in _sources(data, members):
            for offset, length, category, hint in jshints.scan(child):
                if args['category'] != 'all' and args['category'] != category:
                    continue
                text, truncated = _cut(child[offset:offset + length].decode('latin-1'))
                yield Location(offset, min(length, MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES)), dict(
                    kind='js_hint', file=name, category=category, hint=hint, text=text, truncated=truncated), artifact
    return _page(rows(), args)


TOOL = ToolSpec(ToolRef('js', '0.1.0'), {
    'js.files': OperationSpec('js.files', {
        'start': ArgSpec('int', 0, 65535, default=0), 'limit': ArgSpec('int', 1, 256, default=128),
    }, _files, max_observations=256),
    'js.package': OperationSpec('js.package', {
        'file': ArgSpec('literal', 0, 255, default=''),
        'start': ArgSpec('int', 0, 65535, default=0), 'limit': ArgSpec('int', 1, 256, default=128),
    }, _package, max_observations=256),
    'js.hints': OperationSpec('js.hints', {
        'file': ArgSpec('literal', 0, 255, default=''),
        'category': ArgSpec('enum', choices=('all', *_CATEGORIES), default='all'),
        'start': ArgSpec('int', 0, 1048575, default=0), 'limit': ArgSpec('int', 1, 256, default=128),
    }, _hints, max_observations=256),
})

```

`reverseai/tools/jshints.py`:

```py
"""Bounded lexical JavaScript hints; comments and quoted text are included.

These rules describe occurrences, never execution or parsed JavaScript semantics.
Each regex has a fixed maximum span; scan merges its iterators without retaining
the file's matches. Within one pattern, occurrences do not overlap.
"""

import heapq
import re

from reverseai.contract import ContractError, MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES

MAX_BYTES = 128 * 1024 * 1024
CALLEES = frozenset((
    "eval", "Function", "child_process.exec", "childProcess.exec", "cp.exec",
    "execSync", "execFile", "execFileSync", "spawn", "spawnSync", "fork",
    "runInNewContext", "runInThisContext", "runInContext", "fetch", "XMLHttpRequest", "WebSocket",
    "atob", "btoa", "fromCharCode", "Buffer.from", "http.get", "https.get", "http.request", "https.request",
    "net.connect", "tls.connect", "net.createConnection", "dgram.createSocket",
    "fs.write", "fs.writeSync", "fs.writev", "fs.writevSync", "writeFile", "writeFileSync", "appendFile", "appendFileSync",
    "unlink", "unlinkSync", "rm", "rmSync", "rmdir", "rmdirSync", "chmod", "chmodSync", "fchmod", "fchmodSync",
    "lchmod", "lchmodSync",
))
_LEFT = rb"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_$])"
_RIGHT = rb"(?![A-Za-z0-9_$])"
_WS = rb"[ \t-\r]{0,64}"
_DOT = _WS + rb"\." + _WS
_OPEN = _WS + rb"\("
_OCTET = rb"(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])"
_PORT = rb"(?:6553[0-5]|655[0-2][0-9]|65[0-4][0-9]{2}|6[0-4][0-9]{3}|[1-5][0-9]{4}|[1-9][0-9]{0,3}|0)"
_KEY = rb"(?:api[_-]?key|secret|token)"
_ASSIGN_KEY = rb"(?:" + _KEY + _RIGHT + b'|"' + _KEY + b'"' + b"|'" + _KEY + b"')"
_LITERAL = rb'''(?:"(?:[^"\\\r\n]|\\[^\r\n]){1,512}"|'(?:[^'\\\r\n]|\\[^\r\n]){1,512}')'''
# A closed, plain literal is the only loading argument excluded by this rule.
# Concatenations, interpolated templates and escaped spellings remain hints.
_PLAIN = rb'''(?:"[^"\\\r\n]{0,1024}"|'[^'\\\r\n]{0,1024}'|`(?:[^`\\$]|\$(?!\{)){0,1024}`)'''
_DYNAMIC = _WS + rb"(?!" + _PLAIN + _WS + rb"\))[^) \t-\r]"
_PREVIOUS_DOT = re.compile(rb"\.[ \t-\r]{0,64}\Z")
_PREVIOUS_NEW = re.compile(_LEFT + rb"new[ \t-\r]{1,64}\Z")


def _call(source):
    return _LEFT + source + _OPEN


PATTERNS = tuple((name, category, re.compile(source, flags)) for name, category, source, flags in (
    ("url", "endpoint", _LEFT + rb'''(?:https?|wss?|ftp)://[A-Za-z0-9\[][^\x00-\x20\x7f"'<>`\\]{0,4079}''', 0),
    ("ipv4_port", "endpoint", rb"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_$.])" + _OCTET + rb"(?:\." + _OCTET + rb"){3}:" + _PORT + rb"(?![A-Za-z0-9_$.])", 0),
    ("eval", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"eval"), 0),
    ("new_function", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"new" + rb"[ \t-\r]{1,64}" + rb"Function"), 0),
    ("function_constructor", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"Function"), 0),
    ("timer_string", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"set(?:Timeout|Interval)") + _WS + rb'''["'`]''', 0),
    ("vm_run", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"vm" + _DOT + rb"runIn[A-Za-z0-9_$]{1,64}"), 0),
    ("dynamic_import", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"import") + _DYNAMIC, 0),
    ("dynamic_require", "dynamic_code", _call(rb"require") + _DYNAMIC, 0),
    ("child_process", "shell", _LEFT + rb"child_process" + _RIGHT, 0),
    ("process_call", "shell", _call(rb"(?:(?:(?:child_process|childProcess|cp)" + _DOT + rb")?(?P<exec_method>exec)|exec(?:File)?Sync|execFile|spawn(?:Sync)?|fork)"), 0),
    ("fs_mutation", "filesystem", _call(rb"fs" + _DOT + rb"(?:promises" + _DOT + rb")?(?:write(?:File|v)?|appendFile|unlink|rm(?:dir)?|(?:f|l)?chmod)(?:Sync)?"), 0),
    ("process_env", "credential", _LEFT + rb"process" + _DOT + rb"env" + _RIGHT, 0),
    ("fetch", "network", _call(rb"fetch"), 0),
    ("xml_http_request", "network", _LEFT + rb"XMLHttpRequest" + _RIGHT, 0),
    ("web_socket", "network", _LEFT + rb"WebSocket" + _RIGHT, 0),
    ("http_request", "network", _call(rb"https?" + _DOT + rb"(?:request|get)"), 0),
    ("net_connect", "network", _call(rb"net" + _DOT + rb"(?:connect|createConnection)"), 0),
    ("dgram", "network", _LEFT + rb"dgram" + _RIGHT, 0),
    ("aws_access_key", "credential", _LEFT + rb"(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}" + _RIGHT, 0),
    ("private_key", "credential", rb"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |DSA |OPENSSH |ENCRYPTED )?PRIVATE KEY-----", 0),
    ("credential_assignment", "credential", _LEFT + _ASSIGN_KEY + _WS + rb"(?::|=(?![=>]))" + _WS + _LITERAL, re.IGNORECASE),
    ("jwt", "credential", rb"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,253}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,1024}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,1024}(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])", 0),
    ("atob", "encoding", _call(rb"atob"), 0),
    ("btoa", "encoding", _call(rb"btoa"), 0),
    ("buffer_decode", "encoding", _LEFT + rb"Buffer" + _DOT + rb"from" + _OPEN + rb'''[^,()\r\n]{1,1024},''' + _WS + rb'''(?:'(?:base64|hex)'|"(?:base64|hex)")''' + _WS + rb"\)", 0),
    ("from_char_code", "encoding", _call(rb"String" + _DOT + rb"fromCharCode"), 0),
    ("hex_escapes", "encoding", rb"(?:\\x[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}){8,1024}", 0),
    ("unicode_escapes", "encoding", rb"(?:\\u[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}){8,682}", 0),
))


def _matches(data, order, name, category, pattern):
    for match in pattern.finditer(data):
        start, end = match.span()
        if not 0 < end - start <= MAX_EXCERPT_BYTES:
            raise ContractError("Invalid JavaScript hint span")
        if name == "function_constructor" or (name == "process_call" and match.lastgroup == "exec_method"):
            # Three bytes for 'new', up to 64 whitespace bytes, and its boundary.
            prefix = data[max(0, start - 68):start]
            if name == "process_call" and _PREVIOUS_DOT.search(prefix):
                continue
            if name == "function_constructor" and _PREVIOUS_NEW.search(prefix):
                continue
        yield start, order, end - start, category, name


def scan(data):
    """Yield (offset, length, category, hint), ordered by byte then pattern."""
    if not isinstance(data, bytes) or len(data) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise ContractError("JavaScript input exceeds its limit")
    streams = (_matches(data, order, name, category, pattern)
               for order, (name, category, pattern) in enumerate(PATTERNS))
    for offset, _, length, category, name in heapq.merge(*streams):
        yield offset, length, category, name
```

`reverseai/tools/jsonpos.py`:

```py
"""Bounded RFC 8259 JSON with source byte ranges; UTF-8 BOMs are refused.

Numbers use Decimal's finite range and exact precision, never binary floats.
Tokens include punctuation and keys; EOF and whitespace are not tokens.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
import json
import re

from reverseai.contract import ContractError

MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
MAX_DEPTH = 64
MAX_TOKENS = 65536
_SPACE = re.compile(rb"[ \t\r\n]*")
_NUMBER = re.compile(rb"-?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?")
_HEX = frozenset(b"0123456789abcdefABCDEF")


def _check(condition):
    if not condition:
        raise ContractError("Invalid or over-budget JSON")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Token:
    kind: str
    value: object
    start: int
    end: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Node:
    value: object
    start: int
    end: int
    # Array children are nodes; object children are (key token, value node).
    children: tuple = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Document:
    root: Node
    tokens: tuple


class _Reader:
    def __init__(self, data, max_tokens):
        self.data, self.position, self.tokens = data, 0, []
        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
        self.current = self.next()

    def next(self):
        data = self.data
        start = _SPACE.match(data, self.position).end()
        if start == len(data):
            self.position = start
            return None
        _check(len(self.tokens) < self.max_tokens)
        byte, end = data[start], start + 1
        if byte in b'{}[]:,':
            kind = value = chr(byte)
        elif byte == 34:
            while end < len(data) and data[end] != 34:
                _check(data[end] >= 32)
                if data[end] == 92:
                    end += 1
                    _check(end < len(data) and data[end] in b'"\\/bfnrtu')
                    if data[end] == 117:
                        _check(end + 4 < len(data) and all(c in _HEX for c in data[end + 1:end + 5]))
                        end += 4
                end += 1
            _check(end < len(data))
            end += 1
            value = json.loads(data[start:end])
            _check(not any(0xD800 <= ord(char) <= 0xDFFF for char in value))
            kind = "string"
        else:
            match = _NUMBER.match(data, start)
            if match:
                end, kind = match.end(), "number"
                value = Decimal(data[start:end].decode("ascii"))
            else:
                for spelling, value in ((b"true", True), (b"false", False), (b"null", None)):
                    if data.startswith(spelling, start):
                        end, kind = start + len(spelling), "literal"
                        break
                else:
                    _check(False)
        token = Token(kind, value, start, end)
        self.position = end
        self.tokens.append(token)
        return token

    def take(self, kind):
        token = self.current
        _check(token is not None and token.kind == kind)
        self.current = self.next()
        return token

    def node(self, depth=0):
        token = self.current
        _check(token is not None)
        if token.kind not in ("{", "["):
            _check(token.kind in ("string", "number", "literal"))
            self.take(token.kind)
            return Node(token.value, token.start, token.end)
        _check(depth < MAX_DEPTH)
        opening, closing = token.kind, "}" if token.kind == "{" else "]"
        self.take(opening)
        children, value = [], {} if opening == "{" else []
        if self.current is not None and self.current.kind != closing:
            while True:
                if opening == "{":
                    key = self.take("string")
                    _check(key.value not in value)
                    self.take(":")
                    child = self.node(depth + 1)
                    value[key.value] = child.value
                    children.append((key, child))
                else:
                    child = self.node(depth + 1)
                    value.append(child.value)
                    children.append(child)
                if self.current is None or self.current.kind != ",":
                    break
                self.take(",")
        end = self.take(closing).end
        return Node(value, token.start, end, tuple(children))


def parse(data, *, max_bytes=None, max_tokens=None):
    """Return Document(root, tokens); all spans address the original bytes.

    At most 64 nested containers are admitted. Strings and object keys decode
    JSON escapes; duplicate decoded keys and isolated UTF-16 surrogates fail.
    """
    max_bytes = MAX_BYTES if max_bytes is None else max_bytes
    max_tokens = MAX_TOKENS if max_tokens is None else max_tokens
    _check(type(max_bytes) is int and max_bytes >= 0 and type(max_tokens) is int and max_tokens >= 0)
    _check(isinstance(data, bytes) and len(data) <= max_bytes)
    _check(not data.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"))
    try:
        reader = _Reader(data, max_tokens)
        root = reader.node()
        _check(reader.current is None)
        return Document(root, tuple(reader.tokens))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError, InvalidOperation, RecursionError):
        raise ContractError("Invalid or over-budget JSON") from None
```

`reverseai/tools/jsparser_tool.py`:

```py
"""Contained syntax readings with source text and byte anchors re-derived on the host."""

from reverseai.contained import ContainedError, DockerExecutor, default_lock, inspect_image, load_lock
from reverseai.contract import ArgSpec, OperationSpec, ToolRef, ToolSpec, sha256_hex
from reverseai.tools import jsparser_verify

REF = ToolRef('jsparser', '8.0.4-r2')
DEFAULT_LOCK = default_lock("jsparser")


def make_tool(executor=None):
    if executor is None:
        executor = DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK, adapter_version=REF.version)
    lock = load_lock(executor.lock, adapter_version=REF.version)

    def invoke(data, args):
        checked = operation.validate_args(args)
        request, files = jsparser_verify.prepare(data, checked)
        if not files:
            return ()
        digest = sha256_hex(data)
        raw = executor.run('jsparser.syntax', request, data, digest)
        return jsparser_verify.anchor(jsparser_verify.parse_reply(raw, digest), checked, files)

    operation = OperationSpec('jsparser.syntax', {
        'file': ArgSpec('identity', 0, 255, default=''),
        'kind': ArgSpec('enum', choices=('modules', 'calls', 'parse'), default='modules'),
        'start': ArgSpec('int', 0, 1048575, default=0),
        'limit': ArgSpec('int', 1, 256, default=128),
    }, invoke, max_observations=256, derived=True)
    return ToolSpec(REF, {'jsparser.syntax': operation}, contained=True,
                    runtime={'image': lock['image_id'], 'platform': lock['platform']})


def available(lock=None, *, inspect=None):
    try:
        executor = DockerExecutor(DEFAULT_LOCK if lock is None else lock, adapter_version=REF.version,
                                  inspect=inspect_image if inspect is None else inspect)
        return executor.available()
    except ContainedError:
        return False


def __getattr__(name):
    if name == 'TOOL':
        return make_tool()
    raise AttributeError(name)
```
