import argparse
import copy
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import tomllib
import unittest
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch

from hive import bees
from hive.codex_bees import CodexBees, MixedBees, add_arguments, build, drop_nulls, strict_schema


ANSWERS = {
    "planner": {"modules": [{"id": "one", "title": "entry", "functions": ["0x1000"], "rationale": None}],
                "skipped": [], "notes": None},
    "worker": {"status": "done", "functions": [{"entry": "0x1000", "name": None,
                                               "status": "rebuilt", "notes": None}],
               "contract_requests": None, "unknowns": None},
    "repair": {"status": "done", "functions": [], "contract_requests": [], "unknowns": []},
    "councillor": {"verdict": "accept", "defects": [], "summary": None},
    "tester": {"cases": [{"id": "stdin", "files": [{"name": "input", "text": "abc", "base64": None}],
                          "steps": [{"args": [], "stdin": None}], "why": None}]},
}


def overrides(argv):
    return tomllib.loads("\n".join(argv[index + 1] for index, arg in enumerate(argv) if arg == "-c"))


class SchemaTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_all_role_schemas_are_strict_recursively_without_mutating_claude(self):
        original = copy.deepcopy(bees.SCHEMAS)

        def check(schema):
            if isinstance(schema, list):
                for item in schema:
                    check(item)
            elif isinstance(schema, dict):
                if schema.get("type") == "object":
                    self.assertEqual(schema["required"], list(schema["properties"]))
                    self.assertIs(schema["additionalProperties"], False)
                for item in schema.values():
                    check(item)

        for role in ("planner", "worker", "repair", "councillor", "tester"):
            check(strict_schema(bees.SCHEMAS[role]))
        self.assertEqual(bees.SCHEMAS, original)
        schema = strict_schema(bees.SCHEMAS["worker"])
        self.assertEqual(schema["required"], ["status", "functions", "contract_requests", "unknowns"])
        self.assertEqual(schema["properties"]["status"]["enum"], ["done", "partial", "blocked"])
        self.assertEqual(schema["properties"]["unknowns"]["anyOf"][1], {"type": "null"})

    def test_optional_enum_and_nested_objects_are_nullable(self):
        schema = strict_schema({"type": "object", "properties": {
            "mode": {"type": "string", "enum": ["a", "b"]},
            "child": {"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}}}}})
        self.assertEqual(schema["properties"]["mode"], {
            "anyOf": [{"type": "string", "enum": ["a", "b"]}, {"type": "null"}]})
        child = schema["properties"]["child"]["anyOf"][0]
        self.assertEqual(child["required"], ["text"])
        self.assertIs(child["additionalProperties"], False)

    def test_null_removal_preserves_false_empty_values_and_array_positions(self):
        value = {"optional": None, "nested": [{"drop": None, "keep": ""}, None],
                 "false": False, "zero": 0, "empty": []}
        self.assertEqual(drop_nulls(value), {"nested": [{"keep": ""}, None],
                                            "false": False, "zero": 0, "empty": []})
        self.assertIn("optional", value)


class CodexRunnerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.folder = self.root / "bee"
        self.folder.mkdir()
        self.runner = CodexBees(engine=self.root / 'engine "quoted"', inputs=self.root / "inputs with spaces",
                                python='/python "quoted"', config_dir=self.root / "config", timeout=7,
                                allow_network=True)

    def run_bee(self, role="worker", *, answer=None, returncode=0, stderr="", write=True):
        def run(argv, **kwargs):
            if write:
                Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps(ANSWERS[role] if answer is None else answer))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, returncode, stdout='{"type":"turn.completed"}', stderr=stderr)

        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=run) as process:
            result = self.runner(role, "bee-1", "TASK", self.folder)
        return result, process.call_args

    def test_argv_requests_sandbox_approvals_network_and_the_single_mcp_server(self):
        for role in ("planner", "worker", "repair", "councillor", "tester"):
            with self.subTest(role=role):
                result, call = self.run_bee(role)
                self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result)
                argv, kwargs = call.args[0], call.kwargs
                self.assertEqual(argv[:2], ["codex", "exec"])
                for flag in ("--ignore-user-config", "--skip-git-repo-check", "--ephemeral"):
                    self.assertIn(flag, argv)
                self.assertIn("--json", argv)
                self.assertNotIn("--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox", argv)
                self.assertNotIn("--approve-for-me", argv)
                self.assertNotIn("--add-dir", argv)
                self.assertNotIn("-m", argv)
                self.assertEqual(argv[-1], "-")
                self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("-C") + 1], str(self.folder.resolve()))
                self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("--sandbox") + 1],
                                 "read-only" if role == "councillor" else "workspace-write")
                config = overrides(argv)
                self.assertEqual(config["approval_policy"], "never")
                self.assertIs(config["sandbox_workspace_write"]["network_access"], False)
                self.assertEqual(config["sandbox_workspace_write"]["writable_roots"], [])
                self.assertIs(config["sandbox_workspace_write"]["exclude_tmpdir_env_var"], True)
                self.assertIs(config["sandbox_workspace_write"]["exclude_slash_tmp"], True)
                self.assertEqual(config["web_search"], "disabled")
                self.assertEqual(set(config["mcp_servers"]), {"reverseai"})
                server = config["mcp_servers"]["reverseai"]
                self.assertEqual(server["command"], '/python "quoted"')
                self.assertEqual(server["args"], ["-B", "-m", "reverseai", "mcp", "--inputs",
                                                   str((self.root / "inputs with spaces").resolve()), "--with-ghidra"])
                self.assertEqual(server["env"], {"PYTHONPATH": str((self.root / 'engine "quoted"').resolve()),
                                                  "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"})
                schema_path = Path(argv[argv.index("--output-schema") + 1])
                self.assertFalse(schema_path.is_relative_to(self.folder))
                self.assertIs(json.loads(schema_path.read_text())["additionalProperties"], False)
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["input"], bees.brief(role, "TASK"))
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["cwd"], self.folder)
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["timeout"], 7)
                self.assertTrue(kwargs["capture_output"])
                self.assertTrue(kwargs["text"])
                self.assertFalse(kwargs["check"])

    def test_model_effort_and_enabled_tools_are_explicit(self):
        self.runner.model, self.runner.effort = "chosen-model", "high"
        self.runner.enabled = ("ghidra", "yara")
        result, call = self.run_bee()
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"])
        argv = call.args[0]
        self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("-m") + 1], "chosen-model")
        config = overrides(argv)
        self.assertEqual(config["model_reasoning_effort"], "high")
        self.assertEqual(config["mcp_servers"]["reverseai"]["args"][-2:], ["--with-ghidra", "--with-yara"])

    def test_final_file_is_parsed_and_optional_nulls_removed_for_the_queen(self):
        result, _ = self.run_bee()
        self.assertEqual(result["output"], {"status": "done", "functions": [{"entry": "0x1000", "status": "rebuilt"}]})
        self.assertIn("seconds", result)
        result, _ = self.run_bee("tester")
        self.assertEqual(result["output"]["cases"][0], {
            "id": "stdin", "files": [{"name": "input", "text": "abc"}], "steps": [{"args": []}]})

    def test_nonzero_exit_cannot_accept_a_valid_answer(self):
        result, _ = self.run_bee(returncode=3, stderr="native refusal")
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertIn("exit 3: native refusal", result["error"])

    def test_missing_file_cannot_reuse_a_previous_success(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.run_bee()[0]["ok"])
        result, _ = self.run_bee(write=False)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["output"])

    def test_malformed_json_and_invalid_output_fail_closed(self):
        bad = [[], "text", 3, None, {}, {**ANSWERS["worker"], "extra": True},
               {**ANSWERS["worker"], "status": "accepted"},
               {**ANSWERS["worker"], "functions": [None]},
               {**ANSWERS["worker"], "functions": [{"entry": 123, "name": None,
                                                     "status": "rebuilt", "notes": None}]},
               {"status": "done", "functions": []}]
        for value in bad:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                def run(argv, **kwargs):
                    Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps(value))
                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, '{"type":"turn.completed"}', "")
                with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=run):
                    self.assertFalse(self.runner("worker", "bad", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
        def malformed(argv, **kwargs):
            Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text("{broken")
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, '{"type":"turn.completed"}', "")
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=malformed):
            self.assertFalse(self.runner("worker", "bad", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])

    def test_timeout_startup_io_and_invalid_role_fail_without_raising(self):
        for error in (subprocess.TimeoutExpired("codex", 7), FileNotFoundError("missing codex"),
                      OSError("native failure")):
            with self.subTest(error=error), patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=error):
                result = self.runner("worker", "failure", "TASK", self.folder)
                self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
                self.assertTrue(result["error"])
                if isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
                    self.assertEqual(result["seconds"], 7)
        self.assertFalse(self.runner("unknown", "failure", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli") as process:
            self.assertFalse(self.runner("worker", "../escape", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
            process.assert_not_called()
        self.runner.config_dir = self.folder / "not-a-directory"
        self.runner.config_dir.write_text("occupied")
        self.assertFalse(self.runner("worker", "failure", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])

    def test_each_bee_has_separate_output_and_schema_paths(self):
        first = self.runner.argv("worker", "m01-build", self.folder)
        second = self.runner.argv("councillor", "m01-council-r1-io", self.folder)
        for flag in ("--output-schema", "-o"):
            self.assertNotEqual(first[first.index(flag) + 1], second[second.index(flag) + 1])


class NetworkGateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_codex_stops_before_timeout_after_consecutive_mcp_schema_errors(self):
        import sys
        events = [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"id": str(i), "type": "mcp_tool_call",
                   "tool": "export_function", "error": {"code": -32602, "message": "Invalid arguments"}}}
                  for i in range(2)]
        script = "import sys,time; sys.stdin.read(); print(" + repr("\n".join(map(json.dumps, events))) + ",flush=True); time.sleep(30)"
        runner = CodexBees(engine=self.root, inputs=self.root, config_dir=self.root / "stop-config",
                           allow_network=True, timeout=1)
        runner.max_tool_rejections = 2
        with patch.object(runner, "argv", return_value=[sys.executable, "-u", "-c", script]):
            result = runner("planner", "planner", "prompt", self.folder, schema={"type": "object"})
        self.assertEqual(result["outcome"], "tool_schema_failure")
        self.assertFalse(result["refused"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["output"])
        self.assertEqual(result["tool_rejections"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["consecutive_tool_rejections"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["tool_name"], "export_function")

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.folder = self.root / "bee"
        self.folder.mkdir()
        self.runner = CodexBees(engine=self.root, inputs=self.root, config_dir=self.root / "config", timeout=7)
        self.calls = []
        self.probe_exit = 6
        self.probe_report = None
        self.probe_events = None
        self.probe_cli_rc = 0
        self.probe_error = None
        self.probe_write = True
        self.probe_stdout = None

    def fake_codex(self, argv, **kwargs):
        schema = json.loads(Path(argv[argv.index("--output-schema") + 1]).read_text())
        probe = list(schema["properties"]) == ["exit_code"]
        self.calls.append((probe, argv, kwargs))
        if probe and self.probe_error:
            raise self.probe_error
        output = Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1])
        if probe:
            command = "curl --max-time 5 --silent --show-error --output /dev/null https://example.com"
            self.assertIn(command, kwargs["input"])
            events = self.probe_events if self.probe_events is not None else [
                {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "command_execution", "command": command,
                 "exit_code": self.probe_exit, "status": "failed" if self.probe_exit else "completed"}},
                {"type": "turn.completed"}]
            if self.probe_write:
                output.write_text(json.dumps(self.probe_report if self.probe_report is not None else
                                            {"exit_code": self.probe_exit}))
            stdout = self.probe_stdout if self.probe_stdout is not None else "\n".join(json.dumps(event) for event in events)
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, self.probe_cli_rc, stdout, "")
        role = "councillor" if "verdict" in schema["properties"] else "worker"
        output.write_text(json.dumps(ANSWERS[role]))
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, '{"type":"turn.completed"}', "")

    def test_network_success_refuses_worker_before_its_task(self):
        self.probe_exit = 0
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
            result = self.runner("worker", "m02-build", "PRIVATE TASK", self.folder)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(result["error"], "Codex sandbox allowed network access; Codex bees refused")
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 1)
        self.assertTrue(self.calls[0][0])
        self.assertNotIn("PRIVATE TASK", self.calls[0][2]["input"])

    def test_native_network_refusal_allows_the_worker_with_identical_sandbox_config(self):
        self.runner.model, self.runner.effort = "chosen-model", "high"
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
            result = self.runner("worker", "m02-build", "PRIVATE TASK", self.folder)
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertNotIn("warning", result)
        self.assertEqual([probe for probe, _, _ in self.calls], [True, False])
        probe, bee = [call[1] for call in self.calls]
        for flag in ("--sandbox", "-C", "-m"):
            self.assertEqual(probe[probe.index(flag) + 1], bee[bee.index(flag) + 1])
        self.assertEqual(overrides(probe), overrides(bee))
        self.assertEqual(probe[probe.index("--sandbox") + 1], "workspace-write")
        self.assertEqual(overrides(probe)["approval_policy"], "never")
        self.assertEqual(set(overrides(probe)["mcp_servers"]), {"reverseai"})
        for flag in ("--ignore-user-config", "--json", "--ephemeral", "--skip-git-repo-check"):
            self.assertIn(flag, probe)
        self.assertIsNotNone(result["output"])

    def test_probe_outcomes_are_cached_per_sandbox_mode(self):
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
            for name in ("m02-build", "m04-build"):
                self.assertTrue(self.runner("worker", name, "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
            self.probe_exit = 0
            for name in ("m01-council-r1-io", "m01-council-r1-control"):
                self.assertFalse(self.runner("councillor", name, "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
            self.assertTrue(self.runner("worker", "m06-build", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
        probes = [argv for probe, argv, _ in self.calls if probe]
        self.assertEqual([argv[argv.index("--sandbox") + 1] for argv in probes], ["workspace-write", "read-only"])
        self.assertEqual(sum(not probe for probe, _, _ in self.calls), 3)

    def test_read_only_probe_can_allow_councillors(self):
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
            result = self.runner("councillor", "m01-council-r1-io", "TASK", self.folder)
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertTrue(all(argv[argv.index("--sandbox") + 1] == "read-only" for _, argv, _ in self.calls))

    def test_concurrent_workers_share_one_probe(self):
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
                results = list(pool.map(lambda n: self.runner("worker", f"m{n:02}-build", "TASK", self.folder),
                                        (2, 4, 6, 8)))
        self.assertTrue(all(result["ok"] for result in results), results)
        self.assertEqual(sum(probe for probe, _, _ in self.calls), 1)

    def test_probe_exceptions_missing_output_and_native_failure_are_refused_and_cached(self):
        for error in (subprocess.TimeoutExpired("codex", 7), FileNotFoundError("missing codex"),
                      OSError("cannot start")):
            with self.subTest(error=error):
                self.runner._network_checks.clear()
                self.calls.clear()
                self.probe_error = error
                with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
                    for name in ("m02-build", "m04-build"):
                        result = self.runner("worker", name, "TASK", self.folder)
                        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
                        self.assertEqual(result["error"], "Codex sandbox allowed network access; Codex bees refused")
                self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 1)
        self.probe_error = None
        for write, rc in ((False, 0), (True, 1)):
            self.runner._network_checks.clear()
            self.calls.clear()
            self.probe_write, self.probe_cli_rc = write, rc
            with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_codex):
                self.assertFalse(self.runner("worker", "m02-build", "TASK", self.folder)["ok"])
            self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 1)

    def test_missing_malformed_and_inconsistent_native_evidence_never_allows_a_bee(self):

class RoutingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.claude = Mock(return_value={"ok": True, "output": {"runner": "claude"}})
        self.codex = Mock(return_value={"ok": True, "output": {"runner": "codex"}})

    def test_mixed_routing_covers_the_queens_names_and_all_repair_rounds(self):
        runner = MixedBees(self.claude, self.codex)
        routes = [("planner", "planner", "claude"), ("planner", "planner-fix2", "claude"),
                  ("tester", "tester", "claude"), ("repair", "behaviour-fix-2", "claude"),
                  ("worker", "m01-build", "claude"), ("worker", "m02-build", "codex"),
                  ("worker", "m03-build", "claude"), ("worker", "m100-build", "codex"),
                  ("repair", "m01-repair-b1", "claude"), ("repair", "m02-repair-b3", "codex"),
                  ("repair", "m01-repair-c2", "claude"), ("repair", "m02-repair-c2", "codex"),
                  ("repair", "m01-repair-l2", "claude"), ("repair", "m02-repair-l3", "codex"),
                  ("councillor", "m01-council-r1-control", "codex"),
                  ("councillor", "m01-council-r1-io", "codex"),
                  ("councillor", "m01-council-r1-data", "claude"),
                  ("councillor", "m02-council-r2-control", "claude"),
                  ("councillor", "m02-council-r2-io", "claude"),
                  ("councillor", "m02-council-r2-data", "codex")]
        for role, name, expected in routes:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self.claude.reset_mock()
                self.codex.reset_mock()
                result = runner(role, name, "TASK", Path("bee"))
                selected, other = ((self.claude, self.codex) if expected == "claude" else (self.codex, self.claude))
                selected.assert_called_once_with(role, name, "TASK", Path("bee"))
                other.assert_not_called()
                self.assertIs(result, selected.return_value)

    def test_single_model_policies_route_every_role_to_that_model(self):
        for policy, selected, other in (("claude", self.claude, self.codex), ("codex", self.codex, self.claude)):
            runner = MixedBees(self.claude, self.codex, policy)
            for role in ("planner", "worker", "repair", "councillor", "tester"):
                selected.reset_mock()
                other.reset_mock()
                self.assertIs(runner(role, "any-name", "TASK", "bee"), selected.return_value)
                selected.assert_called_once_with(role, "any-name", "TASK", "bee")
                other.assert_not_called()

    def test_unknown_policy_and_ambiguous_module_names_are_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            MixedBees(self.claude, self.codex, "other")
        runner = MixedBees(self.claude, self.codex)
        for role, name in (("worker", "unknown"), ("worker", "m00-build"),
                           ("councillor", "m01-council-r1-unknown"), ("repair", "m02-repair-x1"), ("unknown", "")):
            self.assertFalse(runner(role, name, "TASK", "bee")["ok"])
        self.claude.assert_not_called()
        self.codex.assert_not_called()

    def test_cli_factory_preserves_claude_default_and_separates_codex_settings(self):
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        add_arguments(parser)
        self.assertIs(build(parser.parse_args([]), self.claude), self.claude)
        settings = {"engine": ".", "inputs": ".", "config_dir": ".", "timeout": 123}
        args = parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "mixed", "--codex", "/bin/codex-test",
                                  "--codex-model", "chosen-model", "--codex-effort", "high"])
        runner = build(args, self.claude, **settings)
        self.assertIsInstance(runner, MixedBees)
        self.assertIs(runner.claude, self.claude)
        self.assertEqual(runner.codex.codex, "/bin/codex-test")
        self.assertEqual(runner.codex.model, "chosen-model")
        self.assertEqual(runner.codex.effort, "high")
        self.assertEqual(runner.codex.timeout, 123)
        self.assertFalse(runner.codex.allow_network)
        self.assertIsInstance(build(parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex"]), self.claude, **settings), CodexBees)
        opted_out = build(parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex", "--codex-allow-network"]),
                          self.claude, **settings)
        self.assertTrue(opted_out.allow_network)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Regression oracles for the first Hive queen fix round; all agents are stand-ins."""

import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from tests.hive_compiler import confined
from hive import codex_bees, languages, queen
from tests.test_hive_queen import CONTRACT, GOOD, WRONG_EXIT, FakeBees, FakeEngine, FakeRouter, make_queen


class RecordedBees(FakeBees):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(kwargs.pop("sources", GOOD), **kwargs)
        self.trace = []
        self.reviewed = {}
        self.worker_override = None
        self.missing = set()

    def __call__(self, role, name, task, folder):
        folder = Path(folder)
        self.trace.append((role, name))
        if role == "councillor":
            source = next(folder.glob("unit-*"))
            self.reviewed.setdefault(name.split("-")[0], []).append(hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
            if name.rsplit("-", 1)[-1] in self.missing:
                return {"ok": False, "output": None, "error": "seat unavailable"}
        result = super().__call__(role, name, task, folder)
        if role in ("worker", "repair"):
            entries = {"m01": ["0x1040"], "m02": ["0x1000"]}
            mids = list(self.repaired) if folder.parent.name == "fixes" else [folder.name]
            result["output"] = {"status": "done", "functions": [
                {"entry": entry, "status": "rebuilt"} for mid in mids for entry in entries.get(mid, [])]}
            if role == "worker" and self.worker_override is not None:
                result["output"] = self.worker_override
        return result


@unittest.skipUnless(confined("c"), "needs a Clang compiler the hive can confine")
class QueenFixTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-queen-fixes-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.inputs = self.root / "inputs"
        self.inputs.mkdir()
        (self.inputs / "greet").write_text("Inert input: behaviour execution is simulated.\n")
        self.run_number = 0

    def make(self, bees=None, **kwargs):
        bees = bees or RecordedBees()
        def check(claims, out):
            bees.trace.append(("check", "check"))
            count = len(json.loads(Path(claims).read_text())["claims"])
            return {"claims": count, "confirmed": count, "rejected": 0, "questions": 1,
                    "input_sha256": ["cd" * 32]}, []
        self.run_number += 1
        q = make_queen(engine=FakeEngine(self.inputs), out=self.root / f"run{self.run_number}", bees=bees,
                        check=check, slots=2, compile_rounds=0, **kwargs)
        return q, bees

    def run_quietly(self, q):
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            return q.run()

    def test_every_configured_seat_is_required(self):
        q, bees = self.make()
        bees.missing = {"io", "data"}
        result = self.run_quietly(q)
        self.assertEqual(set(result["modules"].values()), {"incomplete"})
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "not accepted")

    def test_a_refused_non_author_majority_is_incomplete(self):
        q, bees = self.make()
        def refused(role, name, task, folder):
            if role == "councillor":
                return {"ok": False, "output": None, "error": codex_bees.NETWORK_REFUSAL}
            return bees(role, name, task, folder)
        q.bees = FakeRouter(codex_bees.MixedBees(bees, refused))
        result = self.run_quietly(q)
        self.assertEqual(result["modules"]["m01"], "incomplete")
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "not accepted")

    def test_link_repair_reviews_the_final_source(self):
        fake = RecordedBees(sources={"m01": '#include "contract.h"\n', "m02": GOOD["m02"]},
                            repaired={"m01": GOOD["m01"]})
        q, _ = self.make(fake)
        result = self.run_quietly(q)
        final = hashlib.sha256((q.out / "modules/m01/m01.c").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        self.assertIn(final, fake.reviewed["m01"])
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "accepted without behaviour proof")

    def test_a_late_council_veto_is_kept_in_the_final_result(self):
        class LateVeto(RecordedBees):
            def __call__(self, role, name, task, folder):
                result = super().__call__(role, name, task, folder)
                if role == "councillor" and name.startswith("m01-council-r2-"):
                    result["output"] = {"verdict": "refute", "defects": [
                        {"function": "greet_line", "problem": "synthetic late veto", "evidence": "0x1040"}]}
                return result
        fake = LateVeto(sources={"m01": '#include "contract.h"\n', "m02": GOOD["m02"]},
                        repaired={"m01": GOOD["m01"]})
        q, _ = self.make(fake)
        result = self.run_quietly(q)
        self.assertEqual(result["modules"]["m01"], "disputed")
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "not accepted")

    def test_behaviour_repair_reviews_then_checks_final_source(self):
        cases = [{"id": "a", "steps": [{"args": []}]}, {"id": "b", "steps": [{"args": ["x"]}]}]
        fake = RecordedBees(sources={"m01": GOOD["m01"], "m02": WRONG_EXIT},
                            repaired={"m02": GOOD["m02"]}, cases=cases)
        q, _ = self.make(fake, run_original=True)
        def execute(cases, binary, folder, timeout=20):
            original = "/original/" in str(binary)
            correct = (q.out / "modules/m02/m02.c").read_text() == GOOD["m02"]
            return {c["id"]: {"steps": [{"code": 0 if original or correct else 1}], "files": {}} for c in cases}
        with patch.object(queen, "run_cases", side_effect=execute):
            result = self.run_quietly(q)
        final = hashlib.sha256((q.out / "modules/m02/m02.c").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        self.assertIn(final, fake.reviewed["m02"])
        repair_at = fake.trace.index(("repair", "behaviour-fix-1"))
        after = [role for role, _ in fake.trace[repair_at + 1:]]
        self.assertIn("councillor", after)
        self.assertIn("check", after)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "accepted")

    def test_failed_behaviour_relink_never_proves_the_old_binary(self):
        duplicate = GOOD["m02"] + 'int greet_line(const char *name) { return 0; }\n'
        cases = [{"id": "a", "steps": [{"args": []}]}, {"id": "b", "steps": [{"args": ["x"]}]}]
        q, _ = self.make(RecordedBees(repaired={"m02": duplicate}, cases=cases), run_original=True)
        rebuilt_runs = []
        def execute(cases, binary, folder, timeout=20):
            original = "/original/" in str(binary)
            if not original:
                rebuilt_runs.append(binary)
            code = 1 if not original and len(rebuilt_runs) == 1 else 0
            return {c["id"]: {"steps": [{"code": code}], "files": {}} for c in cases}
        with patch.object(queen, "run_cases", side_effect=execute):
            result = self.run_quietly(q)
        objects = [str(q.build.folder / "obj" / f"{mid}.o") for mid in ("m01", "m02")]
        control = subprocess.run([q.build.cc, *objects, "-o", str(self.root / "relink-control")],
                                 capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertNotEqual(control.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "not accepted")
        self.assertFalse(result["link"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["binary"])
        self.assertFalse((q.build.folder / "bin/greet").exists())
        self.assertEqual(len(rebuilt_runs), 1)

    def test_repairs_merge_reports_for_only_the_touched_entries(self):
        both = GOOD["m01"] + GOOD["m02"]
        class PartialRepair(RecordedBees):
            def __call__(self, role, name, task, folder):
                folder = Path(folder)
                if role == "planner":
                    self.calls.append((role, name))
                    (folder / "contract.h").write_text(CONTRACT)
                    return {"ok": True, "output": {"modules": [
                        {"title": "all", "functions": ["0x1000", "0x1040"]}],
                        "skipped": [{"entry": "0x1080", "reason": "import"}]}}
                if role in ("worker", "repair"):
                    self.calls.append((role, name))
                    (folder / "m01.c").write_text(both)
                    (folder / "claims.json").write_text(json.dumps({"claims": [
                        {"id": "x", "text": "fixture", "citations": []}]}))
                    entries = ["0x1000", "0x1040"] if role == "worker" else ["0x1000"]
                    return {"ok": True, "output": {"status": "done", "functions": [
                        {"entry": entry, "status": "rebuilt"} for entry in entries]}}
                return super().__call__(role, name, task, folder)
        q, _ = self.make(PartialRepair(refute_first={"m01"}))
        result = self.run_quietly(q)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "accepted without behaviour proof", result["reason"])
        status = json.loads((q.out / "modules/m01/status.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual({row["entry"] for row in status["worker"]["functions"]}, {"0x1000", "0x1040"})

    def test_unsupported_compiler_is_refused_before_the_planner(self):

    def test_resume_rebuilds_objects_from_an_older_compiler_policy(self):

    def test_empty_or_colliding_cases_never_prove_behaviour(self):

    def test_resume_does_not_trust_a_builders_forged_status(self):
        q, bees = self.make()
        self.assertEqual(self.run_quietly(q)["verdict"], "accepted without behaviour proof")
        source = q.out / "modules/m01/m01.c"
        forged = json.loads((source.parent / "status.json").read_text())
        source.write_text(GOOD["m01"] + "\n/* synthetic unreviewed change */\n")
        changed_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        forged.setdefault("compiled", {})["source_sha256"] = changed_hash
        forged.setdefault("reviewed", {})["source_sha256"] = changed_hash
        (source.parent / "status.json").write_text(json.dumps(forged))
        count = bees.calls.count(("worker", "m01-build"))
        try:
            result = self.run_quietly(q)
        except PermissionError as error:
            self.fail(f"resume cannot validate the modified module: {error}")
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "accepted without behaviour proof")
        self.assertEqual(bees.calls.count(("worker", "m01-build")), count + 1)

    def test_citation_file_overrides_cannot_redirect_the_checker(self):

    def test_frozen_contract_resume(self):

    def test_relative_output_path(self):

        finally:

@unittest.skipUnless(confined("c"), "needs a Clang compiler the hive can confine")
class CompilerBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-compiler-fixes-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.source = self.root / "m01.c"
        self.header = self.root / "contract.h"
        self.secret = self.root / "outside.h"
        self.token = "SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_HEADER_VALUE_482901"
        self.secret.write_text("#warning " + self.token + "\n")
        self.header.write_text("int main(void);\n")
        self.build = queen.Build(self.root / "build")

    def compile(self, text):
        self.source.write_text(text)
        return self.build.compile("m01", self.source, self.header)

    def test_external_absolute_relative_computed_and_include_next_are_unreadable(self):
        for directive in (f'#include "{self.secret}"', f'#define H "{self.secret}"\n#include H',
                          '#include "../../../outside.h"', f'#include_next "{self.secret}"'):
            with self.subTest(directive=directive):
                result = self.compile(directive + "\nint main(void) { return 0; }\n")
                self.assertNotIn(self.token, json.dumps(result))
                self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)

    def test_has_include_cannot_observe_an_external_file(self):
        result = self.compile(f'#if __has_include("{self.secret}")\n#error EXTERNAL_EXISTS\n#endif\n'
                              'int main(void) { return 0; }\n')
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result)

    def test_assembler_cannot_include_or_embed_host_files_from_a_system_header_macro(self):
        binary = self.root / "outside.bin"
        binary.write_bytes(b"SYNTHETIC_BIN_9911")
        payloads = [f'.include \\"{self.secret}\\"',
                    f'.data\\n.globl _hv_blob\\n_hv_blob:\\n.inc" "bin \\"{binary}\\"\\n.byte 0']
        for payload in payloads:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                text = ('#define J(a,b) a ## b\n'
                        '#define remove hv_pad(void); J(__as,m__)("' + payload + '"); int hv_remove\n'
                        '#include <stdio.h>\n#include "contract.h"\nint main(void) { return 0; }\n')
                result = self.compile(text)
                obj = self.build.folder / "obj/m01.o"
                embedded = obj.is_file() and binary.read_bytes() in obj.read_bytes()
                self.assertEqual((result["ok"], self.token in json.dumps(result), embedded),
                                 (False, False, False), result)

    def test_cpp_raw_string_line_markers_do_not_hide_assembler_file_reads(self):
        header = self.root / "contract.hpp"
        header.write_text("int main();\n")
        source = self.root / "m.cpp"
        source.write_text('#include "contract.hpp"\n#define J(a,b) a ## b\n'
                          'static const char *hv = R"q(\\\n# 300 "/trusted/system/header.h" 3\n)q";\n'
                          f'J(__as,m__)(".include \\"{self.secret}\\"");\n'
                          'int main() { return hv[0] == 0; }\n')
        result = queen.Build(self.root / "cpp-build", language=languages.CPP).compile("m01", source, header)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertNotIn(self.token, json.dumps(result))

    def test_original_macro_context_does_not_add_preprocessed_input_warnings(self):
        result = self.compile('#include "contract.h"\n#define EQ(a,b) ((a) == (b))\n'
                              'static int f(int x) { if (EQ(x, 1)) return 1; return 0; }\n'
                              'int main(void) { return f(0); }\n')
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertEqual(result["warnings"], "")

    def test_preprocessor_output_is_bounded(self):
        definitions = ['#define L0 0,']
        definitions += [f'#define L{i} ' + ' '.join([f'L{i-1}'] * 10) for i in range(1, 6)]
        text = '\n'.join(definitions) + '\nint values[] = { L5 };\nint main(void) { return values[0]; }\n'
        with patch.object(queen, "MAX_COMPILER_STDOUT", 32768, create=True):
            result = self.compile(text)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertIn("output limit", result["errors"])

    def test_macro_assembly_and_header_assembly_are_rejected(self):
        result = self.compile('#define JOIN(a,b) a ## b\nint main(void) { JOIN(__as,m__)("nop"); return 0; }\n')
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)
        self.header.write_text('#define SAFE_NOP __asm__\nint main(void);\n')
        result = self.compile('#include "contract.h"\nint main(void) { SAFE_NOP("nop"); return 0; }\n')
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)

    def test_generated_linker_pragmas_cannot_add_host_file_inputs(self):
        for prefix in (f'#pragma comment(lib, "{self.secret}")\n',
                       '_Pragma(' + json.dumps(f'comment(lib, "{self.secret}")') + ')\n'):
            with self.subTest(prefix=prefix):
                result = self.compile(prefix + 'int main(void) { return 0; }\n')
                self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)
    def test_planner_header_has_the_same_boundary(self):
        self.header.write_text(f'#include "{self.secret}"\n')
        ok, diagnostics = self.build.syntax(self.header)
        self.assertNotIn(self.token, diagnostics)
        self.assertFalse(ok)

    def test_external_diagnostics_are_not_forwarded_to_a_repair_bee(self):
        self.source.write_text(f'#include "{self.secret}"\nint main(void) {{ return 0; }}\n')
        prompts = []
        def repair(role, name, task, folder):
            prompts.append(task)
            return {"ok": False, "output": None}
        q = make_queen(engine=None, out=self.root / "repair-run", bees=repair, compile_rounds=1)
        folder = q.out / "modules/m01"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        source, header = folder / self.source.name, folder / self.header.name
        shutil.copyfile(self.source, source)
        shutil.copyfile(self.header, header)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            result = q.compile_loop("m01", folder, source, header, {})
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertTrue(prompts)
        self.assertNotIn(self.token, "\n".join(prompts))

    def test_a_symlink_source_is_not_copied_into_the_stage(self):
        self.source.symlink_to(self.secret)
        result = self.build.compile("m01", self.source, self.header)
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertNotIn(self.token, json.dumps(result))

    def test_standard_headers_and_frozen_contract_still_compile(self):
        self.header.write_text('#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void);\n')
        result = self.compile('#include "contract.h"\nint main(void) { return puts("safe"); }\n')
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"], result)
        self.assertEqual(result["warnings"], "")

from tests.test_hive_queen import FakePlanning, FakeRouter, make_queen

from hive import fuzz, queen

SHA = "ab" * 32
CASES = [{"id": "first", "files": [{"name": "input.bin", "text": "seed"}],
          "steps": [{"args": ["--read", "input.bin"], "stdin": "input.bin"}]},
         {"id": "second", "files": [{"name": "input.bin", "text": "more"}],

class MutationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_each_source_exercises_every_mutator_without_cycle_aliasing(self):
        for total_sources in (2, 3, 6, 12, 40):
            sources = [{"id":f"c{index:02d}", "files":[{"name":"input","text":f"source-{index:02d}-"*8}],
                        "steps":[{"args":["input"]}]} for index in range(total_sources)]
            seen = {}
            real = fuzz.mutate
            def observe(data, operation, *args):
                seen.setdefault(data,set()).add(operation)
                return real(data,operation,*args)
            with self.subTest(sources=total_sources), patch.object(fuzz,"mutate",side_effect=observe):
                fuzz.generate(sources,SHA,500,queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
            self.assertEqual(len(seen),total_sources)
            self.assertTrue(all(operations == set(fuzz.MUTATORS) for operations in seen.values()),seen)

    def test_no_source_equivalent_or_duplicate_inputs_are_counted(self):
        def effective(case):
            files = {str(Path(item["name"])):base64.b64decode(item["base64"]) if item.get("base64")
                     else item.get("text","").encode() for item in case["files"]}
            return tuple(sorted(files.items())), json.dumps(case["steps"],sort_keys=True)
        examples = [CASES, [{"id":"empty","files":[{"name":"f","text":""}],"steps":[{"args":["f"]}]}],
                    [{"id":"alias","files":[{"name":"f","text":"hidden"},{"name":"./f","text":"live"}],
                      "steps":[{"args":["./f"]}]}]]
        for sources in examples:
            with self.subTest(sources=sources):
                mutants = fuzz.generate(sources,SHA,500,queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
                inputs = [effective(case) for case in mutants]
                self.assertTrue(inputs)
                self.assertFalse(set(inputs) & {effective(case) for case in sources})
                self.assertEqual(len(inputs),len(set(inputs)))

    def test_retries_are_bounded_when_every_mutation_is_a_noop(self):
        calls = 0
        def unchanged(data, *args):
            nonlocal calls
            calls += 1
            if calls > 1000:
                self.fail("unbounded retries for unchanged input")
            return data
        with patch.object(fuzz,"mutate",side_effect=unchanged):
            self.assertEqual(fuzz.generate(CASES,SHA,3,queen.MAX_CASE_FILE),[])
        self.assertLessEqual(calls,1000)

    def test_skipped_file_entries_are_filtered_before_base64_decoding(self):
        ignored = [{"name":"../escape","base64":"abc"}, {"name":".","base64":"abc"},
                   {"name":"folder/../..","base64":"abc"}, {"name":"/outside","base64":"abc"}]
        sources = [{"id":"only-skipped","files":ignored,"steps":[{"args":[]}]},
                   {"id":"kept","files":[{"name":"in","text":"content"},*ignored],
                    "steps":[{"args":["in"]}]}]
        try:
            mutants = fuzz.generate(sources,SHA,20,queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        except Exception as error:
            self.fail(f"a file run_cases skips was decoded: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        self.assertTrue(mutants)
        self.assertTrue(all(case["id"].startswith("fz-kept-") for case in mutants))
        self.assertTrue(all([item["name"] for item in case["files"]] == ["in"] for case in mutants))

    def test_small_budget_includes_boundary_inputs_among_many_source_cases(self):
        cases = [{"id":str(index), "files":[{"name":"input","text":chr(65 + index)*64}],
                  "steps":[{"args":["input"]}]} for index in range(6)]
        mutants = fuzz.generate(cases, SHA, 6, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        self.assertTrue(any(byte in fuzz.BOUNDARIES for case in mutants for item in case["files"]
                            for byte in base64.b64decode(item["base64"])))

    def test_every_mutator_changes_only_bounded_bytes(self):
        data, donor = b"abcdefgh", b"XYZ"
        outputs = {operation: fuzz.mutate(data, operation, random.Random(7), 16, donor)
                   for operation in fuzz.MUTATORS}
        self.assertEqual(sum((a ^ b).bit_count() for a, b in zip(data, outputs["bitflip"])), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(outputs["insert"]), len(data) + 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(outputs["delete"]), len(data) - 1)
        self.assertTrue(data.startswith(outputs["truncate"]))
        self.assertLess(len(outputs["truncate"]), len(data))
        changed = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(data, outputs["boundary"]) if a != b]
        self.assertEqual(len(changed), 1)
        self.assertIn(changed[0][1], fuzz.BOUNDARIES)
        self.assertTrue(any(value in outputs["splice"] for value in donor))
        for operation in fuzz.MUTATORS:
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                self.assertLessEqual(len(fuzz.mutate(data * 100, operation, random.Random(2), 8, donor * 100)), 8)
                self.assertLessEqual(len(fuzz.mutate(b"", operation, random.Random(2), 8, b"")), 8)

    def test_seed_is_repeatable_bound_to_input_and_source_id(self):
        before = copy.deepcopy(CASES)
        first = fuzz.generate(CASES, SHA, 36, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        self.assertEqual(first, fuzz.generate(CASES, SHA, 36, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE))
        self.assertEqual(first, fuzz.generate(list(reversed(CASES)), SHA, 36, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE))
        self.assertNotEqual(first, fuzz.generate(CASES, "cd" * 32, 36, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE))
        renamed = copy.deepcopy(CASES)
        renamed[0]["id"] = "another"
        changed_seed = fuzz.generate(renamed, SHA, 36, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        self.assertNotEqual([case["files"] for case in first], [case["files"] for case in changed_seed])
        self.assertEqual(CASES, before)
        for mutant in first:
            source = CASES[0] if mutant["id"].startswith("fz-first-") else CASES[1]
            self.assertEqual(mutant["steps"], source["steps"])
            self.assertEqual([f["name"] for f in mutant["files"]], [f["name"] for f in source["files"]])

    def test_total_cap_off_and_unique_normalised_ids(self):
        sources = copy.deepcopy(CASES)
        sources[0]["id"], sources[1]["id"] = "x" * 63 + "a", "x" * 63 + "b"
        sources.append({"id": "fz-" + "x" * 59 + "-1", "steps": [{"args": []}]})
        mutants = fuzz.generate(sources, SHA, 500, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        names = [case["id"] for case in mutants]
        self.assertEqual(len(names), 500)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(names)), 500)
        self.assertFalse(set(names) & {case["id"] for case in sources})
        self.assertTrue(all(len(name) <= 64 for name in names))
        self.assertTrue(all(name.startswith("fz-") for name in names))
        self.assertEqual(fuzz.generate(CASES, SHA, 0, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE), [])
        self.assertEqual(fuzz.generate([{"id":"args-only","steps":[{"args":["x"]}]}], SHA, 5,
                                       queen.MAX_CASE_FILE), [])
        for value in (-1, 501, True, 1.5, "2.0"):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                fuzz.generate(CASES, SHA, value, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)

    def test_all_files_are_capped_and_stdin_is_mutatable(self):
        cases = [{"id":"stdin", "files":[{"name":"stdin.bin","base64":base64.b64encode(b"a"*100000).decode()},
                                          {"name":"other","text":"z"*100000}],
                  "steps":[{"args":["literal"],"stdin":"stdin.bin"}]}]
        mutants = fuzz.generate(cases, SHA, 24, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        decoded = [[base64.b64decode(item["base64"]) for item in case["files"]] for case in mutants]
        self.assertTrue(all(len(data) <= queen.MAX_CASE_FILE for files in decoded for data in files))
        self.assertTrue(any(files[0] != b"a"*queen.MAX_CASE_FILE for files in decoded))
        self.assertTrue(all(case["steps"] == cases[0]["steps"] for case in mutants))


class DifferentialTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-fuzz-test-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()

    def test_a_mutant_finds_a_rebuild_bug_missing_from_the_plain_cases(self):
        runs = self.root / "runs"
        runs.mkdir()
        calls = []
        def fake_binary(argv, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(kwargs["env"], {"PATH":"/usr/bin:/bin","LC_ALL":"C"})
            self.assertEqual(kwargs["timeout"], 20)
            data = (Path(kwargs["cwd"]) / "input.bin").read_bytes()
            value = len(data) + (argv[0] == "rebuilt" and b"\xff" in data)
            calls.append((argv[0], list(argv[1:])))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, str(value).encode(), b"")
        mutants = fuzz.generate(CASES, SHA, 100, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        with patch.object(queen.subprocess, "run", side_effect=fake_binary):
            original = queen.run_cases(CASES, "original", runs)
            rebuilt = queen.run_cases(CASES, "rebuilt", runs)
            self.assertEqual(queen.compare(original, rebuilt)[1], [])
            original = queen.run_cases(mutants, "original", runs)
            rebuilt = queen.run_cases(mutants, "rebuilt", runs)
        summary = fuzz.summarise(mutants, original, rebuilt, SHA, queen.compare)
        self.assertTrue(summary["ran"])
        self.assertTrue(summary["different"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["cases"], 100)
        self.assertEqual(summary["identical"] + len(summary["different"]), 100)
        self.assertEqual(list(runs.iterdir()), [])  # the existing executor removes each fresh folder
        path = self.root / "fuzz.json"
        fuzz.write_report(path, summary, mutants)
        report = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual({case["id"] for case in report["inputs"]}, set(summary["different"]))
        self.assertTrue(all(b"\xff" in base64.b64decode(case["files"][0]["base64"]) for case in report["inputs"]))
        self.assertEqual(report["seed"], SHA)

    def test_incomplete_or_timed_out_results_never_count_as_a_fuzz_proof(self):
        mutants = fuzz.generate(CASES, SHA, 2, queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        good = {case["id"]:{"steps":[{"code":0}]} for case in mutants}
        for broken, completed in (({},0), ({mutants[0]["id"]:good[mutants[0]["id"]]},1),
                                  ({case["id"]:{"steps":[{"code":"timeout"}]} for case in mutants},0),
                                  ({case["id"]:{"steps":[]} for case in mutants},0)):
            with self.subTest(broken=broken):
                result = fuzz.summarise(mutants, good, broken, SHA, queen.compare)
                self.assertFalse(result["ran"])
                self.assertEqual(result["identical"],completed)
                self.assertEqual(result["completed"],completed)
                self.assertEqual(len(result["incomplete"]),len(mutants)-completed)

    def test_partial_fuzz_compares_complete_pairs_and_keeps_incomplete_ids(self):
        cases = [{"id":name,"steps":[{"args":[]}]} for name in
                 ("equal","different","missing-right","missing-left","timeout","both-timeout")]
        original = {case["id"]:{"steps":[{"code":0,"out":"original"}]} for case in cases}
        rebuilt = copy.deepcopy(original)
        rebuilt["different"]["steps"][0]["out"] = "changed"
        del rebuilt["missing-right"]
        del original["missing-left"]
        rebuilt["timeout"]["steps"][0]["code"] = "timeout"
        original["both-timeout"]["steps"][0]["code"] = "timeout"
        rebuilt["both-timeout"]["steps"][0]["code"] = "timeout"
        summary = fuzz.summarise(cases,original,rebuilt,SHA,queen.compare)
        self.assertEqual(summary["different"],["different"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["identical"],1)
        self.assertEqual(summary.get("incomplete"),["missing-right","missing-left","timeout","both-timeout"])
        self.assertEqual(summary.get("completed"),2)
        self.assertFalse(summary["ran"])

    def test_inputs_include_differing_and_incomplete_mutants(self):
        cases = fuzz.generate(CASES,SHA,3,queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        summary = {"cases":3,"identical":1,"different":[cases[1]["id"]],"incomplete":[cases[2]["id"]],
                   "seed":SHA,"ran":False}
        path = self.root/"fuzz.json"
        fuzz.write_report(path,summary,cases)
        report = json.loads(path.read_text())
        self.assertEqual([case["id"] for case in report["inputs"]],[cases[1]["id"],cases[2]["id"]])

    def test_both_sides_timeout_is_incomplete_even_when_the_rows_are_equal(self):
        cases = fuzz.generate(CASES,SHA,2,queen.MAX_CASE_FILE)
        timed = {case["id"]:{"steps":[{"code":"timeout"}],"files":{}} for case in cases}
        summary = fuzz.summarise(cases,timed,copy.deepcopy(timed),SHA,queen.compare)
        self.assertFalse(summary["ran"])
        self.assertEqual(summary["identical"],0)
        self.assertEqual(summary["different"],[])
        self.assertEqual(summary.get("incomplete"),[case["id"] for case in cases])


class QueenFuzzTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-fuzz-queen-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.input = self.root / "owned-input"
        self.input.write_bytes(b"Owned inert input; every execution is simulated.\n")
        self.out = self.root / "run"
        (self.out / "survey").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.out / "survey/map.json").write_text("{}")

    def make(self, *, permission=True, total=12, rounds=0):
        def tester(role, name, task, folder):
            self.assertEqual(role, "tester")
            return {"ok":True,"output":{"cases":copy.deepcopy(CASES)}}
        return make_queen(engine=SimpleNamespace(path=self.input,file="owned-input"), out=self.out, bees=tester,
                           run_original=permission, fuzz=total, behaviour_rounds=rounds)

    def execution(self, cases, binary, folder):
        return {case["id"]:{"steps":[{"code":0,"out":"same"} for _ in case["steps"]]} for case in cases}

    def conformance(self, q, execution):
        with patch.object(queen, "run_cases", side_effect=execution), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            return q.conformance("first-rebuild", [], self.root / "unused-contract")

    def test_fuzz_runs_after_behaviour_repairs_on_the_final_binary(self):
        q = self.make(rounds=1)
        trace = []
        def execute(cases, binary, folder):
            trace.append((str(binary), [case["id"] for case in cases]))
            answer = self.execution(cases, binary, folder)
            if binary == "first-rebuild":
                for row in answer.values():row["steps"][0]["out"] = "wrong"
            return answer
        with patch.object(q, "behaviour_fix", return_value={"ok":True,"binary":"final-rebuild"}) as repair:
            result = self.conformance(q, execute)
        repair.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual([binary for binary, _ in trace][-2:],
                         [str(self.out / "tests/original/owned-input"), "final-rebuild"])
        self.assertEqual(result["cases"], len(CASES) + 12)
        self.assertEqual(result["identical"], result["cases"])
        self.assertEqual(result["different"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["fuzz"]["cases"], 12)
        self.assertEqual(result["fuzz"]["seed"], hashlib.sha256(self.input.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        self.assertTrue((self.out / "tests/fuzz.json").is_file())

    def test_fuzz_differences_are_reported_without_starting_a_repair_round(self):
        q = self.make(rounds=2)
        def execute(cases, binary, folder):
            answer = self.execution(cases, binary, folder)
            if binary == "first-rebuild" and cases[0]["id"].startswith("fz-"):
                answer[cases[0]["id"]]["steps"][0]["out"] = "fuzz-only difference"
            return answer
        with patch.object(q, "behaviour_fix", side_effect=AssertionError("no fuzz repair")):
            result = self.conformance(q, execute)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["different"]), 1)
        self.assertTrue(result["different"][0].startswith("fz-"))
        self.assertEqual(result["identical"], result["cases"] - 1)
        report = {"file":"owned-input","input_sha256":SHA,"functions":1,"skipped":0,"modules":{},
                  "link":True,"check":None,"claims":0,"conformance":result,"preflight":None,
                  "verdict":"not accepted","reason":"fuzz difference"}
        self.assertIn("(12 fuzz)",queen.render(report))
        details = json.loads((self.out / "tests/fuzz.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual([case["id"] for case in details["inputs"]], result["different"])

    def test_missing_fuzz_execution_invalidates_conformance(self):
        q = self.make()
        def execute(cases, binary, folder):
            if binary == "first-rebuild" and cases[0]["id"].startswith("fz-"):
                return {}
            return self.execution(cases, binary, folder)
        result = self.conformance(q, execute)
        self.assertFalse(result["ran"])
        self.assertIn("incomplete", result["reason"])
        self.assertFalse(result["fuzz"]["ran"])

    def test_partial_fuzz_preserves_the_plain_result_and_every_reproduction_input(self):
        q = self.make()
        mutant_ids = []
        def execute(cases, binary, folder):
            answer = self.execution(cases,binary,folder)
            if not cases[0]["id"].startswith("fz-"):
                if binary == "first-rebuild":
                    answer["first"]["steps"][0]["out"] = "plain difference"
                return answer
            mutant_ids[:] = [case["id"] for case in cases]
            answer[mutant_ids[3]]["steps"][0]["code"] = "timeout"  # both sides
            if binary == "first-rebuild":
                answer[mutant_ids[0]]["steps"][0]["out"] = "fuzz difference"
                answer[mutant_ids[1]]["steps"][0]["code"] = "timeout"
                del answer[mutant_ids[2]]
            return answer
        result = self.conformance(q,execute)
        self.assertFalse(result["ran"])
        self.assertEqual(result["different"],["first",mutant_ids[0]])
        self.assertEqual(result.get("incomplete"),mutant_ids[1:4])
        self.assertEqual(result.get("plain",{}).get("different"),["first"])
        self.assertEqual(result["identical"],9)
        self.assertEqual(result.get("completed"),11)
        verdict = q.verdict({"input_sha256":SHA,"functions":[]},[],[],[],{"ok":True,"binary":"fake"},
                            {"claims":1,"confirmed":1,"rejected":0,"input_sha256":[SHA]},1,result)
        self.assertEqual(verdict["verdict"],"not accepted")
        for name in ["first",*mutant_ids[:4]]:
            self.assertIn(name,verdict["reason"])
        line = next(line for line in queen.render(verdict).splitlines() if line.startswith("- Conformance:"))
        self.assertIn("1/2 plain",line)
        self.assertIn("incomplete",line)
        self.assertNotIn("not run",line)
        report = json.loads((self.out/"tests/fuzz.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual({case["id"] for case in report["inputs"]},set(mutant_ids[:4]))

    def test_stale_fuzz_report_is_removed_before_a_new_conformance_attempt(self):
        path = self.out/"tests/fuzz.json"
        path.parent.mkdir()
        for failed_tester in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(failed_tester=failed_tester):
                path.write_text('{"old":true}')
                q = self.make(total=0)
                if failed_tester:
                    q.bees = FakeRouter(lambda *args: {"ok":False,"error":"no cases"})
                self.conformance(q,self.execution)
                self.assertFalse(path.exists())

    def test_plain_incomplete_conformance_never_starts_fuzzing(self):
        q = self.make()
        with patch.object(fuzz, "generate", side_effect=AssertionError("plain proof incomplete")):
            result = self.conformance(q, lambda cases, binary, folder: {})
        self.assertFalse(result["ran"])
        self.assertNotIn("fuzz", result)

    def test_off_or_without_permission_never_adds_an_execution_path(self):
        for permission, total in ((True, 0), (False, 12)):
            with self.subTest(permission=permission,total=total), \
                 patch.object(fuzz,"generate",side_effect=AssertionError("fuzz is off")):
                q = self.make(permission=permission,total=total)
                result = self.conformance(q,self.execution)
                self.assertNotIn("fuzz", result)
                self.assertEqual(result["cases"], len(CASES))

    def test_cases_without_files_report_zero_mutants_and_do_not_mutate_arguments(self):
        q = self.make()
        plain = [{"id":"a","steps":[{"args":["literal"]}]}, {"id":"b","steps":[{"args":[]}]}]
        q.bees = FakeRouter(lambda *args: {"ok":True,"output":{"cases":copy.deepcopy(plain)}})
        with patch.object(queen,"run_cases",side_effect=self.execution) as execute, \
             contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            result = q.conformance("first-rebuild",[],self.root/"unused")
        self.assertEqual(execute.call_count,2)
        self.assertTrue(result["ran"])
        self.assertEqual(result["cases"],2)
        self.assertEqual(result["fuzz"]["cases"],0)
        self.assertIn("no case files",result["fuzz"]["reason"])

    def test_cli_forwards_the_bound_and_original_permission(self):
        with patch.object(queen.bees_module,"environment_ok",return_value=True), \
             patch.object(queen,"Queen") as factory:
            factory.return_value.run.return_value={"verdict":"accepted"}
            self.assertEqual(queen.main(["run","--inputs",str(self.root),"--file",self.input.name,
                                         "--out",str(self.out),"--run-original","--fuzz","15"]),0)
        self.assertEqual(factory.call_args.kwargs["fuzz"],15)
        self.assertTrue(factory.call_args.kwargs["run_original"])
        self.assertIs(factory.call_args.kwargs["planning"], queen.planning_module)
        self.assertIsInstance(factory.call_args.kwargs["bees"], queen.selfhost.BeeRouter)
        for value in ("-1","501"):
            with self.subTest(value=value), contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()), self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as caught:
                queen.main(["run","--inputs",str(self.root),"--file",self.input.name,"--out",str(self.out),"--fuzz",value])
            self.assertEqual(caught.exception.code,2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

PACKED = {"verdict": "packed", "packers": ["UPX"], "signals": [
    {"strength": "strong", "signal": "packer section", "detail": "segment named 'UPX1' belongs to UPX"}],

class IntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        (self.tmp / "inputs").mkdir()
        (self.tmp / "inputs" / "greet").write_bytes(b"x")

    def queen(self, bees, verdict, **kwargs):
        def check(claims, out):
            return {"claims": 1, "confirmed": 1, "rejected": 0, "questions": 1,
                    "input_sha256": ["cd" * 32]}, []
        return make_queen(engine=FakeEngine(self.tmp / "inputs"), out=self.tmp / "run", bees=bees, slots=2,
                           check=check, preflight=lambda engine, program_map, folder: verdict, **kwargs)

    def test_a_packed_program_stops_before_any_bee(self):
        bees = FakeBees(GOOD)
        result = self.queen(bees, PACKED).run()
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "not started")
        self.assertIn("UPX", result["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(bees.calls, [])
        report = (self.tmp / "run" / "REPORT.md").read_text()
        self.assertIn("Pre-flight: packed", report)
        self.assertIn("Language: not chosen", report)

    @unittest.skipUnless(confined("c"), "needs a Clang compiler the hive can confine")
    def test_the_operator_can_allow_a_packed_program(self):
        bees = FakeBees(GOOD)
        result = self.queen(bees, PACKED, allow_packed=True).run()
        self.assertTrue(bees.calls)
        self.assertEqual(result["preflight"]["verdict"], "packed")

    @unittest.skipUnless(confined("c"), "needs a Clang compiler the hive can confine")
    def test_a_clean_program_runs_and_reports_its_preflight(self):
        result = self.queen(FakeBees(GOOD), CLEAN).run()
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "accepted without behaviour proof")
        self.assertIn("Pre-flight: clean", (self.tmp / "run" / "REPORT.md").read_text())

    def test_main_options_choose_the_bee_runner(self):
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        codex_bees.add_arguments(parser)
        claude = object()
        kwargs = {"engine": self.tmp, "inputs": self.tmp / "inputs", "config_dir": self.tmp / "codex"}
        self.assertIs(codex_bees.build(parser.parse_args([]), claude, **kwargs), claude)
        self.assertIsInstance(codex_bees.build(parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex"]), claude, **kwargs),
                              codex_bees.CodexBees)
        mixed = codex_bees.build(parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "mixed"]), claude, **kwargs)
        self.assertIsInstance(mixed, codex_bees.MixedBees)
        self.assertIs(mixed.claude, claude)

    def test_the_command_line_offers_language_preflight_and_policy(self):
        out = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            queen.main(["run", "--help"])
        for option in ("--language", "--allow-packed", "--bee-policy", "--codex-model", "--run-original"):
            self.assertIn(option, out.getvalue())

class RealSeamTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Actual routing, CLI parsers, hooks and planning; only processes/server/engine are inert."""

    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-real-seams-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name).resolve()
        self.inputs, self.out = self.root / "inputs", self.root / "run"
        self.inputs.mkdir()
        (self.inputs / "greet").write_bytes(b"inert fixture")
        self.calls, self.declared, self.tool_evidence, self.refuse_second = [], 65536, True, False
        self.network_failure = False
        self.metadata_url = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps"
        for target, value in (("ensure_confinement", None), ("syntax", (True, ""))):
            stub = patch.object(queen.Build, target, return_value=value)
            stub.start()
            self.addCleanup(stub.stop)
        for target, operation in (("hive.bees.run_cli", self.cli), ("urllib.request.urlopen", self.metadata)):
            stub = patch(target, side_effect=operation)
            stub.start()
            self.addCleanup(stub.stop)

    def metadata(self, request, timeout):
        self.assertEqual(request.full_url, self.metadata_url)
        self.assertEqual(timeout, 5)
        payload = {"models": [{"name": model, "context_length": self.declared}
                              for model in ("fixture-local", "fixture-fallback")]}
        return contextlib.closing(io.BytesIO(json.dumps(payload).encode()))

    def cli(self, argv, **kwargs):
        folder = Path(kwargs["cwd"])
        codex = "--output-schema" in argv
        schema = json.loads(Path(argv[argv.index("--output-schema") + 1]).read_bytes()) if codex else json.loads(
            argv[argv.index("--json-schema") + 1])
        name = (Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).stem if codex else
                Path(argv[argv.index("--mcp-config") + 1]).stem)
        server = (kwargs.get("env") or {}).get("ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL")
        self.calls.append(("codex" if codex else "claude", name, server))
        events = []
        if name.startswith("network-probe-"):
            output = {"exit_code": 0 if self.network_failure else 7}
            events = [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "command_execution",
                "command": codex_bees.NETWORK_COMMAND, "exit_code": output["exit_code"]}},
                {"type": "turn.completed"}]
        elif (folder / "capability-input.json").exists():
            nonce = json.loads((folder / "capability-input.json").read_bytes())["nonce"]
            output = {"nonce": nonce}
            if self.tool_evidence:
                events = ([{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "command_execution",
                    "command": "cat capability-input.json", "exit_code": 0, "aggregated_output": nonce}}] if codex else [
                    {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "read",
                        "name": "Read", "input": {"file_path": "capability-input.json"}}]}},
                    {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "read", "content": nonce}]}}])
            if self.tool_evidence:
                marker = "using these structured arguments: "
                self.assertIn(marker, kwargs["input"])
                arguments, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(kwargs["input"].split(marker, 1)[1])
                self.assertEqual(arguments["file"], "greet")
                self.assertEqual(arguments["entry"], 0x1000)
                self.assertIs(type(arguments["entry"]), int)
                self.assertEqual(arguments["part"], "info")
                if codex:
                    events.append({"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "mcp_tool_call", "id": "export",
                        "server": "reverseai", "tool": "export_function", "arguments": arguments,
                        "status": "completed", "error": None,
                        "result": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Derived function metadata"}]}}})
                else:
                    events.extend([
                        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "export",
                            "name": "mcp__reverseai__export_function", "input": arguments}]}},
                        {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "export",
                            "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Derived function metadata"}]}]}}])
        elif self.refuse_second and name == "planner-g0002" and server is None:
            events = [{"type": "result", "is_error": True, "error": {"type": "refusal"},
                       "result": "I cannot assist with this request."}]
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, json.dumps(events[0]), "")
        else:
            self.assertTrue(name.startswith("planner-g"), name)
            self.assertIn("declarations", schema["properties"])
            self.assertIn("Plan only group", kwargs["input"])
            self.assertNotIn("Use the legacy schema", kwargs["input"])
            source = json.loads((folder / "map.json").read_bytes())
            output = {"modules": [], "skipped": [{"entry": row["hex"], "reason": "inert library",
                       "evidence": [row["hex"]]} for row in source["functions"]], "declarations": [], "unknowns": []}
        self.assertTrue(bees_module.matches_schema(output, schema), (output, schema))
        if codex:
            Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps(output))
            if not any(e.get("type") == "turn.completed" for e in events):
                events.append({"type": "turn.completed"})
        else:
            events.append({"type": "result", "structured_output": output})
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, "\n".join(json.dumps(e) for e in events), "")

    def router(self, *flags):
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        parser.add_argument("--model")
        codex_bees.add_arguments(parser)
        args = parser.parse_args(flags)
        claude = bees_module.ClaudeBees(engine=self.root, inputs=self.inputs, config_dir=self.root / "claude")
        return codex_bees.build_router(args, claude, engine=self.root, inputs=self.inputs, config_dir=self.root / "codex")

    def make(self, router, **kwargs):
        return queen.Queen(engine=fixtures.FakeEngine(self.inputs), out=self.out, bees=router,
                           attempt_not_started=bees_module.AttemptNotStarted, **kwargs)

    def run_quietly(self, q):
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            return q.run()

    def test_s1_real_adapters_and_planning_resume_only_unfinished_groups(self):
        self.refuse_second = True
        original_partition = queen.partition.partition
        with patch.object(queen.partition, "partition", side_effect=lambda source: original_partition(source, max_functions=1)):
            first = self.make(self.router())
            with self.assertRaises(queen.ProviderRefused):
                self.run_quietly(first)
            progress = json.loads((self.out / "plan/progress.json").read_bytes())
            self.assertEqual(list(progress["groups"]), ["g0001"])
            preserved = progress["groups"]["g0001"]
            second = self.make(self.router("--fallback-model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434",
                "--fallback-model", "fixture-local", "--fallback-scope", "bee", "--fallback-bee", "planner-g0002"),
                resume_refused=True, model_check=selfhost.check_model)
            self.run_quietly(second)
        ordinary = [(name, server) for _, name, server in self.calls if not name.startswith("model-check-")]
        self.assertEqual(ordinary, [("planner-g0001", None), ("planner-g0002", None),
                                   ("planner-g0002", "http://127.0.0.1:11434"), ("planner-g0003", None)])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.out / "plan/progress.json").read_bytes())["groups"]["g0001"], preserved)
        self.assertEqual(second.spent["bees"], 5)  # Four logical attempts plus the mandatory local capability probe.
        self.assertFalse(second.state.data["unresolved_refusals"])
        ids = second.plan_bundle["planner_attempts"]
        self.assertEqual(len(ids), 4)
        self.assertTrue(all(second.state.data["attempts"][aid]["kind"] == "bee" for aid in ids))
        self.assertEqual(len(second.model_checks), 1)
        planning.validate_bundle(second.plan_bundle, second.program_map, out=self.out, language="c", max_functions=12)
        third = self.make(self.router("--fallback-model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434",
            "--fallback-model", "fixture-local", "--fallback-scope", "bee", "--fallback-bee", "planner-g0002"))
        before = len(self.calls)
        self.run_quietly(third)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), before + 1)  # Mandatory capability recheck, no planner.
        self.assertTrue(self.calls[-1][1].startswith("model-check-"))
        self.assertEqual(third.spent["bees"], 6)

    def test_real_codex_negative_isolation_cache_keeps_cause_without_spending_again(self):
        self.network_failure = True
        q = self.make(self.router("--bee-policy", "codex"))
        folder = self.out / "plan/groups/g0001"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        first = q.bee("planner", "planner-g0001", "Task", folder, schema=planning.GROUP_SCHEMA)
        second = q.bee("planner", "planner-g0002", "Task", folder, schema=planning.GROUP_SCHEMA)
        for result in (first, second):
            self.assertEqual(result["outcome"], "failure")
            self.assertEqual(result["code"], "network_isolation")
            self.assertIsNone(result["output"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(first["provenance"]["attempt_id"])
        self.assertIsNone(second["provenance"].get("attempt_id"))
        self.assertEqual(q.spent["bees"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 1)
        self.assertEqual(next(iter(q.state.data["attempts"].values()))["kind"], "network_probe")

    def test_main_checks_selfhost_capabilities_before_actual_planning(self):
        with patch.object(queen, "Engine", side_effect=lambda **kw: fixtures.FakeEngine(kw["inputs"])), \
             patch.object(bees_module, "environment_ok", return_value=True), \

        self.assertTrue(result["model_checks"][0]["ok"])

        self.assertTrue(self.calls[0][1].startswith("model-check-"))
        self.assertEqual(self.calls[1][1], "planner-g0001")
        self.assertTrue((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").is_file())

    def test_capabilities_block_bad_context_and_recheck_after_server_is_corrected(self):
        self.declared = 8192
        flags = ("--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "--codex-model", "fixture-local", "--bee-policy", "codex")
        first = self.make(self.router(*flags), model_check=selfhost.check_model)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(queen.HiveError, "Declared context 8192 is smaller than required 65536"):
            self.run_quietly(first)
        result = json.loads((self.out / "result.json").read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(result["model_checks"][0]["checks"]["context"]["status"], "error")
        self.assertEqual(first.spent["bees"], 2)  # Isolation and capability processes.
        self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())
        self.declared = 65536
        second = self.make(self.router(*flags), model_check=selfhost.check_model)
        self.run_quietly(second)
        self.assertIsNotNone(second.plan_bundle)
        self.assertEqual(second.spent["bees"], 6)  # Fresh router: isolation+check, isolation+planner.
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 6)

    def test_missing_native_tools_or_unknown_context_stop_before_planning(self):
        for index, tool_evidence, declared, label in ((0, False, 65536, "tool_roundtrip"), (1, True, None, "context")):
