```py
                self.out = self.root / f"run-{index}"
                self.tool_evidence, self.declared = tool_evidence, declared
                q = self.make(self.router("--fallback-model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434",
                    "--fallback-model", "fixture-local", "--fallback-scope", "run"), model_check=selfhost.check_model)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(queen.HiveError, label):
                    self.run_quietly(q)
                self.assertEqual(q.spent["bees"], 1)
                self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())

    def test_capability_budget_denies_before_any_cli_or_server_request(self):

    def test_capability_hook_denial_converts_to_not_started_without_a_result(self):

    def test_main_checks_fallback_cli_and_rejects_invalid_required_context(self):
        common = ["run", "--inputs", str(self.inputs), "--file", "greet", "--out", str(self.out)]
        with patch.object(bees_module, "environment_ok", side_effect=[True, False]) as presence, \
             contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()) as errors, self.assertRaises(SystemExit):

                                 "--fallback-model", "fixture-local", "--fallback-scope", "run"])

    def test_main_cloud_skips_capability_probes_and_context_threshold_is_overridable(self):
        common = ["run", "--inputs", str(self.inputs), "--file", "greet"]

    def test_both_clients_and_destinations_are_checked_without_starting_ordinary_bees(self):

        self.assertTrue(all(a["kind"] == "network_probe" for a in q.state.data["attempts"].values()))
        self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())
```

```py
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from tests.hive_compiler import confined
from tests.test_hive_queen import FakePlanning, make_queen
from hive import languages, queen

CXX = shutil.which("c++")

C_MAP = {"functions": [{"name": "FUN_100000a98"}, {"name": "_main"}], "imports": ["_printf", "_exit"]}
CPP_MAP = {"functions": [{"name": "__ZN7Greeter5greetEPKc"}, {"name": "__ZN7GreeterC1Ev"}, {"name": "__ZNK7Greeter4nameEv"},
                         {"name": "_main"}],
           "imports": ["__Znwm", "__ZdlPv", "___cxa_throw", "___gxx_personality_v0", "_printf"]}

ORIGINAL = r'''
#include <cstdio>
struct Greeter { const char *word; explicit Greeter(const char *w) : word(w) {} int greet(const char *n) const; };
int Greeter::greet(const char *n) const { return std::printf("%s %s\n", word, n); }
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: greet NAME\n"); return 2; }
    Greeter g("hello");
    g.greet(argv[1]);
    return 0;
}
'''
CONTRACT = '''#include <cstdio>
#include <cstddef>
struct Greeter {
    const char *word;
    explicit Greeter(const char *w);
    int greet(const char *name) const; /* 0x1040 */
};
static_assert(sizeof(Greeter) == sizeof(const char *), "Greeter holds one pointer");
int main(int argc, char **argv); /* 0x1000 */
'''
SOURCES = {
    "m01": '#include "contract.hpp"\nGreeter::Greeter(const char *w) : word(w) {}\n'
           'int Greeter::greet(const char *n) const { return std::printf("%s %s\\n", word, n); }\n',
    "m02": '#include "contract.hpp"\nint main(int argc, char **argv) {\n'
           '    if (argc < 2) { std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: greet NAME\\n"); return 2; }\n'
           '    Greeter g("hello");\n    g.greet(argv[1]);\n    return 0;\n}\n',
}


class DetectTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_c_and_cpp_programs_are_told_apart(self):
        self.assertEqual(languages.detect(C_MAP)[0], "c")
        name, reasons = languages.detect(CPP_MAP)
        self.assertEqual(name, "cpp")
        self.assertTrue(any("mangled" in r for r in reasons))
        self.assertTrue(any("runtime" in r for r in reasons))

    def test_one_weak_sign_is_not_enough(self):
        self.assertEqual(languages.detect({"functions": [{"name": "_main"}], "imports": ["__Znwm"]})[0], "c")

    def test_the_operator_can_force_a_language(self):
        self.assertEqual(languages.choose("cpp", C_MAP)[0], languages.CPP)
        self.assertEqual(languages.choose("c", CPP_MAP)[0], languages.C)
        self.assertEqual(languages.choose("auto", CPP_MAP)[0], languages.CPP)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            languages.choose("rust", C_MAP)

    def test_language_files_and_compilers(self):
        self.assertEqual((languages.C.source("m01"), languages.C.header), ("m01.c", "contract.h"))
        self.assertEqual((languages.CPP.source("m01"), languages.CPP.header), ("m01.cpp", "contract.hpp"))
        build = queen.Build(tempfile.mkdtemp(), language=languages.CPP)
        self.assertEqual(build.cflags[0], "-std=gnu++17")
        self.assertIn("-Wall", build.cflags)


class CppEngine:
    file = "greet"

    def __init__(self, inputs):
        self.path = Path(inputs) / self.file

    def prepare(self):
        return {}

    def query(self, name, args, out):
        functions = [{"index": 0, "entry": 0x1000, "name": "_main", "size": 64},
                     {"index": 1, "entry": 0x1040, "name": "__ZNK7Greeter5greetEPKc", "size": 32},
                     {"index": 2, "entry": 0x1060, "name": "__ZN7GreeterC1EPKc", "size": 16},
                     {"index": 3, "entry": 0x1070, "name": "__ZN7GreeterC2EPKc", "size": 16}]
        calls = [{"index": 0, "from": 0x1000, "to": 0x1040, "to_name": "__ZNK7Greeter5greetEPKc"},
                 {"index": 1, "from": 0x1000, "to": 0x9000, "to_name": "___cxa_throw"},
                 {"index": 2, "from": 0x1000, "to": 0x9010, "to_name": "__Znwm"}]
        key, rows = {"functions": ("code.export_functions", functions), "calls": ("code.export_calls", calls),
                     "strings": ("code.export_strings", [])}[args["part"]]
        return {"input": {"sha256": "ef" * 32}, "results": [{"findings": [
            {"claim_key": key, "verdict": "derived", "value": {"rows": rows, "total": len(rows)}}]}]}


class CppBees:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, role, name, task, folder):
        folder = Path(folder)
        self.calls.append((role, name, task))
        if role == "planner":
            (folder / "contract.hpp").write_text(CONTRACT)
            return {"ok": True, "output": {"modules": [{"id": "a", "title": "greeter", "functions": ["0x1040", "0x1060"]},
                                                       {"id": "b", "title": "main", "functions": ["0x1000"]}],
                                           "skipped": [{"entry": "0x1070", "reason": "duplicate constructor"}]}}
        if role == "worker":
            (folder / f"{folder.name}.cpp").write_text(SOURCES[folder.name])
            entries = {"m01": ["0x1040", "0x1060"], "m02": ["0x1000"]}[folder.name]
            return {"ok": True, "output": {"status": "done", "functions": [
                {"entry": entry, "status": "rebuilt"} for entry in entries]}}
        if role == "councillor":
            return {"ok": True, "output": {"verdict": "accept", "defects": []}}
        if role == "tester":
            return {"ok": True, "output": {"cases": [{"id": "none", "steps": [{"args": []}]},
                                                     {"id": "ada", "steps": [{"args": ["ada"]}]}]}}
        raise AssertionError(role)


@unittest.skipUnless(confined("cpp"), "needs a Clang++ compiler the hive can confine")
class CppRunTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_cpp_program_is_rebuilt_as_cpp(self):
        tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        inputs = tmp / "inputs"
        inputs.mkdir()
        (tmp / "greet.cpp").write_text(ORIGINAL)
        subprocess.run([CXX, "-std=gnu++17", str(tmp / "greet.cpp"), "-o", str(inputs / "greet")], check=True)
        bees = CppBees()

        def check(claims, out):
            return {"claims": 1, "confirmed": 1, "rejected": 0, "questions": 1,
                    "input_sha256": ["ef" * 32]}, []

        hive = make_queen(engine=CppEngine(inputs), out=tmp / "run", bees=bees, slots=2, check=check, planning=FakePlanning(header=CONTRACT),
                           run_original=True, language="auto")
        (tmp / "run" / "modules" / "m01").mkdir(parents=True)
        (tmp / "run" / "modules" / "m01" / "claims.json").write_text(json.dumps({"claims": [
            {"id": "c", "text": "t", "citations": []}]}))
        result = hive.run()
        self.assertEqual(result["language"], "C++")
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "accepted", result["reason"])
        self.assertEqual(result["conformance"]["identical"], 2)
        self.assertTrue((tmp / "run" / "src" / "contract.hpp").is_file())
        seats = list((tmp / "run" / "council").glob("*/unit-*"))
        self.assertTrue(seats and all(seat.suffix == ".cpp" for seat in seats))
        planner_task = next(task for role, _, task in bees.calls if role == "planner")
        self.assertIn("contract.hpp", planner_task)
        self.assertIn("C++", (tmp / "run" / "REPORT.md").read_text())
```

```py
"""Startup regression: a successful Read cannot certify ReverseAI MCP tools."""

import argparse
import contextlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from hive import bees, codex_bees, queen, selfhost
from tests.test_hive_queen import FakeEngine
from tests.test_hive_selfhost import accepted_mcp_events


class ModelMCPStartupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-model-mcp-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.inputs = self.root / "inputs"
        self.inputs.mkdir()
        (self.inputs / "greet").write_bytes(b"inert input; never executed")
        self.calls = []
        self.mcp_accept = False

    def router(self, client="claude"):
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        parser.add_argument("--model")
        codex_bees.add_arguments(parser)
        args = parser.parse_args(["--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "--model", "fixture"]
                                 + (["--bee-policy", "codex", "--codex-model", "fixture", "--codex-allow-network"]
                                    if client == "codex" else []))
        source = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=self.root, inputs=self.inputs, config_dir=self.root / "claude")
        return codex_bees.build_router(args, source, engine=self.root, inputs=self.inputs,
                                      config_dir=self.root / "codex")

    def cli(self, argv, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((argv, kwargs))
        nonce = json.loads(Path(kwargs["cwd"], "capability-input.json").read_text())["nonce"]
        codex = "--output-schema" in argv
        if codex:
            config = next(arg for arg in argv if arg.startswith("mcp_servers="))
            self.assertIn(str(self.inputs), config)
            self.assertIn("http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1", " ".join(argv))
        else:
            config = json.loads(Path(argv[argv.index("--mcp-config") + 1]).read_text())
            mcp_args = config["mcpServers"]["reverseai"]["args"]
            self.assertEqual(Path(mcp_args[mcp_args.index("--inputs") + 1]).resolve(), self.inputs.resolve())
            self.assertEqual(kwargs["env"]["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
        events = [
            {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "read",
                "name": "Read", "input": {"file_path": "capability-input.json"}}]}},
            {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "read", "content": nonce}]}},
            {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "export",
                "name": "mcp__reverseai__export_function", "input": {"file": "greet", "entry": "0x1000"}}]}},
            {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "export",
                "is_error": True, "content": "Arguments must match this tool's input schema."}]}},
            {"type": "result", "structured_output": {"nonce": nonce}},
        ]
        if self.mcp_accept:
            events[2:4] = accepted_mcp_events("claude")
        if codex:
            events = [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "command_execution",
                "command": "cat capability-input.json", "exit_code": 0, "aggregated_output": nonce}}]
            if self.mcp_accept:
                events += accepted_mcp_events("codex")
            else:
                events += [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "mcp_tool_call", "server": "reverseai",
                    "tool": "export_function", "status": "failed", "arguments": {"file": "greet", "entry": "0x1000"},
                    "result": None, "error": {"code": -32602, "message": "Invalid arguments"}}}]
            events.append({"type": "turn.completed"})
            Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps({"nonce": nonce}))
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, "\n".join(map(json.dumps, events)), "")

    def rejected_export(self, client):
        def check(router, client, **kwargs):
            return selfhost.check_model(router, client, context_query=lambda server, model: 65536, **kwargs)

        q = queen.Queen(engine=FakeEngine(self.inputs), out=self.root / "run", bees=self.router(client),
                        model_check=check, attempt_not_started=bees.AttemptNotStarted)
        with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.cli), \
             patch.object(queen.Build, "ensure_confinement"), \
             patch.object(q, "plan", side_effect=AssertionError("planner reached after rejected MCP arguments")) as planner, \
             patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=AssertionError("network forbidden")), \
             contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(queen.HiveError, "mcp_tool"):
                q.run()
        planner.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 1)
        report = q.model_checks[0]
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["tool_roundtrip"]["status"], "ok")
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["structured_output"]["status"], "ok")
        self.assertNotEqual(report["checks"]["mcp_tool"]["status"], "ok")
        self.assertEqual(report["attempt"]["tool_rejections"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(q.stopped, "model_capability")
        self.assertEqual(q.spent["bees"], 1)
        attempts = list(q.state.data["attempts"].values())
        self.assertEqual([a["kind"] for a in attempts], ["network_probe"])
        self.assertIn("export_function", self.calls[0][1]["input"])
        self.assertIn("greet", self.calls[0][1]["input"])
        self.assertIn("4096", self.calls[0][1]["input"])
        self.assertFalse((q.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())


    def test_read_success_with_rejected_export_stops_before_planning(self):
        self.rejected_export("claude")

    def test_codex_read_success_with_rejected_export_stops_before_planning(self):
        self.rejected_export("codex")

    def test_native_mcp_acceptance_allows_planning_for_both_clients(self):
        class PlanningReached(Exception):
            pass
        self.mcp_accept = True
        for client in ("claude", "codex"):
            with self.subTest(client=client):
                def check(router, selected, **kwargs):
                    self.assertEqual(kwargs["mcp_probe"], {"file": "greet", "entry": "0x1000"})
                    return selfhost.check_model(router, selected, context_query=lambda s, m: 65536, **kwargs)
                q = queen.Queen(engine=FakeEngine(self.inputs), out=self.root / client, bees=self.router(client),
                                model_check=check, attempt_not_started=bees.AttemptNotStarted)
                with patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.cli), patch.object(queen.Build, "ensure_confinement"), \
                     patch.object(q, "plan", side_effect=PlanningReached) as planner, \
                     patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=AssertionError("network forbidden")), \
                     contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), self.assertRaises(PlanningReached):
                    q.run()
                self.assertEqual(planner.call_count, 1)
                self.assertTrue(q.model_checks[0]["ok"], q.model_checks)
                self.assertEqual(q.model_checks[0]["checks"]["mcp_tool"]["status"], "ok")
                self.assertEqual(q.spent["bees"], 1)
                self.assertEqual(q.model_checks[0]["attempt"]["tool_rejections"], 0)
                self.assertIsNone(q.stopped)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_hive_partition.py`:

```py
"""Contract tests for the model-free first stage of planning."""

import copy
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

try:
    partition = importlib.import_module("hive.partition")
except ModuleNotFoundError as error:
    if error.name != "hive.partition":
        raise
    partition = None


def encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def program(count):
    return {"file": "fixture", "input_sha256": "ab" * 32,
            "functions": [{"entry": 0x1000 + 16 * i, "hex": hex(0x1000 + 16 * i),
                           "name": f"fn_{i}", "size": 16, "signature": "int f(void)"}
                          for i in range(count)],
            "calls": [], "strings": [], "imports": []}


def owner(result):
    return {entry: group["id"] for group in result["groups"] for entry in group["functions"]}


class PartitionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.assertIsNotNone(partition, "Phase A partitioner is not implemented on the original base")

    def valid_partition(self, source, **limits):
        try:
            return partition.partition(source, **limits)
        except ValueError as error:
            self.fail(f"valid map must partition instead of aborting: {error}")

    def check_bounds(self, source, result, count, size, summary):
        entries = [entry for group in result["groups"] for entry in group["functions"]]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(entries), sorted(row["hex"] for row in source["functions"]))
        self.assertEqual(len(entries), len(set(entries)))
        self.assertEqual(len({g["id"] for g in result["groups"]}), len(result["groups"]))
        for group in result["groups"]:
            self.assertGreater(len(group["functions"]), 0)
            self.assertLessEqual(len(group["functions"]), count)
            self.assertEqual(group["bytes"], len(encoded(group["map"])))
            self.assertLessEqual(group["bytes"], size)
            self.assertEqual(set(group["map"]), set(source))
            self.assertEqual({f["hex"] for f in group["map"]["functions"]}, set(group["functions"]))
        self.assertEqual(result["summary_bytes"], len(encoded(result["summary"])))
        self.assertLessEqual(result["summary_bytes"], summary)
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["totals"]["functions"], len(entries))
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["totals"]["groups"], len(result["groups"]))
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["totals"]["cut_edges"], len(result["cut_edges"]))

    def test_empty_map(self):
        source = program(0)
        result = partition.partition(source)
        self.assertEqual(result["groups"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["cut_edges"], [])
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 128, 65536, 8192)

    def test_every_function_is_assigned_once_even_without_relations(self):
        source = program(173)
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=7, max_bytes=5000)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 7, 5000, 8192)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["groups"]), 25)

    def test_mutually_calling_pairs_stay_together(self):
        source = program(6)
        entries = [f["hex"] for f in source["functions"]]
        pairs = [(entries[i], entries[i + 3]) for i in range(3)]
        source["calls"] = [{"from": a, "to": b, "to_name": "callee"}
                           for a, b in pairs + [(b, a) for a, b in pairs]]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=2)
        owners = owner(result)
        self.assertTrue(all(owners[a] == owners[b] for a, b in pairs))
        self.assertEqual(result["cut_edges"], [])

    def test_shared_string_bytes_join_functions_at_different_addresses(self):
        source = program(4)
        source["strings"] = [{"from": f["hex"], "address": hex(0x8000 + i * 32),
                              "text": "even" if i % 2 == 0 else "odd"}
                             for i, f in enumerate(source["functions"])]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=2)
        owners = owner(result)
        self.assertEqual(owners["0x1000"], owners["0x1020"])
        self.assertEqual(owners["0x1010"], owners["0x1030"])

    def test_shared_data_references_join_functions_and_preserve_rows(self):
        for table in ("references", "data_refs"):
            with self.subTest(table=table):
                source = program(4)
                source[table] = [{"from": f["hex"], "to": "0x9000" if i % 2 == 0 else "0xa000",
                                  "type": "READ" if i < 2 else "WRITE", "at": f["entry"] + 1}
                                 for i, f in enumerate(source["functions"])]
                result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=2)
                owners = owner(result)
                self.assertEqual(owners["0x1000"], owners["0x1020"])
                self.assertEqual(owners["0x1010"], owners["0x1030"])
                actual = [r for g in result["groups"] for r in g["map"][table]]
                self.assertEqual(sorted(map(encoded, actual)), sorted(map(encoded, source[table])))

    def test_utf8_slice_limit_includes_metadata_and_all_rows(self):
        source = program(12)
        for function in source["functions"]:
            function["signature"] = "é漢" * 80
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=12, max_bytes=900)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 12, 900, 8192)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["groups"]), 12)
        self.assertTrue(all(g["map"]["functions"][0]["signature"] == "é漢" * 80 for g in result["groups"]))

    def test_large_string_row_has_an_oversized_group_and_full_side_file(self):
        source = program(1)
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "address": "0x8000", "text": "x" * 5000}]
        result = self.valid_partition(source, max_bytes=1000)
        group = result["groups"][0]
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        self.assertLessEqual(group["bytes"], 1000)
        detail = group["overflow"]["strings"]
        self.assertEqual((detail["total"], detail["retained"], detail["deferred"]), (1, 0, 1))
        self.assertEqual(result["side_files"][detail["file"]]["rows"], source["strings"])
        source = program(1)
        source["file"] = "x" * 2000
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            partition.partition(source, max_bytes=1000)

    def test_exact_limit_is_allowed(self):
        source = program(1)
        limit = len(encoded(source))
        result = partition.partition(source, max_bytes=limit)
        self.assertEqual(result["groups"][0]["bytes"], limit)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            partition.partition(source, max_bytes=limit - 1)

    def test_all_directed_cut_calls_are_listed_including_distinct_callsites(self):
        source = program(3)
        source["calls"] = [
            {"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1010", "at": "0x1001", "to_name": "first"},
            {"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1010", "at": "0x1002", "to_name": "first"},
            {"from": "0x1010", "to": "0x1000", "at": "0x1011"},
            {"from": "0x1020", "to": "0x1020"},
            {"from": "0x1020", "to": "0x9999", "to_name": "puts"}]
        source["imports"] = ["unused", "puts"]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=1)
        owners = owner(result)
        expected = [{**row, "from_group": owners[row["from"]], "to_group": owners[row["to"]]}
                    for row in source["calls"] if row["to"] in owners and owners[row["from"]] != owners[row["to"]]]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(map(encoded, result["cut_edges"])), sorted(map(encoded, expected)))
        self.assertEqual(len(result["cut_edges"]), 3)
        for group in result["groups"]:
            mine = set(group["functions"])
            touched = [r for r in source["calls"] if r["from"] in mine or r["to"] in mine]
            self.assertEqual(sorted(map(encoded, group["map"]["calls"])), sorted(map(encoded, touched)))
            self.assertEqual(group["map"]["imports"], ["puts"] if "0x1020" in mine else [])

    def test_table_order_and_json_key_order_do_not_change_partition(self):
        source = program(31)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": f["hex"], "to": source["functions"][(i + 3) % 31]["hex"]}
                           for i, f in enumerate(source["functions"])]
        shuffled = {key: list(reversed(value)) if isinstance(value, list) else value
                    for key, value in reversed(list(source.items()))}
        self.assertEqual(encoded(partition.partition(source, max_functions=5)),
                         encoded(partition.partition(shuffled, max_functions=5)))

    def test_hash_seed_does_not_change_serialized_result(self):
        source = program(24)
        source["strings"] = [{"from": f["hex"], "address": "0x8000", "text": "common"}
                             for f in source["functions"]]
        source["strings"].append({"from": "0x1000", "address": "0x9000", "text": "manual" * 12000})
        source["references"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "to": "0xdead", "type": "DATA"}]
        script = ("import json,sys,hashlib; from hive.partition import partition,encode; "
                  "print(hashlib.sha256(encode(partition(json.load(sys.stdin),max_functions=5))).hexdigest())")
        digests = []
        for seed in ("1", "917"):
            env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONHASHSEED=seed)
            done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", script], env=env,
                                  cwd=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], input=json.dumps(source),
                                  text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
            self.assertEqual(done.returncode, 0, done.stderr)
            digests.append(done.stdout.strip())
        self.assertEqual(digests[0], digests[1])
        self.assertEqual(len(digests[0]), hashlib.sha256().digest_size * 2)

    def test_summary_omissions_are_explicit_and_complete_edges_stay_available(self):
        source = program(350)
        source["entry_points"] = [f["hex"] for f in source["functions"]]
        source["calls"] = [{"from": source["functions"][i]["hex"], "to": source["functions"][i + 1]["hex"]}
                           for i in range(349)]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=1, max_bytes=30000, summary_bytes=512)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 1, 30000, 512)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["cut_edges"]), 349)
        summary = result["summary"]
        for key in ("groups", "cut_edges", "entry_points", "entry_hints"):
            self.assertEqual(len(summary[key]) + summary["omitted"][key], summary["totals"][key])
        self.assertGreater(summary["omitted"]["groups"], 0)
        self.assertGreater(summary["omitted"]["cut_edges"], 0)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "summary"):
            partition.partition(source, summary_bytes=1)

    def test_runtime_hints_and_declared_entries_are_preserved_without_skipping(self):
        source = program(4)
        source["functions"][0].update(name="main")
        source["functions"][1].update(library_hint="libc", is_thunk=True)
        source["functions"][2].update(runtime=True, is_entry=True)
        source["entry_points"] = ["0x1030"]
        before = copy.deepcopy(source)
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=2)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 2, 65536, 8192)
        actual = {f["hex"]: f for g in result["groups"] for f in g["map"]["functions"]}
        self.assertEqual(actual, {f["hex"]: f for f in source["functions"]})
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_points"], ["0x1020", "0x1030"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_hints"], ["0x1000", "0x1010"])
        result["groups"][0]["map"]["functions"][0]["name"] = "changed"
        self.assertEqual(source, before)

    def test_invalid_limits_addresses_or_duplicate_functions_fail(self):
        for limits in ({"max_functions": 0}, {"max_functions": True}, {"max_bytes": -1},
                       {"summary_bytes": 0}, {"max_bytes": 2.5}):
            with self.subTest(limits=limits), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                partition.partition(program(1), **limits)
        for update in (lambda m: m["functions"].append(dict(m["functions"][0])),
                       lambda m: m["functions"][0].update(hex="0xffff"),
                       lambda m: m["calls"].append({"from": "bad", "to": "0x1000"})):
            source = program(2)
            update(source)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                partition.partition(source)

    def test_three_thousand_functions_have_bounded_lossless_slices(self):
        source = program(3000)
        for i, function in enumerate(source["functions"]):
            source["calls"].append({"from": function["hex"],
                                    "to": source["functions"][(i + 1) % 3000]["hex"]})
            source["strings"].append({"from": function["hex"], "address": hex(0x80000 + i // 30),
                                      "text": f"cluster {i // 30}"})
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=64, max_bytes=32768, summary_bytes=4096)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 64, 32768, 4096)
        owners = owner(result)
        cuts = [r for r in source["calls"] if owners[r["from"]] != owners[r["to"]]]
        self.assertEqual(sorted((r["from"], r["to"]) for r in result["cut_edges"]),
                         sorted((r["from"], r["to"]) for r in cuts))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(result["groups"]), 47)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(result["groups"]), 100)

    def test_reference_target_also_gets_the_full_reference_row(self):
        source = program(4)
        row = {"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1030", "type": "DATA"}
        source["references"] = [row]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=1)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 1, 65536, 8192)
        by_entry = {g["functions"][0]: g["map"] for g in result["groups"]}
        self.assertEqual(by_entry["0x1030"]["references"], [row])
        self.assertEqual(by_entry["0x1000"]["references"], [row])
        self.assertEqual(by_entry["0x1010"]["references"], [])

    def test_explicit_entries_are_restricted_to_their_slice(self):
        source = program(4)
        source["entry_points"] = [f["hex"] for f in source["functions"]]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=1)
        for group in result["groups"]:
            self.assertEqual(group["map"]["entry_points"], group["functions"])

    def test_declared_entry_is_excluded_from_hints(self):
        source = program(1)
        source["functions"][0]["name"] = "main"
        source["entry_points"] = ["0x1000"]
        result = partition.partition(source)
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_points"], ["0x1000"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_hints"], [])

    def test_entry_name_and_roots_are_hints_not_declared_entries(self):
        source = program(4)
        source["functions"][0]["name"] = "main"
        source["functions"][2]["name"] = "entry"
        source["entry_points"] = ["0x1000"]
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1010"},
                           {"from": "0x1010", "to": "0x1000"},
                           {"from": "0x1030", "to": "0x1020"}]
        result = partition.partition(source)
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_points"], ["0x1000"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_hints"], ["0x1020", "0x1030"])

    def test_call_affinity_wins_over_an_unrelated_shared_text(self):
        source = program(4)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1020"}]
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "address": "0x8000", "text": "shared"},
                             {"from": "0x1010", "address": "0x9000", "text": "shared"}]
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=2)
        owners = owner(result)
        self.assertEqual(owners["0x1000"], owners["0x1020"])
        self.assertNotEqual(owners["0x1000"], owners["0x1010"])

    def test_named_entry_hint_precedes_roots_in_a_small_summary(self):
        source = program(200)
        source["functions"][-1]["name"] = "entry"
        result = partition.partition(source, max_functions=1, summary_bytes=512)
        self.assertTrue(result["summary"]["entry_hints"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["entry_hints"][0], source["functions"][-1]["hex"])
        self.assertGreater(result["summary"]["omitted"]["entry_hints"], 0)

    def test_high_fan_in_uses_an_isolated_group_and_exact_caller_group_counts(self):
        source = program(1301)
        hub = source["functions"][-1]["hex"]
        source["calls"] = [{"from": f["hex"], "to": hub, "to_name": "helper", "at": f["entry"] + 1}
                           for f in source["functions"][:-1]]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 128, 65536, 8192)
        group = next(g for g in result["groups"] if hub in g["functions"])
        self.assertEqual(group["functions"], [hub])
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["oversized"], 1)
        detail = group["overflow"]["incoming_calls"]
        self.assertEqual(detail["total"], 1300)
        self.assertLessEqual(detail["retained"], 128)
        self.assertEqual(detail["retained"] + detail["deferred"], 1300)
        payload = result["side_files"][detail["file"]]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(map(encoded, payload["rows"])), sorted(map(encoded, source["calls"])))
        owners = owner(result)
        expected = {}
        for row in source["calls"]:
            mid = owners[row["from"]]
            expected[mid] = expected.get(mid, 0) + 1
        self.assertEqual(payload["by_group"], expected)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["cut_edges"]), 1300)
        self.assertEqual(len(group["map"]["calls"]), detail["retained"])

    def test_hugehelp_strings_are_counted_and_the_complete_file_is_written(self):
        source = program(3)
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1010", "address": hex(0x100000 + i * 80),
                              "text": "é" * 73 + str(i)} for i in range(5704)]
        before = copy.deepcopy(source)
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 128, 65536, 8192)
        group = next(g for g in result["groups"] if "0x1010" in g["functions"])
        self.assertEqual(group["functions"], ["0x1010"])
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        detail = group["overflow"]["strings"]
        self.assertEqual(detail["total"], 5704)
        self.assertLessEqual(detail["retained"], 128)
        self.assertEqual(detail["retained"], len(group["map"]["strings"]))
        self.assertEqual(detail["deferred"], 5704 - detail["retained"])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            partition.write_side_files(result, folder)
            raw = (Path(folder) / detail["file"]).read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), detail["sha256"])
            self.assertEqual(sorted(map(encoded, json.loads(raw)["rows"])), sorted(map(encoded, source["strings"])))
        self.assertEqual(source, before)

    def test_incoming_and_string_sample_limits_also_obey_the_byte_cap(self):
        source = program(4)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": hex(0x3000 + i * 16), "to": "0x1030", "at": i, "to_name": "x" * 200}
                           for i in range(15)]
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1030", "address": hex(0x8000 + i), "text": "x" * 500}
                             for i in range(15)]
        import inspect
        self.assertIn("incoming_limit", inspect.signature(partition.partition).parameters)
        self.assertIn("string_limit", inspect.signature(partition.partition).parameters)
        result = self.valid_partition(source, max_bytes=1000, incoming_limit=2, string_limit=2)
        group = next(g for g in result["groups"] if "0x1030" in g["functions"])
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        self.assertLessEqual(group["bytes"], 1000)
        self.assertLessEqual(group["overflow"]["incoming_calls"]["retained"], 2)
        self.assertLessEqual(group["overflow"]["strings"]["retained"], 2)
        for limits in ({"incoming_limit": 0}, {"string_limit": True}):
            with self.subTest(limits=limits), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                partition.partition(source, **limits)

    def test_orphan_rows_are_preserved_and_counted_even_without_functions(self):
        for count in (0, 2):
            with self.subTest(functions=count):
                source = program(count)
                source["calls"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "to": "0xdead", "at": 1}] * 2
                source["strings"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "address": "0x8000", "text": "manual" * 1000}]
                source["references"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "to": "0x9000", "type": "DATA"}]
                source["data_refs"] = [{"from": "0xcafe", "to": "0xa000"}]
                result = partition.partition(source)
                self.assertIn("unattached", result)
                for key in ("calls", "strings", "references", "data_refs"):
                    self.assertEqual(result["unattached"][key], source[key])
                    self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["unattached"][key], len(source[key]))
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
                    partition.write_side_files(result, folder)
                    self.assertEqual(json.loads((Path(folder) / "unattached.json").read_text()), result["unattached"])

    def test_all_irreducible_offenders_are_reported_together(self):
        source = program(3)
        source["functions"][0]["signature"] = "x" * 5000
        source["functions"][2]["signature"] = "y" * 5000
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
            partition.partition(source, max_bytes=1000)
        self.assertIn("0x1000", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("0x1020", str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIn("bytes", str(caught.exception))

    def test_malformed_map_rows_have_contextual_value_errors(self):
        cases = [([], "map"), ({}, "functions"), ({"functions": None}, "functions"),
                 ({"functions": [42]}, "functions"), ({"functions": [{}]}, "functions"),
                 ({"functions": [], "calls": {}}, "calls"),
                 ({"functions": [], "calls": ["bad"]}, "calls"),
                 ({"functions": [], "calls": [{"from": "0x1000"}]}, "calls"),
                 ({"functions": [], "strings": [{"from": "0x1000", "address": 8192, "text": 5}]}, "strings"),
                 ({"functions": [], "strings": [{"from": "0x1000", "address": 8192, "text": "\ud800"}]}, "JSON"),
                 ({"functions": [], "file": "\ud800"}, "JSON"),
                 ({"functions": [], "imports": [1]}, "imports"),
                 ({"functions": [], "entry_points": None}, "entry_points"),
                 ({"functions": [], "extra": {1, 2}}, "JSON")]
        for source, message in cases:
            with self.subTest(source=repr(source)):
                try:
                    partition.partition(source)
                except Exception as error:
                    self.assertIs(type(error), ValueError, f"malformed input raised {type(error).__name__}")
                    self.assertRegex(str(error), message)
                else:
                    self.fail("malformed input was accepted")

    def test_manifest_counts_only_deferred_incoming_rows_by_caller_group(self):
        from collections import Counter
        source = program(1301)
        hub = source["functions"][-1]["hex"]
        source["calls"] = [{"from": f["hex"], "to": hub, "at": f["entry"]}
                           for f in source["functions"][:-1]]
        source["calls"] += [{"from": "0x0001", "to": hub, "at": i} for i in range(400)]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        group = next(g for g in result["groups"] if hub in g["functions"])
        manifest = group["overflow"]["incoming_calls"]
        self.assertIn("by_group", manifest)
        owners = owner(result)
        deferred = Counter(map(encoded, source["calls"])) - Counter(map(encoded, group["map"]["calls"]))
        expected = Counter()
        for row, count in deferred.items():
            expected[owners.get(json.loads(row)["from"], "unknown_caller")] += count
        self.assertEqual(manifest["by_group"], dict(expected))
        self.assertEqual(sum(manifest["by_group"].values()), manifest["deferred"])
        self.assertLessEqual(len(manifest["by_group"]), len(result["groups"]) + 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["unattached"]["calls"], [])
        payload = result["side_files"][manifest["file"]]
        self.assertNotIn("unattached", payload["by_group"])
        self.assertEqual(payload["by_group"]["unknown_caller"], 400)
        self.assertEqual(sum(payload["by_group"].values()), manifest["total"])

    def test_large_outgoing_call_list_has_a_complete_side_file(self):
        from collections import Counter
        source = program(1301)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": f["hex"], "at": i, "to_name": "callee"}
                           for i, f in enumerate(source["functions"][1:])]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        self.check_bounds(source, result, 128, 65536, 8192)
        group = next(g for g in result["groups"] if "0x1000" in g["functions"])
        self.assertEqual(group["functions"], ["0x1000"])
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        self.assertIn("outgoing_calls", group["overflow"])
        manifest = group["overflow"]["outgoing_calls"]
        payload = result["side_files"][manifest["file"]]
        self.assertEqual(Counter(map(encoded, payload["rows"])), Counter(map(encoded, source["calls"])))
        self.assertLessEqual(manifest["retained"], 128)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["retained"] + manifest["deferred"], 1300)
        self.assertEqual(sum(manifest["by_group"].values()), manifest["deferred"])
        self.assertEqual(len(result["cut_edges"]), 1300)

    def test_large_references_and_data_refs_are_sampled_in_both_directions(self):
        from collections import Counter
        for table in ("references", "data_refs"):
            for direction in ("incoming", "outgoing"):
                with self.subTest(table=table, direction=direction):
                    source = program(3)
                    if direction == "incoming":
                        source[table] = [{"from": hex(0x90000 + i * 16), "to": "0x1000", "type": "READ"}
                                         for i in range(1900)]
                        bucket = "unknown_source"
                    else:
                        source[table] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": hex(0x90000 + i * 16), "type": "WRITE"}
                                         for i in range(1900)]
                        bucket = "unknown_target"
                    result = self.valid_partition(source)
                    self.check_bounds(source, result, 128, 65536, 8192)
                    group = next(g for g in result["groups"] if "0x1000" in g["functions"])
                    manifest = group["overflow"][table]
                    self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
                    self.assertLessEqual(manifest["retained"], 128)
                    self.assertEqual(manifest["total"], 1900)
                    self.assertEqual(manifest["by_group"], {bucket: manifest["deferred"]})
                    payload = result["side_files"][manifest["file"]]
                    self.assertEqual(Counter(map(encoded, payload["rows"])), Counter(map(encoded, source[table])))
                    self.assertEqual(len(group["map"][table]), manifest["retained"])

    def test_oversized_view_keeps_strings_that_fit_and_its_self_call(self):
        source = program(1)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x0001", "to": "0x1000", "at": i} for i in range(1800)]
        self_call = {"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1000", "at": 4097}
        source["calls"].append(self_call)
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "address": "0x9000", "text": "usage"},
                             {"from": "0x1000", "address": "0x9010", "text": "help"}]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        group = result["groups"][0]
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        self.assertEqual(group["original_bytes"], len(encoded(source)))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(map(encoded, group["map"]["strings"])), sorted(map(encoded, source["strings"])))
        self.assertIn(self_call, group["map"]["calls"])
        self.assertEqual(group["overflow"]["incoming_calls"]["total"], 1800)
        self.assertNotIn("strings", group["overflow"])
        self.assertNotIn("outgoing_calls", group["overflow"])
        summarized = next(g for g in result["summary"]["groups"] if g["id"] == group["id"])
        self.assertIs(summarized.get("oversized"), True)

    def test_side_file_objects_are_independent_of_every_result_container(self):
        source = program(1)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "to": "0xdead", "meta": {"values": [1]}}]
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "address": "0x9000", "text": "orphan"}]
        result = partition.partition(source)
        result["unattached"]["calls"][0]["meta"]["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result["side_files"]["unattached.json"]["calls"][0]["meta"]["values"], [1])
        result["side_files"]["unattached.json"]["strings"][0]["text"] = "side"
        self.assertEqual(result["unattached"]["strings"][0]["text"], "orphan")
        self.assertEqual(source["calls"][0]["meta"]["values"], [1])
        source = program(2)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1010", "at": i, "meta": {"values": [1]}}
                           for i in range(1300)]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        names = list(result["side_files"])
        self.assertEqual(len(names), 2)
        result["side_files"][names[0]]["rows"][0]["meta"]["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result["side_files"][names[1]]["rows"][0]["meta"]["values"], [1])
        self.assertTrue(all(row["meta"]["values"] == [1] for row in result["cut_edges"]))
        self.assertTrue(all(row["meta"]["values"] == [1] for row in source["calls"]))

    def test_many_self_calls_are_sampled_without_aborting(self):
        source = program(1)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x1000", "at": i} for i in range(2000)]
        source["calls"] += [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x0001", "at": -i - 1} for i in range(1000)]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        group = result["groups"][0]
        self.assertTrue(group["oversized"])
        self.assertLessEqual(group["bytes"], 65536)
        manifest = group["overflow"]["outgoing_calls"]
        self.assertEqual((manifest["total"], manifest["retained"], manifest["deferred"]), (3000, 128, 2872))
        self.assertEqual(manifest["by_group"], {group["id"]: 1872, "unknown_target": 1000})
        self.assertTrue(all(row["to"] == "0x1000" for row in group["map"]["calls"]))
        self.assertEqual(len(result["side_files"][manifest["file"]]["rows"]), 3000)

    def test_writer_removes_only_stale_files_it_owns(self):
        source = program(1)
        source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "address": "0x9000", "text": "x" * 70000},
                             {"from": "0xbeef", "address": "0x9010", "text": "orphan"}]
        result = self.valid_partition(source)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            folder = Path(folder)
            partition.write_side_files(result, folder)
            created = set(result["side_files"])
            self.assertTrue(created)
            self.assertTrue(all((folder / name).is_file() for name in created))
            protected = ["notes.json", "g0001-custom.json", "g1234x-strings.json", "README"]
            for name in protected:
                (folder / name).write_text("keep")
            (folder / "g10000-data_refs.json").write_text("stale")
            (folder / "g0009-incoming_calls.json").mkdir()
            partition.write_side_files(partition.partition(program(1)), folder)
            self.assertTrue(all(not (folder / name).exists() for name in created))
            self.assertFalse((folder / "g10000-data_refs.json").exists())
            self.assertTrue((folder / "g0009-incoming_calls.json").is_dir())
            self.assertTrue(all((folder / name).read_text() == "keep" for name in protected))

    def test_new_relation_limits_validate_and_keep_deferred_counts_exact(self):
        import inspect
        self.assertIn("outgoing_limit", inspect.signature(partition.partition).parameters)
        self.assertIn("reference_limit", inspect.signature(partition.partition).parameters)
        source = program(1)
        source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0x9000", "at": i} for i in range(80)]
        source["references"] = [{"from": "0xbeef", "to": "0x1000", "at": i} for i in range(80)]
        source["data_refs"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": "0xa000", "at": i} for i in range(80)]
        result = self.valid_partition(source, max_bytes=1000, outgoing_limit=2, reference_limit=2)
        self.assertLessEqual(result["groups"][0]["bytes"], 1000)
        for kind in ("outgoing_calls", "references", "data_refs"):
            manifest = result["groups"][0]["overflow"][kind]
            self.assertLessEqual(manifest["retained"], 2)
            self.assertEqual(sum(manifest["by_group"].values()), manifest["deferred"])
        for limits in ({"outgoing_limit": 0}, {"reference_limit": True}):
            with self.subTest(limits=limits), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                partition.partition(program(1), **limits)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_hive_planning.py`:

```py
"""Group planning contracts, evidence paging and restart bindings without inference."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import tempfile
import unittest

from hive import partition, planning


def program(count):
    return {"file": "synthetic", "input_sha256": "ab" * 32,
            "functions": [{"entry": 0x1000 + i * 16, "hex": hex(0x1000 + i * 16),
                           "name": f"fn_{i}", "size": 16, "signature": "int f(void)"} for i in range(count)],
            "calls": [], "strings": [], "imports": []}


def declaration(kind, key, text, *, entry=None, owner=None, linkage=None, requires=()):
    return {"entity_id": kind + ":" + key, "kind": kind, "entry": entry, "owner_entry": owner,
            "linkage": linkage, "text": text, "requires": list(requires), "evidence": [entry or "0x1000"]}


def proposal(entries):
    return {"modules": [{"id": "local", "title": "Synthetic functions", "functions": list(entries)}] if entries else [],
            "skipped": [], "unknowns": [], "declarations": [
                declaration("function", e, f"int fn_{int(e, 16):x}(void); /* {e} */", entry=e) for e in entries]}


class FakeInvoke:
    def __init__(self, partitioned):
        self.outputs = {"planner-" + g["id"]: proposal(g["functions"]) for g in partitioned["groups"]}
        self.calls, self.fail, self.prior = [], {}, []
        self.prefix = "physical-"

    def __call__(self, role, name, task, folder, *, schema=None):
        self.calls.append((role, name, task, Path(folder), schema))
        if name in self.fail:
            return self.fail[name]
        if name.startswith("planner-interface-"):
            data = json.loads((Path(folder) / "interfaces.json").read_bytes())
            output = {"choices": [{"entity_id": data["entity_id"],
                                    "variant_sha256": data["variants"][0]["variant_sha256"], "evidence": ["0x1000"]}]}
        else:
            output = self.outputs[name]
        return {"ok": True, "outcome": "ok", "output": copy.deepcopy(output), "error": None,
                "provenance": {"attempt_id": self.prefix + name, "prior_attempt_ids": list(self.prior)}}


class PlanningTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hive-planning-")
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.out = Path(self.temporary.name).resolve() / "run"
        self.source = program(5)
        self.parts = partition.partition(self.source, max_functions=2)
        self.invoke = FakeInvoke(self.parts)

    def run_plan(self, **kwargs):
        return planning.plan(self.source, self.parts, out=self.out, invoke=self.invoke, language="c", **kwargs)

    def validate(self, bundle, **kwargs):
        return planning.validate_bundle(bundle, self.source, out=self.out, language="c", max_functions=kwargs.get("max_functions", 12))

    def assert_error(self, code, call):
        with self.assertRaises(planning.PlanningError) as raised:
            call()
        self.assertEqual(raised.exception.code, code, raised.exception)
        return raised.exception

    def test_groups_have_exact_coverage_and_do_not_receive_the_global_map(self):
        before = copy.deepcopy((self.source, self.parts))
        bundle = self.run_plan(max_functions=1)
        self.assertEqual([m["id"] for m in bundle["modules"]], [f"m{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 6)])
        self.assertEqual([m["functions"] for m in bundle["modules"]], [[row["hex"]] for row in self.source["functions"]])
        self.assertEqual([c[1] for c in self.invoke.calls], ["planner-g0001", "planner-g0002", "planner-g0003"])
        for call, group in zip(self.invoke.calls, self.parts["groups"]):
            role, _, _, folder, schema = call
            self.assertEqual(role, "planner")
            self.assertEqual(schema, planning.GROUP_SCHEMA)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((folder / "map.json").read_bytes()), group["map"])
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE((folder / "map.json").stat().st_mode), 0o444)
        self.assertEqual(before, (self.source, self.parts))
        self.validate(bundle, max_functions=1)

    def test_empty_program_needs_no_bee(self):
        self.source = program(0)
        self.parts = partition.partition(self.source)
        bundle = self.run_plan()
        self.assertEqual(bundle["modules"], [])
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke.calls, [])
        self.validate(bundle)

    def test_identity_is_independent_of_paths_and_attempt_ids(self):
        self.invoke.prior = ["primary-refusal"]
        first = self.run_plan()
        self.out = self.out.parent / "another"
        self.invoke.prefix = "other-"
        self.invoke.prior = []
        second = self.run_plan()
        self.assertEqual(first["plan_id"], second["plan_id"])
        self.assertNotEqual(first["planner_attempts"], second["planner_attempts"])
        self.assertIn("primary-refusal", first["planner_attempts"])

    def test_complete_manifest_is_reused_without_invoke(self):
        first = self.run_plan()
        self.invoke.calls.clear()
        self.assertEqual(self.run_plan(), first)
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke.calls, [])

    def test_refusal_preserves_valid_groups_and_resume_skips_them(self):
        refused = {"ok": False, "outcome": "provider_refusal", "output": None, "error": "refused", "provenance": {}}
        self.invoke.fail["planner-g0002"] = refused
        error = self.assert_error("provider_refusal", self.run_plan)
        self.assertIs(error.bee_result, refused)
        saved = json.loads((self.out / error.details["progress_path"]).read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(list(saved["groups"]), ["g0001"])
        self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())
        self.invoke.fail.clear()
        self.invoke.calls.clear()
        bundle = self.run_plan(saved=saved)
        self.assertEqual([c[1] for c in self.invoke.calls], ["planner-g0002", "planner-g0003"])
        self.validate(bundle)

    def test_non_ok_outcomes_retain_their_exact_cause(self):
        for outcome in ("timeout", "rate_limit", "context_limit", "invalid_schema", "failure", "not_started"):
            with self.subTest(outcome=outcome):
                result = {"ok": False, "outcome": outcome, "output": None}
                self.invoke.fail["planner-g0001"] = result
                error = self.assert_error(outcome, self.run_plan)
                self.assertIs(error.bee_result, result)
        self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())

    def test_coverage_holes_duplicates_and_foreign_assignments_are_errors(self):
        for entries in (["0x1000"], ["0x1000", "0x1000"], ["0x1000", "0x1020"]):
            with self.subTest(entries=entries):
                self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"] = proposal(entries)
                self.assert_error("planning_coverage", self.run_plan)
        self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/manifest.json").exists())

    def test_unknowns_prevent_freezing_and_incomplete_group_restarts(self):
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["unknowns"] = ["Unknown structure layout"]
        self.assert_error("interface_conflict", self.run_plan)
        saved = json.loads((self.out / "plan/progress.json").read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(saved["groups"], {})
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["unknowns"] = []
        self.invoke.calls.clear()
        self.run_plan(saved=saved)
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke.calls[0][1], "planner-g0001")

    def test_skips_need_evidence_and_remain_in_the_bundle(self):
        for output in self.invoke.outputs.values():
            entries = output["modules"][0]["functions"]
            output.update(modules=[], declarations=[], skipped=[{"entry": e, "reason": "runtime thunk", "evidence": [e]} for e in entries])
        bundle = self.run_plan()
        self.assertEqual(len(bundle["skipped"]), 5)
        self.assertEqual(bundle["modules"], [])
        self.validate(bundle)

    def test_structural_schema_rejects_unknown_or_missing_fields(self):
        for mutation in (lambda o: o.update(extra=True), lambda o: o.pop("unknowns"), lambda o: o["modules"][0].update(extra=1)):
            with self.subTest(mutation=mutation):
                self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"] = proposal(self.parts["groups"][0]["functions"])
                mutation(self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"])
                self.assert_error("invalid_schema", self.run_plan)

    def test_global_owner_follows_the_split_module(self):
        value = declaration("global", "0x2000", "extern int counter;", entry="0x2000", owner="0x1010", linkage="defined")
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["declarations"].append(value)
        bundle = self.run_plan(max_functions=1)
        self.assertEqual(bundle["modules"][1]["globals"], ["global:0x2000"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.out / "plan/interfaces.json").read_bytes())["owners"], {"global:0x2000": "m02"})
        self.validate(bundle, max_functions=1)

    def test_global_owner_must_be_a_built_function(self):
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["declarations"].append(
            declaration("global", "0x2000", "extern int counter;", entry="0x2000", owner="0xdead", linkage="defined"))
        self.assert_error("interface_conflict", self.run_plan)

    def test_external_global_has_no_generated_owner(self):
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["declarations"].append(
            declaration("global", "0x2000", "extern int counter;", entry="0x2000", linkage="external"))
        self.run_plan()
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.out / "plan/interfaces.json").read_bytes())["owners"], {})

    def test_conflicts_use_bounded_named_calls_and_existing_variants(self):
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0002"]["declarations"].append(
            declaration("function", "0x1000", "long fn_1000(void); /* 0x1000 */", entry="0x1000"))
        bundle = self.run_plan()
        calls = [c for c in self.invoke.calls if c[1].startswith("planner-interface-")]
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertRegex(calls[0][1], r"^planner-interface-[0-9a-f]{12}-r1$")
        self.assertEqual(calls[0][4], planning.INTERFACE_SCHEMA)
        self.assertLessEqual(len(calls[0][2].encode()) + (calls[0][3] / "interfaces.json").stat().st_size, 65536)
        self.assertIn("physical-" + calls[0][1], bundle["planner_attempts"])
        self.validate(bundle)

    def test_zero_conflict_rounds_never_invents_a_contract(self):
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0002"]["declarations"].append(
            declaration("function", "0x1000", "long fn_1000(void); /* 0x1000 */", entry="0x1000"))
        self.assert_error("interface_conflict", lambda: self.run_plan(interface_rounds=0))
        self.assertFalse((self.out / "plan/contract.h").exists())

    def test_text_deduplication_only_normalizes_line_endings_and_trailing_spaces(self):
        duplicate = copy.deepcopy(self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["declarations"][0])
        duplicate["text"] += "  \r\n"
        original = self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["declarations"][0]
        original["text"] += "\n"
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0002"]["declarations"].append(duplicate)
        self.run_plan()
        self.assertFalse(any("interface-" in c[1] for c in self.invoke.calls))

    def test_opaque_types_allow_pointers_but_reject_by_value(self):
        for pointer in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(pointer=pointer):
                self.out = self.out.parent / ("pointer" if pointer else "value")
                output = self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]
                output["declarations"][0] = declaration("function", "0x1000",
                    "int use(struct Opaque " + ("*" if pointer else "") + "v); /* 0x1000 */",
                    entry="0x1000", requires=["type:Opaque"])
                output["declarations"] = [d for d in output["declarations"] if d["kind"] != "type"]
                output["declarations"].append(declaration("type", "Opaque", "struct Opaque;"))
                if pointer:
                    self.run_plan()
                else:
                    self.assert_error("interface_conflict", self.run_plan)

    def test_dependencies_must_resolve_and_cycles_are_explicit_errors(self):
        output = self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]
        output["declarations"][0]["requires"] = ["type:Missing"]
        self.assert_error("interface_conflict", self.run_plan)
        output["declarations"][0]["requires"] = []
        output["declarations"].extend([
            declaration("type", "A", "struct A { int a; };", requires=["type:B"]),
            declaration("type", "B", "struct B { int b; };", requires=["type:A"])])
        self.assert_error("interface_conflict", self.run_plan)

    def test_cpp_qualified_types_and_header_path(self):
        self.invoke.outputs["planner-g0001"]["declarations"].append(
            declaration("type", "space::A", "namespace space { struct A { int a; }; }"))
        bundle = planning.plan(self.source, self.parts, out=self.out, invoke=self.invoke, language="cpp")
        self.assertEqual(bundle["contract_path"], "plan/contract.hpp")
        planning.validate_bundle(bundle, self.source, out=self.out, language="cpp", max_functions=12)

    def test_partition_corruption_is_rejected_before_any_invoke(self):
        original = copy.deepcopy(self.parts)
        mutations = [lambda p: p["groups"][0].update(bytes=1), lambda p: p["groups"][0]["functions"].pop(),
                     lambda p: p["summary"]["totals"].update(functions=99), lambda p: p["groups"][0]["map"]["functions"][0].update(name="changed")]
        for mutation in mutations:
            self.parts = copy.deepcopy(original)
            mutation(self.parts)
            with self.subTest(mutation=mutation):
                self.assert_error("invalid_partition", self.run_plan)
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke.calls, [])

    def test_large_views_page_complete_overflow_and_cut_edges_under_byte_caps(self):
        self.source = program(12)
        self.source["strings"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "address": hex(0x8000 + i), "text": "x" * 80 + str(i)} for i in range(80)]
        self.source["calls"] = [{"from": "0x1000", "to": row["hex"], "at": hex(i)} for i, row in enumerate(self.source["functions"][1:])]
        self.parts = partition.partition(self.source, max_functions=2, max_bytes=1800, string_limit=2)
        self.invoke = FakeInvoke(self.parts)
        self.run_plan(max_prompt_bytes=4096)
        for _, _, task, folder, _ in self.invoke.calls:
            initial = sum((folder / name).stat().st_size for name in ("map.json", "summary.json", "interfaces.json"))
            self.assertLessEqual(initial + len(task.encode()), 4096)
            for page in (folder / "pages").glob("*.json"):
                self.assertLessEqual(page.stat().st_size, 4096)
        evidence = json.loads((self.out / "plan/evidence/g0001-strings.json").read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(len(evidence["rows"]), 80)
        self.assertTrue(list((self.out / "plan/groups/g0001/pages").glob("*.json")))

    def test_indivisible_record_above_limit_is_not_truncated(self):
        self.source = program(1)
        self.source["functions"][0]["signature"] = "X" * 8000
        self.parts = partition.partition(self.source, max_bytes=20000)
        self.invoke = FakeInvoke(self.parts)
        self.assert_error("planning_payload_too_large", lambda: self.run_plan(max_prompt_bytes=4096))
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke.calls, [])

    def test_bundle_detects_tampered_files_or_input_without_inference(self):
        bundle = self.run_plan()
        calls = len(self.invoke.calls)
        for name in ("plan/contract.h", "plan/interfaces.json", "plan/partition.json", "plan/policy.json", "plan/manifest.json"):
            path = self.out / name
            original = path.read_bytes()
            path.chmod(0o600)
            if name.endswith(".json"):
                changed = json.loads(original)
                changed["unexpected_tampering"] = True
                path.write_text(json.dumps(changed))
            else:
                path.write_bytes(original + b" ")
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                self.assert_error("resume_mismatch", lambda: self.validate(bundle))
            path.write_bytes(original)
            path.chmod(0o444)
        self.source["file"] = "other"
        self.assert_error("resume_mismatch", lambda: self.validate(bundle))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.invoke.calls), calls)

    def test_bundle_paths_symlinks_and_hardlinks_are_refused(self):
        bundle = self.run_plan()
        path = self.out / "plan/contract.h"
        copy_path = self.out / "outside"
        path.rename(copy_path)
        path.symlink_to(copy_path)
        self.assert_error("unsafe_planning_path", lambda: self.validate(bundle))
        path.unlink()
        os.link(copy_path, path)
        self.assert_error("unsafe_planning_path", lambda: self.validate(bundle))

    def test_saved_proposal_corruption_stops_resume(self):
        self.invoke.fail["planner-g0002"] = {"ok": False, "outcome": "timeout"}
        self.assert_error("timeout", self.run_plan)

        path.chmod(0o600)

        self.invoke.calls.clear()
        self.assert_error("resume_mismatch", lambda: self.run_plan(saved=saved))
        self.assertEqual(self.invoke.calls, [])


    def test_refused_interface_keeps_group_proposals_and_attempt_provenance(self):

    def test_invalid_conflict_choices_exhaust_two_rounds_even_across_resume(self):
```

`tests/test_hive_preflight.py`:

```py
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

from hive import preflight, queen

# Low-entropy stand-in for machine code: a few repeating instruction-like words.
CODE = (b"\xfd\x7b\xbf\xa9\xfd\x03\x00\x91\x00\x00\x80\x52\xc0\x03\x5f\xd6" * 8192)[:96 * 1024]
PACKED = zlib.compress(bytes(range(256)) * 64 + b"".join(i.to_bytes(4, "little") * 3 for i in range(40000)), 9)
PACKED = (PACKED * 4)[:96 * 1024]
NORMAL_IMPORTS = ["_printf", "_fopen", "_fread", "_fwrite", "_malloc", "_free", "_strcmp", "_exit"]


def segments(code_name="__TEXT", size=96 * 1024):
    return [("__PAGEZERO", 0, 0, 0, 1 << 32, False, False, False),
            (code_name, 0, size, 1 << 32, size, True, False, True),
            ("__DATA", size, 4096, (1 << 32) + size, 4096, True, True, False)]


def functions(count, size=256, dominant=None):
    rows = [{"size": size} for _ in range(count)]
    if dominant:
        rows.append({"size": dominant})
    return rows


class AssessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_entropy_bounds(self):
        self.assertEqual(preflight.entropy(b""), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(preflight.entropy(b"\x00" * 100), 0.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(preflight.entropy(bytes(range(256))), 8.0)
        self.assertGreater(preflight.entropy(PACKED), preflight.STRONG_SEGMENT_ENTROPY)
        self.assertLess(preflight.entropy(CODE), preflight.WEAK_SEGMENT_ENTROPY)

    def test_ordinary_program_is_clean(self):
        data = CODE + b"\x00" * 4096
        result = preflight.assess(data, segments(), NORMAL_IMPORTS, functions(300), strings=500)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "clean")
        self.assertEqual(result["signals"], [])

    def test_compressed_code_is_packed(self):
        data = PACKED + b"\x00" * 4096
        result = preflight.assess(data, segments(), NORMAL_IMPORTS, functions(300), strings=500)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "packed")
        self.assertIn("executable entropy", [s["signal"] for s in result["signals"]])
        self.assertIn("Unpack", result["advice"])

    def test_packer_section_names_and_markers(self):
        data = CODE + b"\x00" * 4096
        result = preflight.assess(data, segments("UPX1"), NORMAL_IMPORTS, functions(300), strings=500)
        self.assertEqual((result["verdict"], result["packers"]), ("packed", ["UPX"]))
        marked = CODE[:2048] + b"$Info: This file is packed with the UPX executable packer $" + CODE[2048:]
        result = preflight.assess(marked, segments(), NORMAL_IMPORTS, functions(300), strings=500)
        self.assertEqual(result["packers"], ["UPX"])
        for name in (".vmp0", ".MPRESS1", ".themida"):
            self.assertEqual(preflight.assess(data, segments(name), NORMAL_IMPORTS)["verdict"], "packed", name)

    def test_weak_signals_need_company(self):
        data = CODE + b"\x00" * 4096
        one = preflight.assess(data, segments(), ["_dlopen", "_dlsym", "_mprotect"], functions(300), strings=500)
        self.assertEqual(one["verdict"], "clean")
        self.assertEqual([s["signal"] for s in one["signals"]], ["loader-only imports"])
        many = preflight.assess(data, segments(), ["LoadLibraryA", "GetProcAddress"], functions(1, dominant=80000),
                                strings=0)
        self.assertEqual(many["verdict"], "suspected")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(s["signal"] for s in many["signals"]),
                         ["few functions", "few strings", "loader-only imports", "one dominant function"])

    def test_small_programs_are_not_judged_by_density(self):
        small = CODE[:16 * 1024] + b"\x00" * 4096
        result = preflight.assess(small, segments(size=16 * 1024), NORMAL_IMPORTS, functions(1), strings=0)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "clean")


class RunTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """run() reads the approved file through intake and binds every report and the bytes to the survey's hash."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        self.inputs = self.tmp / "inputs"
        self.inputs.mkdir()
        self.program = self.inputs / "program"
        self.program.write_bytes(PACKED + b"\x00" * 4096)
        self.sha = hashlib.sha256(self.program.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        self.map = {"input_sha256": self.sha, "functions": functions(300), "strings": [{}] * 500}

    def engine(self, after_overview=None, report_sha=None):
        test = self

        class Engine:
            inputs, file, path = test.inputs, "program", test.program
            asked = []

            def query(self, name, args, out):
                self.asked.append((name, dict(args)))
                header = {"input": {"sha256": report_sha or test.sha}}
                if name == "list_segments":
                    rows = [list(row) for row in segments()][args["start"]:args["start"] + args["limit"]]
                    return {**header, "results": [{"findings": [{"claim_key": "segments.list", "verdict": "supported",
                                                                 "value": {"rows": rows}}]}]}
                if after_overview:
                    after_overview()
                return {**header, "results": [{"findings": [{"claim_key": "imports.symbols", "verdict": "supported",
                                                             "value": NORMAL_IMPORTS}]}]}
        return Engine()

    def test_run_reads_segments_and_imports_from_reverseai(self):
        engine = self.engine()
        result = preflight.run(engine, self.map, self.tmp / "pre")
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "packed")
        self.assertEqual([name for name, _ in engine.asked], ["list_segments", "binary_overview"])
        self.assertEqual(json.loads((self.tmp / "pre" / "preflight.json").read_text())["verdict"], "packed")

    def test_a_link_swapped_in_after_the_queries_is_refused(self):
        outside = self.tmp / "outside"
        outside.write_bytes(CODE + b"\x00" * 4096)  # clean bytes that would hide the packed verdict

        def swap():
            self.program.unlink()
            self.program.symlink_to(outside)
        with self.assertRaises(queen.HiveError):
            preflight.run(self.engine(after_overview=swap), self.map, self.tmp / "pre")
        self.assertFalse((self.tmp / "pre" / "preflight.json").exists())

    def test_a_changed_regular_file_is_refused(self):
        def change():
            self.program.write_bytes(CODE + b"\x00" * 4096)
        with self.assertRaises(queen.HiveError) as raised:
            preflight.run(self.engine(after_overview=change), self.map, self.tmp / "pre")
        self.assertIn("changed since the survey", str(raised.exception))

    def test_reports_about_another_input_are_refused(self):
        with self.assertRaises(queen.HiveError):
            preflight.run(self.engine(report_sha="0" * 64), self.map, self.tmp / "pre")
        with self.assertRaises(queen.HiveError):
            preflight.run(self.engine(), {"functions": []}, self.tmp / "pre2")

    def test_a_truncated_segment_is_judged_on_the_bytes_present(self):
        data = CODE[:16384] + PACKED[:256]
        rows = [("__TEXT", 0, 16384, 1 << 32, 16384, True, False, True),
                ("TAIL", 16384, 4096, (1 << 32) + 16384, 4096, True, False, True)]  # declares 4096, has 256
        result = preflight.assess(data, rows, NORMAL_IMPORTS)
        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "clean")
        self.assertEqual(result["executable_bytes"], 16384)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import json

ORIGINAL = r'''
#include <stdio.h>
static int greet_line(const char *name) { return printf("hello %s\n", name); }
int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: greet NAME\n"); return 2; }

}
'''
CONTRACT = '''#include <stdio.h>
int greet_line(const char *name); /* 0x1040 */
int main(int argc, char **argv); /* 0x1000 */

GOOD = {
    "m01": '#include "contract.h"\nint greet_line(const char *name) { return printf("hello %s\\n", name); }\n',
    "m02": '#include "contract.h"\nint main(int argc, char **argv) {\n'
           '    if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: greet NAME\\n"); return 2; }\n'
           '    greet_line(argv[1]);\n    return 0;\n}\n',
```
