```py
    "GH_TOKEN": "sentinel-13", "HF_TOKEN": "sentinel-14", "NPM_TOKEN": "sentinel-15", "SSH_AUTH_SOCK": "sentinel-16",
    "DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG": "sentinel-17", "MY_SERVICE_PASSWORD": "sentinel-18"}


class ChildEnvironmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """What the bee process receives, through the real build path, with every credential family present."""

    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        parent = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "HOME": str(self.tmp), "LANG": "C.UTF-8", "LC_ALL": "C", **SENTINELS}
        patch = mock.patch.dict(os.environ, parent, clear=True)
        patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(patch.stop)
        self.parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        self.parser.add_argument("--model")
        codex_bees.add_arguments(self.parser)

    def assert_clean(self, env):
        self.assertIsNotNone(env, "a self-hosted bee must not inherit the parent environment")
        leaked = sorted(key for key, value in env.items() if value.startswith("sentinel-"))
        self.assertEqual(leaked, [])
        self.assertEqual((env["PATH"], env["LANG"], env["LC_ALL"]), ("/usr/bin:/bin", "C.UTF-8", "C"))

    def test_claude_bee_process(self):
        claude = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=self.tmp, inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "cfg")
        args = self.parser.parse_args(["--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "--model", "m1"])
        runner = codex_bees.build(args, claude, engine=self.tmp, inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "codex")
        done = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0, json.dumps({"structured_output": ANSWER}), "")
        with mock.patch.object(bees, "run_cli", return_value=done) as run:
            self.assertTrue(runner("councillor", "c", "task", self.tmp)["ok"])
        env = run.call_args.kwargs["env"]
        self.assert_clean(env)
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:11434")  # routing kept
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN"], selfhost.PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN)

    def test_codex_bee_process_and_its_network_probe(self):
        args = self.parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex", "--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434",
                                       "--codex-model", "gpt-oss:20b"])
        claude = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=self.tmp, inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "cfg")
        runner = codex_bees.build(args, claude, engine=self.tmp, inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "codex")
        calls = []

        def fake_run(argv, **kwargs):
            calls.append(kwargs)
            Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps({"verdict": "accept", "defects": [], "summary": None}))
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, '{"type":"turn.completed"}', "")
        with mock.patch.object(bees, "run_cli", side_effect=fake_run), \
                mock.patch.object(runner, "_network_ok",  # a probe process like the real one, judged isolated
                                  wraps=lambda role, folder: bool(runner._execute(role, "probe", "t", folder))) as probe:
            answer = runner("councillor", "c", "task", self.tmp)
        self.assertTrue(answer["ok"], answer)
        self.assertTrue(probe.called)  # the network probe still decides
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 2)  # the probe's process and the bee's process
        for kwargs in calls:
            self.assert_clean(kwargs["env"])

    def test_without_the_flag_the_parent_environment_is_inherited(self):
        claude = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=self.tmp, inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "cfg")
        codex = codex_bees.build(self.parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex"]), claude, engine=self.tmp,
                                 inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "codex")
        self.assertIsNone(claude.env)
        self.assertIsNone(codex.env)


class EnvironmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_subscription_or_cloud_credential_reaches_the_bee(self):
        base = {"PATH": "/usr/bin", "HOME": "/home/x", "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN": "secret-oauth",
                "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "secret-key", "ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN": "secret-token",
                "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "https://api.anthropic.com", "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK": "1",
                "AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK": "secret-aws", "OPENAI_API_KEY": "secret-openai"}
        env = selfhost.claude_environment(base, "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "qwen3.6:35b")
        self.assertFalse([value for value in env.values() if "secret" in value])
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN"], selfhost.PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN)
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"], "")
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL"], "qwen3.6:35b")
        self.assertNotIn("CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK", env)
        self.assertEqual((env["PATH"], env["HOME"]), ("/usr/bin", "/home/x"))

    def test_the_claude_runner_passes_its_environment(self):
        tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        runner = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=tmp, inputs=tmp, config_dir=tmp / "cfg", env={"PATH": "/usr/bin"})
        done = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0, json.dumps({"structured_output": ANSWER}), "")
        with mock.patch.object(bees, "run_cli", return_value=done) as run:
            self.assertTrue(runner("councillor", "c", "task", tmp)["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(run.call_args.kwargs["env"], {"PATH": "/usr/bin"})
        default = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=tmp, inputs=tmp, config_dir=tmp / "cfg")
        with mock.patch.object(bees, "run_cli", return_value=done) as run:
            default("councillor", "c", "task", tmp)
        self.assertIsNone(run.call_args.kwargs["env"])  # unchanged default: inherit


class CommandLineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        self.parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        self.parser.add_argument("--model")
        codex_bees.add_arguments(self.parser)
        self.kwargs = {"engine": self.tmp, "inputs": self.tmp, "config_dir": self.tmp / "codex"}

    def claude(self):
        return bees.ClaudeBees(engine=self.tmp, inputs=self.tmp, config_dir=self.tmp / "cfg")

    def test_without_a_model_server_nothing_changes(self):
        claude = self.claude()
        self.assertIs(codex_bees.build(self.parser.parse_args([]), claude, **self.kwargs), claude)
        self.assertIsNone(claude.env)
        codex = codex_bees.build(self.parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex"]), claude, **self.kwargs)
        self.assertIs(type(codex), codex_bees.CodexBees)

    def test_claude_bees_go_to_the_server_with_the_named_model(self):
        claude = self.claude()
        args = self.parser.parse_args(["--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "--model", "qwen3.6:35b"])
        self.assertIs(codex_bees.build(args, claude, **self.kwargs), claude)
        self.assertEqual(claude.env["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
        self.assertIn("qwen3.6:35b", claude.argv("councillor", "c"))

    def test_codex_bees_use_a_selfhost_provider_and_keep_their_sandbox(self):
        args = self.parser.parse_args(["--bee-policy", "codex", "--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434",
                                       "--codex-model", "gpt-oss:20b"])
        codex = codex_bees.build(args, self.claude(), **self.kwargs)
        self.assertIsInstance(codex, selfhost.SelfHostedCodexBees)
        argv = codex.argv("worker", "w", self.tmp)
        self.assertIn('model_provider="selfhost"', argv)
        provider = next(item for item in argv if item.startswith("model_providers.selfhost="))
        self.assertIn('base_url="http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1"', provider)
        self.assertIn('wire_api="responses"', provider)
        self.assertEqual(argv[argv.index("-m") + 1], "gpt-oss:20b")
        self.assertIn("sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=false", argv)
        self.assertEqual(argv[-1], "-")
        self.assertFalse(codex.allow_network)  # the network probe still decides

    def test_missing_model_names_and_remote_servers_stop_the_command(self):
        for argv, text in ((["--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434"], "--model"),
                           (["--bee-policy", "codex", "--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:1"], "--codex-model"),
                           (["--model-server", "http://gpu.lan:8000", "--model", "m"], "--model-server-remote"),
                           (["--model-server-remote"], "needs --model-server")):
            with self.subTest(argv=argv), self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, text):
                codex_bees.build(self.parser.parse_args(argv), self.claude(), **self.kwargs)


class FakeAnthropic(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """A model server that answers every bee with ANSWER through the CLI's structured-output tool."""

    seen = []

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def reply(self, status, payload, content_type="application/json"):
        data = payload if isinstance(payload, bytes) else json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("content-type", content_type)
        self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self):
        type(self).seen.append({"method": "GET", "path": self.path})
        self.reply(404, {"type": "error", "error": {"type": "not_found_error", "message": "not here"}})

    def do_POST(self):
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("content-length", 0))) or b"{}")
        type(self).seen.append({"method": "POST", "path": self.path, "authorization": self.headers.get("authorization"),
                                "x-api-key": self.headers.get("x-api-key"), "model": body.get("model")})
        if "count_tokens" in self.path:
            return self.reply(200, {"input_tokens": 100})
        tools = [tool.get("name", "") for tool in body.get("tools", [])]
        structured = next((name for name in tools if "StructuredOutput" in name), None)
        answered = any(isinstance(m.get("content"), list) and any(c.get("type") == "tool_result" for c in m["content"])
                       for m in body.get("messages", []))
        if structured and not answered:
            blocks, stop = [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "toolu_selfhost", "name": structured, "input": ANSWER}], "tool_use"
        else:
            blocks, stop = [{"type": "text", "text": "Done."}], "end_turn"
        message = {"id": "msg_selfhost", "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "model": body.get("model"),
                   "content": blocks, "stop_reason": stop, "stop_sequence": None,
                   "usage": {"input_tokens": 10, "output_tokens": 10}}
        if not body.get("stream"):
            return self.reply(200, message)
        events = [("message_start", {"type": "message_start", "message": dict(message, content=[], stop_reason=None)})]
        for index, block in enumerate(blocks):
            start = dict(block, input={}) if block["type"] == "tool_use" else dict(block, text="")
            delta = ({"type": "input_json_delta", "partial_json": json.dumps(block["input"])}
                     if block["type"] == "tool_use" else {"type": "text_delta", "text": block["text"]})
            events += [("content_block_start", {"type": "content_block_start", "index": index, "content_block": start}),
                       ("content_block_delta", {"type": "content_block_delta", "index": index, "delta": delta}),
                       ("content_block_stop", {"type": "content_block_stop", "index": index})]
        events += [("message_delta", {"type": "message_delta", "delta": {"stop_reason": stop, "stop_sequence": None},
                                      "usage": {"output_tokens": 10}}),
                   ("message_stop", {"type": "message_stop"})]
        self.reply(200, "".join(f"event: {name}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n" for name, data in events).encode(),
                   "text/event-stream")


@unittest.skipUnless(os.environ.get("HIVE_SELFHOST_LIVE") == "1" and shutil.which("claude"),
                     "live check: set HIVE_SELFHOST_LIVE=1 with Claude Code installed")
class LiveClaudeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_real_claude_bee_answers_through_a_self_hosted_server(self):
        FakeAnthropic.seen = []
        server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), FakeAnthropic)
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.addCleanup(server.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(server.shutdown)
        tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}"
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        runner = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=root, inputs=tmp, config_dir=tmp / "cfg", model="local-test-model",
                                 env=selfhost.claude_environment(os.environ, url, "local-test-model"), timeout=300)
        answer = runner("councillor", "c", "Reply with the verdict accept and no defects.", tmp)
        self.assertTrue(answer["ok"], answer)
        self.assertEqual(answer["output"], ANSWER)
        posts = [request for request in FakeAnthropic.seen if request["method"] == "POST"]
        self.assertTrue(posts)
        for request in posts:  # never print a header value: a leak would put a real token in the test log
            placeholder = request["authorization"] in (None, f"Bearer {selfhost.PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN}")
            self.assertTrue(placeholder and request["x-api-key"] in (None, "", selfhost.PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN),
                            "a credential other than the placeholder reached the model server")
        self.assertEqual({request["model"] for request in posts if request["model"]}, {"local-test-model"})



class RouterFixture:
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        codex_bees.add_arguments(self.parser)
        self.parser.add_argument("--model")

    def router(self, flags=()):
        args = self.parser.parse_args(flags)
        claude = bees.ClaudeBees(engine=self.root, inputs=self.root, config_dir=self.root / "claude", model=args.model)
        return codex_bees.build_router(args, claude, engine=self.root, inputs=self.root, config_dir=self.root / "codex")

    def fallback_flags(self, scope="run"):
        return ["--fallback-model-server", "http://localhost:11434", "--fallback-model", "configured-local",
                "--fallback-scope", scope]



class RouterTests(RouterFixture, unittest.TestCase):
    def test_construction_and_describe_are_pure_policy_copies_are_isolated(self):
        with mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli") as run, mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen") as network:
            router = self.router(self.fallback_flags())
            first = router.describe("planner", "planner-g0001")
            second = router.describe("planner", "planner-g0001", local=True)
            self.assertIsNone(first["context_id"])
            self.assertIsNone(second["observed_model"])
            self.assertEqual(second["origin"], "fallback")
            self.assertEqual(second["server"], "http://localhost:11434")
            policy = router.policy()
            policy["fallback"]["roles"].append("worker")
            policy["primary"]["claude"]["requested_model"] = "changed"
            self.assertEqual(router.policy()["fallback"]["roles"], [])
            self.assertIsNone(router.policy()["primary"]["claude"]["requested_model"])
        run.assert_not_called()
        network.assert_not_called()
        self.assertIsNone(self.router().policy()["fallback"])
        self.assertIsNone(self.router().fallback("planner", "planner-g0001"))

    def test_selectors_are_exact_and_never_activate_themselves(self):
        router = self.router(self.fallback_flags("role") + ["--fallback-role", "planner"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(router.fallback("planner", "planner-g0001"))
        self.assertIsNone(router.fallback("worker", "m01-build"))
        router = self.router(self.fallback_flags("bee") + ["--fallback-bee", "planner-g0001"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(router.fallback("planner", "planner-g0001"))
        self.assertIsNone(router.fallback("planner", "planner-g00010"))
        self.assertIs(router.primary("planner", "planner-g0001"), router.primary("planner", "planner-g0002"))

    def test_inconsistent_flags_remote_fallback_and_v1_roots_are_rejected(self):
        bad = [["--fallback-model", "x"], ["--fallback-role", "worker"],
               self.fallback_flags("run") + ["--fallback-role", "worker"],
               self.fallback_flags("role"), self.fallback_flags("bee"),
               self.fallback_flags("bee") + ["--fallback-bee", "m*-build"],
               self.fallback_flags() + ["--fallback-codex-model", "unused"],
               ["--fallback-model-server", "http://host.example", "--fallback-model", "x", "--fallback-scope", "run", "--model-server-remote", "--model-server", "http://host.example", "--model", "x"],
               ["--fallback-model-server", "http://localhost:11434/v1", "--fallback-model", "x", "--fallback-scope", "run"]]
        for flags in bad:
            with self.subTest(flags=flags), self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                self.router(flags)
        for url in ("http://localhost/v1", "http://localhost/v1/", "http://localhost:bad", "http://u:p@localhost", "http://localhost/?token=secret", "http://localhost/#secret"):
            with self.subTest(url=url), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                selfhost.server_url(url)
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            self.router(["--model-server", "http://localhost/v1", "--model", "x"])

    def test_duplicate_normalized_target_model_client_is_not_an_alternative(self):
        flags = self.fallback_flags() + ["--model-server", "http://127.0.0.1:11434/", "--model", "configured-local"]
        router = self.router(flags)
        self.assertIsNone(router.fallback("planner", "planner-g0001"))
        self.assertIsNone(router.describe("planner", "planner-g0001", local=True))
        flags[-1] = "different"
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.router(flags).fallback("planner", "planner-g0001"))

    def test_mixed_client_mapping_and_models_are_explicit_on_both_destinations(self):
        flags = ["--bee-policy", "mixed", "--fallback-model-server", "http://localhost:11434", "--fallback-scope", "run"]
        for suffix in ([], ["--fallback-model", "local-c"], ["--fallback-codex-model", "local-x"]):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
                self.router(flags + suffix)
        router = self.router(flags + ["--fallback-model", "local-c", "--fallback-codex-model", "local-x"])
        for role, name, client in (("planner", "planner-g0001", "claude"), ("worker", "m01-build", "claude"),
                                  ("worker", "m02-build", "codex"), ("councillor", "m01-council-r1-io", "codex")):
            self.assertEqual(router.describe(role, name)["client"], client)
            self.assertEqual(router.describe(role, name, local=True)["client"], client)
        local = router.fallback("worker", "m02-build")
        argv = local.argv("worker", "m02-build", self.root)
        self.assertIn('base_url="http://localhost:11434/v1"', " ".join(argv))
        self.assertEqual(router.fallback("worker", "m01-build").env["ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL"], "http://localhost:11434")

    def test_probe_description_tracks_actual_pending_cache_without_running_it(self):
        router = self.router(["--bee-policy", "codex"])
        runner = router.primary("worker", "m02-build")
        first = router.describe("worker", "m02-build")
        same = router.describe("repair", "m02-repair-b1")
        council = router.describe("councillor", "m02-council-r1-io")
        self.assertEqual(first["probe_key"], same["probe_key"])
        self.assertNotEqual(first["probe_key"], council["probe_key"])
        self.assertTrue(first["probe_required"])
        runner._network_checks[first["probe_key"]] = False
        self.assertFalse(router.describe("worker", "m02-build")["probe_required"])
        runner.model = "changed"
        self.assertTrue(router.describe("worker", "m02-build")["probe_required"])

    def test_server_kind_distinguishes_remote_loopback_and_cloud(self):
        for policy in ("claude", "codex"):
            with self.subTest(client=policy):
                router = self.router(["--bee-policy", policy, "--model-server", "https://inference.example.test",
                                      "--model-server-remote", "--model", "chosen", "--codex-model", "chosen"])
                self.assertEqual(router.describe("planner", "planner-g0001")["server_kind"], "remote")
        for url in ("http://localhost:11434", "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "http://[::1]:11434"):
            with self.subTest(url=url):
                router = self.router(["--model-server", url, "--model", "chosen"])
                self.assertEqual(router.describe("planner", "planner-g0001")["server_kind"], "local")
        self.assertEqual(self.router().describe("planner", "planner-g0001")["server_kind"], "cloud")

    def test_fallback_environment_drops_cloud_credentials(self):
        with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"OPENAI_API_KEY": "SECRET", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "SECRET", "GITHUB_TOKEN": "SECRET"}):
            router = self.router(self.fallback_flags())
        env = router.fallback("planner", "planner-g0001").env
        self.assertNotIn("SECRET", repr(env))
        self.assertEqual(env["ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN"], selfhost.PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN)


MCP_PROBE = {"file": "greet", "entry": "0x1000"}


def accepted_mcp_events(client, arguments=None):
    arguments = {"file": "greet", "entry": 4096, "select": "entry", "part": "info"} if arguments is None else arguments
    if client == "claude":
        return [{"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "export",
                    "name": "mcp__reverseai__export_function", "input": arguments}]}},
                {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "export",
                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Derived function metadata"}]}]}}]
    return [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "mcp_tool_call", "id": "export",
                "server": "reverseai", "tool": "export_function", "arguments": arguments,
                "status": "completed", "result": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Derived function metadata"}]},
                "error": None}}]


class MCPNativeEvidenceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_native_acceptance_for_both_clis_and_integer_schema(self):
        from reverseai.mcp_tools import catalog
        schema = next(tool["inputSchema"] for tool in catalog(frozenset({"ghidra"})) if tool["name"] == "export_function")
        arguments = {"file": "greet", "entry": 4096, "part": "info"}
        self.assertTrue(bees.matches_schema(arguments, schema))
        self.assertFalse(bees.matches_schema(dict(arguments, entry="0x1000"), schema))
        for client in ("claude", "codex"):
            with self.subTest(client=client):
                self.assertTrue(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(accepted_mcp_events(client, arguments), client, MCP_PROBE))

    def test_prose_and_final_json_do_not_establish_mcp_acceptance(self):
        claims = [{"type": "result", "structured_output": {"mcp_tool": "ok"}, "result": "export_function accepted"},
                  {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(accepted_mcp_events("claude"))}]}},
                  {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "agent_message", "text": json.dumps(accepted_mcp_events("codex"))}}]
        for client in ("claude", "codex"):
            self.assertFalse(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(claims, client, MCP_PROBE))

    def test_acceptance_must_match_the_surveyed_function_and_selector(self):
        variants = [{"file": "other", "entry": 4096}, {"file": "greet", "entry": 8192},
                    {"file": "greet", "entry": "0x1000"}, {"file": "greet", "entry": True},
                    {"file": "greet", "entry": 4096, "select": "name"},
                    {"file": "greet", "entry": 4096, "name": "other"},
                    {"file": "greet", "entry": 4096, "part": "pseudocode"}]
        for client in ("claude", "codex"):
            for arguments in variants:
                with self.subTest(client=client, arguments=arguments):
                    self.assertFalse(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(accepted_mcp_events(client, arguments), client, MCP_PROBE))

    def test_claude_requires_correlated_nonerror_result_from_reverseai(self):
        for mutation in ("error", "wrong_id", "wrong_server", "missing_result", "result_first", "empty_content"):
            events = accepted_mcp_events("claude")
            call, result = events[0]["message"]["content"][0], events[1]["message"]["content"][0]
            if mutation == "error":
                result.update(is_error=True, content="Arguments must match this tool's input schema.")
            elif mutation == "wrong_id":
                result["tool_use_id"] = "other"
            elif mutation == "wrong_server":
                call["name"] = "mcp__other__export_function"
            elif mutation == "missing_result":
                events.pop()
            elif mutation == "result_first":
                events.reverse()
            else:
                result["content"] = []
            with self.subTest(mutation=mutation):
                self.assertFalse(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(events, "claude", MCP_PROBE))

    def test_codex_requires_completed_native_mcp_result_without_errors(self):
        for mutation in ("error", "isError", "is_error", "wrong_server", "wrong_tool", "started", "failed", "missing_result"):
            events = accepted_mcp_events("codex")
            call = events[0]["item"]
            if mutation == "error":
                call["error"] = {"code": -32602, "message": "Invalid arguments"}
            elif mutation in ("isError", "is_error"):
                call["result"][mutation] = True
            elif mutation == "wrong_server":
                call["server"] = "other"
            elif mutation == "wrong_tool":
                call["tool"] = "export_program"
            elif mutation == "started":
                events[0]["type"] = "item.started"
            elif mutation == "failed":
                call["status"] = "failed"
            else:
                call["result"] = None
            with self.subTest(mutation=mutation):
                self.assertFalse(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(events, "codex", MCP_PROBE))
        encoded = accepted_mcp_events("codex")
        encoded[0]["item"]["arguments"] = json.dumps(encoded[0]["item"]["arguments"])
        self.assertTrue(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(encoded, "codex", MCP_PROBE))

    def test_missing_target_and_malformed_events_never_pass(self):
        for target in (None, {}, {"file": "greet", "entry": 4096}, {"file": "greet", "entry": "0x10000000000000000"}):
            self.assertFalse(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(accepted_mcp_events("claude"), "claude", target))
        malformed = [None, {}, {"type": "assistant", "message": None}, {"type": "user", "message": {"content": "bad"}},
                     {"type": "item.completed", "item": None}]
        for client in ("claude", "codex", "unknown"):
            self.assertFalse(selfhost.mcp_tool_accepted(malformed, client, MCP_PROBE))


class CapabilityTests(RouterFixture, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.hooks = []

    def fake_claude(self, argv, **kwargs):
        nonce = json.loads(Path(kwargs["cwd"], "capability-input.json").read_text())["nonce"]
        events = [{"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_use", "id": "read", "name": "Read", "input": {"file_path": "capability-input.json"}}]}},
                  {"type": "user", "message": {"content": [{"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "read", "content": nonce}]}},
                  {"type": "result", "structured_output": {"nonce": nonce}}]
        events[2:2] = accepted_mcp_events("claude")
        self.assertEqual(kwargs["timeout"], 45)
        self.assertIn("--json-schema", argv)
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, "\n".join(json.dumps(e) for e in events), "")

    def test_capabilities_through_actual_runner_cli_parser_with_budgeted_probe(self):
        from tests.test_hive_bees import Hooks
        router = self.router(self.fallback_flags())
        hooks = Hooks()
        with mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude) as run:
            report = selfhost.check_model(router, "claude", local=True, required_context=64000,
                                          before_start=hooks, context_query=lambda server, model: 65536, mcp_probe=MCP_PROBE)
        self.assertTrue(report["ok"], report)
        self.assertEqual(run.call_count, 1)
        self.assertEqual(hooks.started, [("attempt-1", "network_probe")])
        self.assertEqual(len(hooks.results), 1)
        self.assertEqual(hooks.results[0][1]["provenance"]["kind"], "network_probe")
        self.assertTrue(all(c["status"] == "ok" for c in report["checks"].values()))
        self.assertEqual(router.fallback("councillor", "check").timeout, 2400)

    def test_context_check_rejects_insufficient_unknown_and_failing_metadata(self):
        router = self.router(self.fallback_flags())
        for declared, status in ((8192, "error"), (None, "unsupported"), ("65536", "unsupported")):
            with self.subTest(declared=declared), mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude):
                report = selfhost.check_model(router, "claude", local=True, context_query=lambda server, model: declared)
            self.assertFalse(report["ok"])
            self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["context"]["status"], status)
            self.assertTrue(report["checks"]["context"]["suggestion"])
        with mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude):
            report = selfhost.check_model(router, "claude", local=True, context_query=mock.Mock(side_effect=OSError("metadata unavailable")))
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["context"]["status"], "error")

    def test_claimed_tool_call_without_native_result_does_not_pass(self):
        def fake(argv, **kwargs):
            nonce = json.loads(Path(kwargs["cwd"], "capability-input.json").read_text())["nonce"]
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, json.dumps({"type": "result", "structured_output": {"nonce": nonce}}), "")
        with mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=fake):
            report = selfhost.check_model(self.router(), "claude", context_query=lambda s, m: 65536)
        self.assertFalse(report["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["structured_output"]["status"], "ok")
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["tool_roundtrip"]["status"], "unsupported")

    def test_capability_budget_denial_propagates_without_network_or_process(self):
        from tests.test_hive_bees import Hooks
        with mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli") as run, mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen") as network, self.assertRaises(bees.AttemptNotStarted):
            selfhost.check_model(self.router(), "claude", before_start=Hooks("budget_exhausted"))
        run.assert_not_called()
        network.assert_not_called()

    def test_codex_tool_roundtrip_uses_cli_schema_and_native_command_evidence(self):
        from tests.test_hive_bees import Hooks
        router = self.router(["--bee-policy", "codex", "--codex-allow-network", "--codex-model", "chosen"])
        hooks = Hooks()
        def fake(argv, **kwargs):
            nonce = json.loads(Path(kwargs["cwd"], "capability-input.json").read_text())["nonce"]
            schema = json.loads(Path(argv[argv.index("--output-schema") + 1]).read_text())
            self.assertEqual(schema["required"], ["nonce"])
            Path(argv[argv.index("-o") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps({"nonce": nonce}))
            events = [{"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "command_execution", "command": "cat capability-input.json", "exit_code": 0, "aggregated_output": nonce}}, {"type": "turn.completed"}]
            events[1:1] = accepted_mcp_events("codex")
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv, 0, "\n".join(json.dumps(e) for e in events), "")
        with mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=fake):
            report = selfhost.check_model(router, "codex", before_start=hooks, context_query=lambda s, m: 65536, mcp_probe=MCP_PROBE)
        self.assertTrue(report["ok"], report)
        self.assertEqual(hooks.started, [("attempt-1", "network_probe")])

    def metadata_server(self, routes):
        """A simulated metadata server; no HTTP request leaves this process."""
        def respond(request, **kwargs):
            path = selfhost.urllib.parse.urlsplit(request.full_url).path
            payload = routes.get(path, 404)
            if type(payload) is int:
                raise selfhost.urllib.error.HTTPError(request.full_url, payload, "metadata unavailable", {}, None)
            response = mock.MagicMock()
            response.__enter__.return_value.read.return_value = json.dumps(payload).encode()
            return response
        return mock.patch("urllib.request.urlopen", side_effect=respond)

    def test_vllm_context_metadata_passes_the_capability_check(self):
        router = self.router(self.fallback_flags())
        routes = {"/v1/models": {"object": "list", "data": [
            {"id": "another", "max_model_len": 999999},
            {"id": "configured-local", "max_model_len": 65536}]}}
        with self.metadata_server(routes) as network, mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude):
            report = selfhost.check_model(router, "claude", local=True, required_context=65536, mcp_probe=MCP_PROBE)
        self.assertTrue(report["ok"], report)
        self.assertEqual(report["declared_context"], 65536)
        self.assertEqual([call.args[0].full_url for call in network.call_args_list],
                         ["http://localhost:11434/api/ps", "http://localhost:11434/v1/models"])
        self.assertTrue(all(call.kwargs["timeout"] == 5 for call in network.call_args_list))

    def test_vllm_context_below_requirement_remains_an_error(self):
        routes = {"/v1/models": {"data": [{"id": "configured-local", "max_model_len": 8192}]}}
        with self.metadata_server(routes), mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude):
            report = selfhost.check_model(self.router(self.fallback_flags()), "claude", local=True, required_context=65536)
        self.assertFalse(report["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(report["declared_context"], 8192)
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["context"]["status"], "error")
        self.assertIn("smaller than required", report["checks"]["context"]["message"])

    def test_vllm_context_requires_exact_model_and_a_positive_integer(self):
        cards = [{"id": "another", "max_model_len": 999999}, {"id": "configured-local"}]
        cards += [{"id": "configured-local", "max_model_len": value} for value in (None, True, "65536", 0, -1)]
        for card in cards:
            with self.subTest(card=card), self.metadata_server({"/v1/models": {"data": [card]}}), \
                    mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude):
                report = selfhost.check_model(self.router(self.fallback_flags()), "claude", local=True)
            self.assertFalse(report["ok"])
            self.assertIsNone(report["declared_context"])
            self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["context"]["status"], "unsupported")
            self.assertIn("not verifiable on this server", report["checks"]["context"]["message"])

    def test_server_without_either_metadata_api_remains_unsupported(self):
        with self.metadata_server({}) as network, mock.patch("hive.bees.run_cli", side_effect=self.fake_claude):
            report = selfhost.check_model(self.router(self.fallback_flags()), "claude", local=True)
        self.assertFalse(report["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(report["checks"]["context"]["status"], "unsupported")
        self.assertIn("not verifiable on this server", report["checks"]["context"]["message"])
        self.assertEqual(network.call_count, 2)

    def test_active_ollama_context_takes_precedence_over_other_metadata(self):

                  "/v1/models": {"data": [{"id": "configured-local", "max_model_len": 65536}]}}

    def test_unrecognized_metadata_shapes_do_not_invent_context(self):

    def test_metadata_auth_and_server_errors_are_not_hidden_by_api_discovery(self):

    def test_read_only_without_a_real_survey_target_is_unsupported(self):

    def test_mcp_probe_does_not_reconfigure_the_original_runner(self):
        router = self.router()
        source = router.primary("councillor", "check")
        def inspect(argv, **kwargs):

        self.assertFalse(hasattr(source, "_capability_mcp"))

    def test_mcp_probe_requires_ghidra_enabled_in_the_actual_runner(self):

    def test_active_context_metadata_matches_configured_model_only(self):
        response = mock.MagicMock()
        response.__enter__.return_value.read.return_value = json.dumps({"models": [
            {"name": "another", "context_length": 999999}, {"name": "chosen", "context_length": 65536}]}).encode()

        self.assertEqual(request.call_args.kwargs["timeout"], 5)
```

```py
COMMIT = "a" * 40
VERSION = H.expected_version(ROOT)
WHEEL = f"reverseai-{VERSION}-py3-none-any.whl"
CLEAN = "....\nRan 4 tests in 0.1s\n\nOK (skipped=1)\n"


class StandIn:
    """Answers every proof command without running it; suite and windows_tests answers are configurable."""
    def __init__(self, *, suite=CLEAN, windows_tests="..\nRan 2 tests in 0.1s\n\nOK\n", fail=(), git=0, real=False,
                 doctor=None):
        self.calls, self.suite, self.windows_tests, self.fail, self.git = [], suite, windows_tests, set(fail), git
        self.doctor = json.dumps({"reverseai": VERSION, "host_ok": True, "tools": []}) if doctor is None else doctor
        self.real = real  # answer the import path with links resolved, as Python does

    def __call__(self, argv, *, timeout, cwd=None, env=None):
        self.calls.append((list(argv), cwd, env))
        name = self.name(argv)
        if name in self.fail:
            return 1, "", "failed on purpose"
        if name == "git":
            return (0, COMMIT + "\n", "") if self.git == 0 else (128, "", "not a git repository")
        if name == "suite":
            return 0, "", self.suite
        if name == "windows_tests":
            return 0, "", self.windows_tests
        if name == "wheel":
            folder = Path(argv[argv.index("--wheel-dir") + 1])
            folder.mkdir()
            (folder / WHEEL).write_bytes(b"PK")
            return 0, "", ""
        if name == "version":
            return 0, f"reverseai {VERSION}\n", ""
        if name == "imported_from":
            venv = Path(argv[0]).parents[1]
            imported = venv / "lib/python3.12/site-packages/reverseai/__init__.py"
            return 0, (os.path.realpath(imported) if self.real else str(imported)) + "\n", ""
        if name == "doctor":
            return 0, self.doctor, ""
        if name in ("analyze", "query"):
            out = Path(argv[argv.index("--out") + 1])
            out.mkdir()
            (out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps({"input": {"sha256": "1" * 64}, "summary": {"supported": 1}}))
            (out / "report.md").write_text("# report\n")
        return 0, "", ""

    @staticmethod
    def name(argv):
        if argv[0] == "git":
            return "git"
        if argv[1:4] == ["-B", "-m", "unittest"]:
            return "suite" if argv[4] == "discover" else "windows_tests"
        if argv[1:4] == ["-m", "pip", "wheel"]:
            return "wheel"
        if argv[1:3] == ["-m", "venv"]:
            return "venv"
        if argv[1:4] == ["-m", "pip", "install"]:
            return "install"
        if argv[1:3] == ["-I", "-c"]:
            return "imported_from"
        if argv[1:3] == ["-B", "-c"]:
            return "fixture"
        if argv[1:] == ["--version"]:
            return "version"
        if argv[1:] == ["doctor", "--json"]:
            return "doctor"
        if argv[1] in ("analyze", "query"):
            return argv[1]
        raise AssertionError(f"unexpected argv {argv}")


def run_steps(runner, *, windows=False):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
        work, source = Path(folder, "work"), Path(folder, "src")
        work.mkdir()
        (source / ".git").mkdir(parents=True)
        (source / "pyproject.toml").write_text("[project]\n")
        facts = H.steps(runner, work, source, {"PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR": "1"}, windows=windows)
        copied = sorted(path.name for path in (work / "build").iterdir())
        return facts, work, source, copied


class StepTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_posix_steps_run_offline_in_order_from_a_copy_and_use_bin(self):
        runner = StandIn()
        facts, work, source, copied = run_steps(runner)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(facts["steps"]), H.POSIX_STEPS)
        self.assertEqual(copied, ["pyproject.toml"])  # .git and caches stay behind
        argvs = {StandIn.name(argv): (argv, cwd) for argv, cwd, _ in runner.calls}
        self.assertEqual(argvs["suite"], ([sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-t", "."],
                                          source))
        self.assertEqual(argvs["wheel"][0], [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "wheel", "--no-index", "--no-deps",
                                             "--wheel-dir", str(work / "dist"), str(work / "build")])
        self.assertEqual(argvs["install"][0], [str(work / "venv/bin/python"), "-m", "pip", "install", "--no-index",
                                               "--no-deps", str(work / "dist" / WHEEL)])
        self.assertEqual(argvs["query"][0], [str(work / "venv/bin/reverseai"), "query", str(work / "run/input.elf"),
                                             "--query", "list_segments", "--arg", "limit=16", "--out",
                                             str(work / "run/query")])
        self.assertEqual(argvs["fixture"][1], source)
        self.assertTrue(all(env == {"PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR": "1"} for _, _, env in runner.calls))
        self.assertNotIn("windows_tests", facts["steps"])
        self.assertEqual((facts["query"]["reports"], facts["analyze"]["reports"]), (["report.json", "report.md"],) * 2)
        self.assertTrue(H.passed(facts, VERSION))

    def test_windows_steps_use_scripts_and_add_the_windows_report_tests(self):
        runner = StandIn()
        facts, work, source, _ = run_steps(runner, windows=True)
        self.assertEqual(tuple(facts["steps"]), ("suite",) + H.WINDOWS_STEPS)
        argvs = {StandIn.name(argv): (argv, cwd) for argv, cwd, _ in runner.calls}
        self.assertEqual(argvs["install"][0][0], str(work / "venv/Scripts/python.exe"))
        self.assertEqual(argvs["version"][0], [str(work / "venv/Scripts/reverseai.exe"), "--version"])
        self.assertEqual(argvs["windows_tests"], ([sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_windows_output",
                                                   "-v"], source))
        self.assertEqual(facts["windows_tests"]["ran"], 2)
        self.assertTrue(H.passed(facts, VERSION, windows=True))

    def test_a_failed_wheel_stops_before_any_install(self):
        facts, _, _, _ = run_steps(StandIn(fail={"wheel"}))
        self.assertEqual(list(facts["steps"]), ["suite", "wheel"])
        self.assertIsNone(facts["wheel"])
        self.assertFalse(H.passed(facts, VERSION))


class PredicateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def facts(self, windows=False, **runner):
        return run_steps(StandIn(**runner), windows=windows)[0]

    def test_posix_needs_every_step_and_a_clean_whole_suite(self):
        self.assertTrue(H.passed(self.facts(), VERSION))
        cases = {"suite failure": dict(suite="F\nRan 4 tests in 0.1s\n\nFAILED (failures=1)\n"),
                 "zero tests": dict(suite="\nRan 0 tests in 0.0s\n\nOK\n"),
                 "unparsed suite": dict(suite="Killed\n")}
        cases.update({f"{name} exit 1": dict(fail={name}) for name in H.POSIX_STEPS})
        for label, runner in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(label=label):
                self.assertFalse(H.passed(self.facts(**runner), VERSION))
        self.assertFalse(H.passed(self.facts(), VERSION + ".1"))
        outside = {**self.facts(), "imported_from": str(ROOT / "reverseai/__init__.py")}
        self.assertFalse(H.passed(outside, VERSION))

    def test_windows_gates_on_its_report_tests_not_on_the_whole_suite(self):
        failing_suite = dict(suite="F\nRan 4 tests in 0.1s\n\nFAILED (failures=1)\n")
        facts = self.facts(windows=True, **failing_suite)
        self.assertEqual(facts["suite"]["failures"], 1)  # recorded
        self.assertTrue(H.passed(facts, VERSION, windows=True))
        self.assertFalse(H.passed(facts, VERSION))
        cases = {"report test failure": dict(windows_tests="F\nRan 2 tests in 0.1s\n\nFAILED (failures=1)\n"),
                 "no report test": dict(windows_tests="\nRan 0 tests in 0.0s\n\nOK\n"),
                 "report tests all skipped": dict(windows_tests="sssssssss\nRan 9 tests in 0.0s\n\nOK (skipped=9)\n"),
                 "one report test skipped": dict(windows_tests="s.\nRan 2 tests in 0.0s\n\nOK (skipped=1)\n")}
        cases.update({f"{name} exit 1": dict(fail={name}) for name in H.WINDOWS_STEPS})
        for label, runner in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(label=label):
                self.assertFalse(H.passed(self.facts(windows=True, **runner), VERSION, windows=True))


    def test_both_hosts_need_doctor_json_saying_host_ok_for_this_version(self):
        doctors = {"malformed": "{not json", "a list": "[1]", "a string": json.dumps("ok"),
                   "host_ok false": json.dumps({"reverseai": VERSION, "host_ok": False, "tools": []}),
                   "host_ok string": json.dumps({"reverseai": VERSION, "host_ok": "true", "tools": []}),
                   "another version": json.dumps({"reverseai": VERSION + ".1", "host_ok": True, "tools": []})}
        for windows in (False, True):
            for label, output in doctors.items():
                with self.subTest(windows=windows, doctor=label):
                    facts = self.facts(windows=windows, doctor=output)
                    self.assertEqual(facts["steps"]["doctor"]["exit"], 0)
                    self.assertFalse(H.passed(facts, VERSION, windows=windows))


class ProveTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def prove(self, runner, *, windows=False, summary=False):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder, contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as stdout:
            receipt, summary_file = Path(folder, "receipt.json"), Path(folder, "summary.md")
            environment = {"GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY": str(summary_file)} if summary else {}
            with patch.dict(os.environ, environment, clear=False):
                if not summary:
                    os.environ.pop("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY", None)
                code = H.prove(receipt, runner, windows=windows)
            return (code, json.loads(receipt.read_text()), stdout.getvalue(),
                    summary_file.read_text() if summary_file.exists() else None)

    def test_the_receipt_marker_and_step_summary_carry_the_same_facts(self):
        code, receipt, printed, summary = self.prove(StandIn(), summary=True)
        self.assertEqual(code, 0)
        self.assertEqual((receipt["commit"], receipt["passed"], receipt["expected_version"]), (COMMIT, True, VERSION))
        line, = [line for line in printed.splitlines() if line.startswith(H.MARKER)]
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(line[len(H.MARKER):]), receipt)
        self.assertIn(line, summary)
        self.assertTrue(summary.startswith("### ReverseAI host proof: passed"))
        for key in ("python", "platform", "machine", "steps", "suite", "wheel", "version", "doctor", "query"):
            self.assertIn(key, receipt)

    def test_failures_and_an_unknown_commit_fail_the_receipt(self):
        for runner in (StandIn(fail={"query"}), StandIn(git=1)):
            with self.subTest(fail=runner.fail, git=runner.git):
                code, receipt, printed, summary = self.prove(runner)
                self.assertEqual((code, receipt["passed"], summary), (1, False, None))
                self.assertIn(H.MARKER, printed)
        self.assertIsNone(self.prove(StandIn(git=1))[1]["commit"])

    def test_a_scratch_directory_reached_through_a_link_still_passes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            real, link = Path(folder, "real"), Path(folder, "link")
            real.mkdir()
            try:
                link.symlink_to(real, target_is_directory=True)
            except OSError:
                self.skipTest("symbolic links are not available here")

            @contextlib.contextmanager
            def linked(prefix=None):
                (real / "work").mkdir()
                yield str(link / "work")

            with patch.object(H, "tempfile", types.SimpleNamespace(TemporaryDirectory=linked)):
                code, receipt, _, _ = self.prove(StandIn(real=True))
        self.assertEqual((code, receipt["passed"]), (0, True))
        self.assertEqual(receipt["venv"], str(real.resolve() / "work/venv"))

    def test_the_windows_receipt_names_windows_and_its_report_tests(self):
        code, receipt, _, _ = self.prove(StandIn(), windows=True)
        self.assertEqual((code, receipt["os"], receipt["windows_tests"]["ran"]), (0, "windows", 2))

    def test_the_environment_drops_python_and_index_redirections(self):
        planted = {"PYTHONPATH": "/elsewhere", "PIP_INDEX_URL": "https://index.invalid/", "PIP_FIND_LINKS": "/x",
                   "KEEP_ME": "1"}
        with patch.dict(os.environ, planted):
            env = H.host_env()
        self.assertFalse({"PYTHONPATH", "PIP_INDEX_URL", "PIP_FIND_LINKS"} & set(env))
        self.assertEqual((env["KEEP_ME"], env["PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR"], env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]), ("1", "1", "1"))

    def test_the_receipt_must_be_a_new_file_and_posix_only_calls_are_absent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder, contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
            existing = Path(folder, "receipt.json")
            existing.write_text("{}")
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as raised:
                H.main(["--receipt", str(existing)])
            self.assertEqual((raised.exception.code, existing.read_text()), (2, "{}"))
        source = (ROOT / "tools/host_proof.py").read_text()
        self.assertNotIn("getuid", source)
        self.assertTrue(source.isascii())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import random
import unittest

from reverseai.contract import MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES, ContractError, Location, Observation, canonical_json, make_evidence
from reverseai.tools import structure
from tests.fixtures_structure import elf_dynamic_imports, elf_imports, macho, patched, pe_imports
from tests.test_structure import run


class ImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sectionless_elf_uses_dynamic_program_header_and_both_hash_formats(self):
        for width in (32, 64):
            for order in ("<", ">"):
                for gnu in (True, False):
                    data, layout = elf_dynamic_imports(width=width, order=order, gnu_hash=gnu)
                    with self.subTest(width=width, order=order, gnu=gnu):
                        self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", data), [
                            Observation(Location(layout["library_names"][0], 11), {"kind": "library", "name": "libalpha.so"}),
                            Observation(Location(layout["symbol_names"][0], 5), {"kind": "symbols", "library": None, "names": ["alpha", "beta"]})])

    def test_elf_libraries_and_only_undefined_dynamic_symbols_in_both_widths_and_orders(self):
        for width in (32, 64):
            for order in ("<", ">"):
                data, layout = elf_imports(width=width, order=order)
                with self.subTest(width=width, order=order):
                    self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", data), [
                        Observation(Location(layout["library_names"][0], 11), {"kind": "library", "name": "libalpha.so"}),
                        Observation(Location(layout["library_names"][1], 10), {"kind": "library", "name": "libbeta.so"}),
                        Observation(Location(layout["symbol_names"][0], 5), {"kind": "symbols", "library": None, "names": ["alpha", "beta"]})])

    def test_pe_dll_names_hints_ordinals_and_first_thunk_fallback(self):
        for plus in (True, False):
            for original in (True, False):
                data, layout = pe_imports(plus=plus, original=original)
                with self.subTest(plus=plus, original=original):
                    self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", data), [
                        Observation(Location(layout["library_names"][0], 12), {"kind": "library", "name": "KERNEL32.dll"}),
                        Observation(Location(layout["symbol_names"][0][0], 11), {"kind": "symbols", "library": "KERNEL32.dll", "names": ["ExitProcess", "#7"]}),
                        Observation(Location(layout["library_names"][1], 10), {"kind": "library", "name": "USER32.dll"}),
                        Observation(Location(layout["symbol_names"][1][0], 11), {"kind": "symbols", "library": "USER32.dll", "names": ["MessageBoxA"]})])
                ordinal_data, ordinal_layout = pe_imports(plus=plus, libraries=((b"lib.dll", (42, 43)),))
                self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", ordinal_data)[1], Observation(
                    Location(ordinal_layout["thunks"][0], 8 if plus else 4), {"kind": "symbols", "library": "lib.dll", "names": ["#42", "#43"]}))

    def test_macho_reexport_lazy_and_upward_dylibs_use_the_bounded_name_layout(self):
        for width in (32, 64):
            data, layout = macho(width=width, libraries=(b"/usr/lib/libother.dylib",))
            position = layout["dylib_names"][0] - 24
            expected = run("structure.imports", data)
            self.assertEqual(expected[0].value, {"kind": "library", "name": "/usr/lib/libother.dylib"})
            for command in (0xC, 0x80000018, 0x8000001f, 0x20, 0x80000023):
                changed = patched(data, position, "<I", command)
                with self.subTest(width=width, command=command):
                    self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", changed), expected)
                    self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", patched(changed, position + 8, "<I", 23)), [])
                    self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", patched(changed, position + 8, "<I", 2**32 - 1)), [])

    def test_macho_load_and_weak_dylibs_and_only_undefined_external_symbols(self):
        for width in (32, 64):
            data, layout = macho(width=width, libraries=(b"/usr/lib/a.dylib", b"/usr/lib/b.dylib"), symbols=(b"_alpha", b"_beta"))
            with self.subTest(width=width):
                self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", data), [
                    Observation(Location(layout["dylib_names"][0], 16), {"kind": "library", "name": "/usr/lib/a.dylib"}),
                    Observation(Location(layout["dylib_names"][1], 16), {"kind": "library", "name": "/usr/lib/b.dylib"}),
                    Observation(Location(layout["symbol_names"][0], 6), {"kind": "symbols", "library": None, "names": ["_alpha", "_beta"]})])
                # Debug entries and common symbols (undefined type with a nonzero value) are not imports.
                start, size = layout["symbols_offset"] + (16 if width == 64 else 12), 16 if width == 64 else 12
                debug = patched(data, start + 4, "B", 0xE1)
                common = patched(data, start + 8, "<Q" if width == 64 else "<I", 12)
                defined_type = patched(data, start + 4, "B", 0xF)
                defined_section = patched(data, start + 5, "B", 1)
                for control in (debug, common, defined_type, defined_section):
                    self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", control)[-1].value["names"], ["_beta"])

    def test_groups_cut_at_32_and_observation_cap_including_json_escaping(self):
        for names in (tuple(f"symbol{i:03d}".encode() for i in range(70)), (b'"' * 128,) * 40, (b"\xff" * 128,) * 40):
            for builder in (lambda: elf_imports(libraries=(), symbols=names), lambda: macho(symbols=names),
                            lambda: pe_imports(libraries=((b"a" * 128, names),))):
                data, _ = builder()
                found = run("structure.imports", data)
                groups = [o for o in found if o.value["kind"] == "symbols"]
                self.assertEqual(sum(len(o.value["names"]) for o in groups), len(names))
                for o in groups:
                    self.assertLessEqual(len(o.value["names"]), 32)
                    self.assertLessEqual(len(canonical_json(o.value).encode()), MAX_OBSERVATION_BYTES)
                    self.assertTrue(all(0 < len(name) <= 128 and name.isascii() and name.isprintable() for name in o.value["names"]))

    def test_names_and_locations_use_the_same_escaped_bounded_prefix(self):
        names = (b"a\\\x1b\xffb", b"n" * 300, b"\xff" * 100)
        for data, _ in (elf_imports(libraries=names, symbols=names), macho(libraries=names, symbols=names)):
            found = run("structure.imports", data)
            self.assertEqual([o.value["name"] for o in found if o.value["kind"] == "library"],
                             ["a\\x5c\\x1b\\xffb", "n" * 128, "\\xff" * 32])
            self.assertEqual([o.location.length for o in found if o.value["kind"] == "library"], [5, 128, 32])
            for observation in found:
                self.assertTrue(make_evidence(data, structure.REF, "structure.imports", observation).location.within(len(data)))

    def test_max_imports_caps_observations_and_has_closed_argument_schema(self):
        data, _ = elf_imports(libraries=tuple(f"lib{i}".encode() for i in range(300)))
        self.assertEqual(len(run("structure.imports", data)), 128)
        self.assertEqual(len(run("structure.imports", data, max_imports=256)), 256)
        self.assertEqual(len(run("structure.imports", data, max_imports=1)), 1)
        spec = structure.TOOL.operations["structure.imports"]
        self.assertFalse(spec.derived)
        self.assertEqual(spec.max_observations, 256)
        for args in ({"max_imports": 0}, {"max_imports": 257}, {"max_imports": True}, {"max_imports": "1"}, {"path": "x"}):
            with self.assertRaises(ContractError):
                spec.validate_args(args)

    def test_bad_elf_link_entry_size_and_name_offsets_never_become_imports(self):
        data, layout = elf_imports()
        for control in (patched(data, layout["shoff"] + 64 + 40, "<I", 2**32 - 1),
                        patched(data, layout["shoff"] + 64 + 56, "<Q", 0),
                        patched(data, layout["dynamic"] + 8, "<Q", 2**64 - 1)):
            self.assertNotIn("libalpha.so", [o.value.get("name") for o in run("structure.imports", control)])
        out_of_range = patched(data, layout["dynsym"] + 24, "<I", layout["strings_size"])
        self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", out_of_range)[-1].value["names"], ["beta"])

    def test_malformed_pe_directory_dll_thunk_and_ordinal_cut_at_valid_prefix(self):
        data, layout = pe_imports()
        for control in (patched(data, layout["directory"], "<I", 0xFFFFFFFF),
                        patched(data, layout["descriptor"] + 12, "<I", 0xFFFFFFFF),
                        patched(data, layout["table_offset"] + 12, "<I", 0xFFFFFFFF)):
            self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", control), [])
        invalid_thunk = patched(data, layout["thunks"][0], "<Q", 0x100000001)
        self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", invalid_thunk)[0].value["name"], "KERNEL32.dll")
        self.assertFalse(any("ExitProcess" in o.value.get("names", []) for o in run("structure.imports", invalid_thunk)))
        invalid_ordinal = patched(data, layout["thunks"][0] + 8, "<Q", (1 << 63) | (1 << 30) | 7)
        self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", invalid_ordinal)[1].value["names"], ["ExitProcess"])
        # Two section headers mapping the same RVA cannot select a unique import table.
        ambiguous = bytearray(patched(data, layout["lfanew"] + 6, "<H", 2))
        table = layout["table_offset"]
        ambiguous[table + 40:table + 80] = ambiguous[table:table + 40]
        self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", bytes(ambiguous)), [])
        padding = patched(data, table + 8, "<I", 21)
        self.assertEqual(run("structure.imports", padding), [])

    def test_every_truncation_and_seeded_corruption_produces_only_bounded_observations(self):
        generator = random.Random(7317)
        for data, _ in (elf_imports(), elf_imports(width=32, order=">"), elf_dynamic_imports(), elf_dynamic_imports(gnu_hash=True),
                        pe_imports(), pe_imports(plus=False),
                        macho(libraries=(b"lib",), symbols=(b"func",))):
            corruptions = [data[:i] for i in range(len(data) + 1)]
            corruptions += [patched(data, generator.randrange(len(data)), "B", generator.randrange(256)) for _ in range(200)]
            for item in corruptions:
                found = run("structure.imports", item)
                self.assertLessEqual(len(found), 128)
                for observation in found:
                    self.assertTrue(observation.location.within(len(item)))
                    make_evidence(item, structure.REF, "structure.imports", observation)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_intake.py`:

```py
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from reverseai import intake
from reverseai.contract import ContractError, InputRef, sha256_hex


class Changed:
    """An fstat result whose selected fields differ from the real one."""

    def __init__(self, value, **changes):
        self.value, self.changes = value, changes

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        return self.changes.get(name, getattr(self.value, name))


class IntakeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(directory.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(directory.name)
        self.sample = self.root / "sample.bin"
        self.sample.write_bytes(b"\x7fELF frozen bytes")

    def refused(self, path, message):
        with self.assertRaises(intake.IntakeError) as caught:
            intake.snapshot(path)
        self.assertIsInstance(caught.exception, ContractError)
        self.assertEqual(str(caught.exception), message)
        self.assertNotIn(str(self.root), str(caught.exception))
        self.assertIsNone(caught.exception.__cause__)  # no OSError text with the path is chained

    def test_a_regular_file_is_frozen_with_its_basename(self):
        data, ref = intake.snapshot(self.sample)
        self.assertEqual(data, b"\x7fELF frozen bytes")
        self.assertEqual(ref, InputRef(sha256=sha256_hex(data), size=len(data), name="sample.bin"))
        self.assertEqual(intake.snapshot(str(self.sample)), (data, ref))

    def test_links_and_non_regular_files_are_refused(self):
        link = self.root / "link.bin"
        link.symlink_to(self.sample)
        self.refused(link, "Symlinks and reparse points cannot be input files")
        self.refused(self.root, "Only a regular file can be an input")
        hard = self.root / "hard.bin"
        os.link(self.sample, hard)
        self.refused(self.sample, "Hard-linked input files need a separate copy")
        self.refused(hard, "Hard-linked input files need a separate copy")

    @unittest.skipUnless(hasattr(os, "mkfifo"), "FIFOs need a POSIX host")
    def test_a_fifo_is_refused_without_blocking(self):
        fifo = self.root / "pipe"
        os.mkfifo(fifo)
        self.refused(fifo, "Only a regular file can be an input")

    def test_a_missing_file_is_refused_without_its_path(self):
        self.refused(self.root / "missing.bin", "Input file could not be inspected")

    def test_the_size_limit_is_enforced(self):
        with patch.object(intake, "MAX_INPUT_BYTES", 4):
            self.refused(self.sample, "Input file exceeds the byte limit")
        with patch.object(intake, "MAX_INPUT_BYTES", len(self.sample.read_bytes())):
            self.assertEqual(intake.snapshot(self.sample)[1].size, len(self.sample.read_bytes()))

    def test_a_file_replaced_or_changed_during_the_read_is_refused(self):
        real = os.fstat
        def replaced(descriptor):
            return Changed(real(descriptor), st_ino=real(descriptor).st_ino + 1)
        with patch.object(intake.os, "fstat", side_effect=replaced):
            self.refused(self.sample, "Input file changed identity while opening")
        calls = []
        def grown(descriptor):
            calls.append(descriptor)
            value = real(descriptor)
            return Changed(value, st_size=value.st_size + 1) if len(calls) > 1 else value
        with patch.object(intake.os, "fstat", side_effect=grown):
            self.refused(self.sample, "Input changed while reading")
        calls.clear()
        def touched(descriptor):
            calls.append(descriptor)
            value = real(descriptor)
            return Changed(value, st_mtime_ns=value.st_mtime_ns + 1) if len(calls) > 1 else value
        with patch.object(intake.os, "fstat", side_effect=touched):
            self.refused(self.sample, "Input changed while reading")

    def test_an_empty_file_is_frozen(self):
        empty = self.root / "empty.bin"
        empty.write_bytes(b"")
        self.assertEqual(intake.snapshot(empty), (b"", InputRef(sha256=sha256_hex(b""), size=0, name="empty.bin")))

    def test_a_nul_in_the_path_is_an_intake_error(self):
        self.refused(str(self.root) + "/a\x00b", "Input file could not be inspected")

    def test_non_utf8_names_become_escapes_that_reports_can_encode(self):
        name = intake.display_name(Path(os.fsdecode(b"/any/bad\xffname.bin")))
        self.assertEqual(name, "bad\\xffname.bin")
        json.dumps(name).encode("utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(len(intake.display_name(Path("n" * 300))), 255)

    def test_a_literal_backslash_never_looks_like_an_escaped_byte(self):
        text = intake.display_name(Path(os.fsdecode(b"/any/a\\xffb.bin")))  # the four characters \ x f f
        byte = intake.display_name(Path(os.fsdecode(b"/any/a\xffb.bin")))  # the single byte 0xFF
        self.assertEqual((text, byte), ("a\\x5cxffb.bin", "a\\xffb.bin"))
        self.assertEqual(intake.display_name(Path("caf\u00e9 \u6587\u4ef6.bin")), "caf\u00e9 \u6587\u4ef6.bin")

    def test_truncation_keeps_whole_escapes(self):
        cases = (
            (b"n" * 251 + b"\xff", "n" * 251 + "\\xff"),  # exactly 255 characters: unchanged
            (b"n" * 252 + b"\xff\xfe", "n" * 252 + "\u2026"),  # the escape would cross 254: dropped whole
            (b"n" * 250 + b"\\" + b"n" * 10, "n" * 250 + "\\x5c" + "\u2026"),
            (b"\xff" * 100, "\\xff" * 63 + "\u2026"),
        )
        for raw, expected in cases:
            with self.subTest(raw=raw[-12:]):
                shown = intake.display_name(Path(os.fsdecode(b"/any/" + raw)))
                self.assertEqual(shown, expected)
                self.assertLessEqual(len(shown), 255)

    def test_a_final_ellipsis_always_means_truncation(self):
        whole = intake.display_name(Path("n" * 240 + "\u2026"))  # 252 characters once escaped: not truncated
        self.assertEqual(whole, "n" * 240 + "\\xe2\\x80\\xa6")
        self.assertEqual(intake.display_name(Path("n" * 300)), "n" * 254 + "\u2026")
        self.assertEqual(intake.display_name(Path("n" * 250 + "\u2026")), "n" * 250 + "\\xe2\u2026")  # whole escapes kept

    def test_escapes_start_at_byte_0x80(self):
        self.assertEqual(intake.display_name(Path(os.fsdecode(b"/any/a\x7fb\x80c\xffd"))), "a\x7fb\\x80c\\xffd")

    def test_the_input_ref_uses_the_display_name(self):
        with patch.object(intake, "display_name", return_value="shown.bin") as shown:
            self.assertEqual(intake.snapshot(self.sample)[1].name, "shown.bin")
        shown.assert_called_once()

    def test_a_real_non_utf8_file_name_reaches_the_input_ref_escaped(self):
        try:
            raw = os.fsencode(self.root) + b"/bad\xffname.bin"
            with open(raw, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(b"x")
        except OSError:
            self.skipTest("this file system refuses non-UTF-8 names")  # macOS APFS does
        self.assertEqual(intake.snapshot(os.fsdecode(raw))[1].name, "bad\\xffname.bin")

    @unittest.skipUnless(hasattr(os, "mkfifo"), "FIFOs need a POSIX host")
    def test_a_fifo_swapped_in_after_inspection_is_refused_without_blocking(self):
        real = intake._regular_stat
        def swap(path):
            value = real(path)
            path.unlink()
            os.mkfifo(path)
            return value
        outcome = []
        def attempt():
            try:
                intake.snapshot(self.sample)
            except intake.IntakeError as error:
                outcome.append(str(error))
        with patch.object(intake, "_regular_stat", side_effect=swap):
            worker = threading.Thread(target=attempt, daemon=True)
            worker.start()
            worker.join(timeout=10)
        if worker.is_alive():  # unblock the reader before failing
            os.close(os.open(self.sample, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK))
            self.fail("opening a FIFO blocked: O_NONBLOCK is missing")
        self.assertEqual(outcome, ["Input file changed identity while opening"])

    def test_the_open_handle_is_checked_again(self):
        real = os.fstat
        for label, changes, message in (
                ("second hard link", {"st_nlink": 2}, "Input file changed identity while opening"),
                ("not a regular file", {"st_mode": stat.S_IFIFO | 0o644}, "Input file changed identity while opening")):
            with self.subTest(label), patch.object(intake.os, "fstat", side_effect=lambda fd, c=changes: Changed(real(fd), **c)):
                self.refused(self.sample, message)
        calls = []
        def ctime_changed(descriptor):
            calls.append(descriptor)
            value = real(descriptor)
            return Changed(value, st_ctime_ns=value.st_ctime_ns + 1) if len(calls) > 1 else value
        with patch.object(intake.os, "fstat", side_effect=ctime_changed):
            self.refused(self.sample, "Input changed while reading")

    def test_a_link_swapped_in_after_inspection_is_not_followed(self):
        if not getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0):
            self.skipTest("O_NOFOLLOW is not available on this host")
        target = self.root / "target.bin"
        target.write_bytes(b"other bytes")
        real = intake._regular_stat
        def swap(path):
            value = real(path)
            path.unlink()
            path.symlink_to(target)
            return value
        with patch.object(intake, "_regular_stat", side_effect=swap):
            self.refused(self.sample, "Input file could not be opened")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_jadx_contract.py`:

```py
"""Identity arguments for contained tools and the derived android.java claim."""

import unittest

from reverseai import claims
from reverseai.contract import (
    AnalysisResult, ArgSpec, ContractError, InputRef, Location, Observation, OperationSpec, ToolRef, ToolSpec,
    content_id, make_evidence, make_finding, sha256_hex,
)
from reverseai.review import review

DATA = bytes(range(256)) * 4
INPUT = InputRef(sha256_hex(DATA), len(DATA), "fixture.apk")
JADX = ToolRef("jadx", "1.5.6-r1")
ROW = {"dex": "classes.dex", "class": "Lorg/reverseai/fixture/Helper;", "name": "compute", "prototype": "(II)I",
       "form": "java", "start": 0, "total": 52, "text": "public static int compute(int i, int i2) {\n\treturn i + i2;\n}"[:52]}


def tools(derived=True):
    operation = OperationSpec("jadx.method", {}, lambda data, args: [], max_observations=16, derived=derived)
    return {"jadx": ToolSpec(JADX, {"jadx.method": operation})}


def judge(value, spec=None):
    item = make_evidence(DATA, JADX, "jadx.method", Observation(Location(0, 16), {"kind": "java", **value}))
    finding = make_finding("code", "Java.", "android.java", value, [item.id], "inferred")
    result = AnalysisResult(content_id("tk", {"t": "java"}), "code", "ok", (item,), (finding,))
    return review(DATA, INPUT, [result], spec or tools())[0].status


class IdentityArgumentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_identity_is_printable_ascii_and_contained_tools_may_declare_it(self):
        identity = ArgSpec("identity", 0, 255, default="")
        for good in ("", "Lcom/obf/\\xe9\\u200b;", "-x", "(II)I", "<init>", "~" * 255):
            self.assertEqual(identity.check(good), good)
        for bad in ("café", "a\nb", "\x7f", "x" * 256, 7, None):
            with self.assertRaises(ContractError):
                identity.check(bad)
        self.assertEqual(ArgSpec("identity", 1, 255).check("L;"), "L;")
        with self.assertRaises(ContractError):
            ArgSpec("identity", 1, 255).check("")
        method = OperationSpec("jadx.method", {"class": ArgSpec("identity", 1, 255)}, lambda d, a: [], derived=True)
        ToolSpec(JADX, {"jadx.method": method}, contained=True)
        literal = OperationSpec("jadx.method", {"class": ArgSpec("literal", 1, 255)}, lambda d, a: [], derived=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ContractError):
            ToolSpec(JADX, {"jadx.method": literal}, contained=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ContractError):  # The contract bound is 255
            ArgSpec("identity", 0, 256)


class JavaClaimTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_well_formed_java_page_is_derived_even_under_a_misregistered_spec(self):
        self.assertEqual(judge(ROW), "derived")
        self.assertEqual(judge(ROW, tools(derived=False)), "derived")
        self.assertIn("android.java", claims.DERIVED_CLAIMS)
        self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, "form": "error", "text": "", "start": 0, "total": 0}), "derived")
        self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, "form": "fallback", "start": 10, "total": 62}), "derived")
        self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, "form": "omitted", "text": "", "start": 0, "total": 0}), "derived")

    def test_each_malformed_field_is_refused(self):
        bad = [("dex", ""), ("class", "Lé;"), ("prototype", ""), ("form", "smali"), ("start", -1),
               ("total", 51), ("text", "café"), ("text", "a\rb"), ("text", "x" * 2049)]
        for field, value in bad:
            self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, field: value}), "unsupported", (field, value))
        self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, "form": "error"}), "unsupported")
        self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, "form": "omitted"}), "unsupported")  # No text
        self.assertEqual(judge({**ROW, "extra": 1}), "unsupported")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
